2026-05-14.explanation: The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) is headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra. It is a premier research and development organisation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). C-DAC is widely known for developing India’s first indigenous supercomputer, PARAM 8000, in 1991. The organisation plays a significant role in advanced computing, electronics, and information technology research in India. In the IP Catalyst initiative launched in 2026, C-DAC Pune was entrusted with the implementation of the programme aimed at promoting patent commercialisation and supporting innovation-driven technology development across the country.

2026-05-14.question: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the BRISEC Chamber of Commerce & Industry in May 2026?
2026-05-14.explanation: Dr Harvansh Chawla was appointed as the Chairman of the BRISEC Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI) on May 11, 2026. Before taking up this position, he stepped down as the Chairman of the BRICS CCI. The BRISEC Chamber focuses on promoting cross-border trade, investment, and economic collaboration among emerging and established markets. It also works to expand policy dialogue beyond the traditional BRICS framework into broader global economic corridors. The organisation is officially recognised by NITI Aayog and regularly organises forums, trade delegations, and policy interactions to strengthen international business cooperation.

2026-05-14.question: What is the revised annual release date for the Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP and Q4 GDP announced by the NSO?
2026-05-14.explanation: The National Statistics Office (NSO) revised the annual release schedule for the Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP and Fourth Quarter GDP to June 7 each year. Earlier, the data was released on the last working day of May. The revision was made after consultations with the Advisory Committee on National Accounts Statistics (ACNAS). The new schedule allows the inclusion of important corporate financial data and finalised Central Government account figures such as taxes, subsidies, and capital expenditure. The NSO, functioning under the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation, is responsible for compiling national accounts and major macroeconomic indicators in India.

2026-05-14.question: Which platform partnered with SAI to launch CWG 2030 engagement initiatives in 2026?
2026-05-14.explanation: MyBharat, officially known as Mera Yuva Bharat, is a technology-driven platform launched on October 31, 2023, for youth development in India. It partnered with the Sports Authority of India (SAI) to launch nationwide digital engagement initiatives ahead of the Commonwealth Games 2030 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. These initiatives included a Torch Design Contest, CWG Reel Challenge, and CWG 2030 Quiz. The platform aims to encourage youth participation in sports, creativity, and nation-building activities through digital outreach and engagement programmes across the country.

2026-05-14.question: What GDP growth forecast did Moody's set for India for 2026 and 2027?
2026-05-14.explanation: Moody's Investors Service revised India's GDP growth forecast to 6% for both 2026 and 2027 due to rising energy costs and geopolitical tensions affecting the economy. The downgrade reflects concerns over subdued private consumption, weaker industrial activity, and reduced capital formation. India’s dependence on imported energy, especially crude oil and LPG passing through the Strait of Hormuz, increases vulnerability to global disruptions. Higher fuel and fertiliser costs may also strain government finances and reduce capital spending. Moody’s is one of the world’s leading credit rating agencies and closely monitors global economic and financial conditions.

2026-05-14.question: Who took oath as the Chief Minister of Puducherry for a fifth term in May 2026?
2026-05-14.explanation: N Rangasamy, leader of the All India NR Congress (AINRC), was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Puducherry for the fifth time on May 13, 2026. The oath of office was administered by Lieutenant Governor K Kailashnathan. The AINRC-led NDA alliance formed the government after securing the support of 18 MLAs, crossing the majority mark in the Puducherry Legislative Assembly. Along with him, Malladi Krishna Rao and A Namassivayam were inducted as ministers. N Rangasamy also won assembly elections from both Thattanchavady and Mangalam constituencies with significant victory margins.

2026-05-13.question: Who assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) on 09 May 2026?
2026-05-13.explanation: Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) on 09 May 2026. Before his elevation, he served as Director (Finance) and also handled the additional responsibility of Director (Commercial) in the company. Dr. Panda began his career with SAIL in 1992 as a Management Trainee (Technical), showcasing a long and experienced association with the organisation. SAIL is a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Steel and plays a major role in India’s steel production and industrial development.

2026-05-13.question: Which airport in Mumbai achieved the Zero Waste to Landfill (ZWL) Platinum – Class I Rating for diverting over 99% of its waste from landfills?

options.D: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport

2026-05-13.explanation: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (CSMIA) in Mumbai achieved the prestigious Zero Waste to Landfill (ZWL) Platinum – Class I Rating on May 12, 2026. The recognition was awarded by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for successfully diverting more than 99 percent of airport waste away from landfills. This achievement highlights the airport’s strong commitment to sustainable waste management and environmental conservation. CSMIA is also one of India’s busiest airports, handling over 50 million passengers annually. The airport is operated by Mumbai International Airport Limited, where Adani Airport Holdings Limited holds the majority stake.

2026-05-13.question: How many Panchayats across 17 States and Union Territories were selected for the National Panchayat Awards 2025?
2026-05-13.explanation: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj announced the National Panchayat Awards 2025, recognising 42 Panchayats from 17 States and Union Territories for their outstanding contributions to rural development and local governance. These awards are presented under the Incentivization of Panchayats component of the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA). The awards encourage Panchayati Raj Institutions to improve governance, social welfare, women's empowerment, child welfare, water conservation, and livelihood opportunities. Cash incentives ranging from ₹50 lakh to ₹5 crore are provided to winning Panchayats. Karnataka secured the highest number of awards, followed by Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.

2026-05-13.question: In which city was the National Conference on Laboratory Animal Welfare organised by the Committee for Control and Supervision of Experiments on Animals (CCSEA) on May 11, 2026?
2026-05-13.explanation: The National Conference on Laboratory Animal Welfare was organised in New Delhi by the Committee for Control and Supervision of Experiments on Animals (CCSEA) on May 11, 2026. The conference focused on promoting ethical research practices and ensuring animal welfare in scientific experiments. It was conducted under the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying with the theme “Policies and Best Practices of Research on Animals and their Welfare.” The event highlighted humane treatment of animals during vaccine development and drug discovery trials while also encouraging institutions to align with international animal welfare standards and responsible scientific research practices.

2026-05-13.question: Which city in Gujarat will host the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships from May 11 to 17, 2026?
2026-05-13.explanation: Gandhinagar, the capital city of Gujarat, has been selected as the host venue for the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships. The event is scheduled to take place from May 11 to 17, 2026, and it marks a significant milestone as India will organise the championship after a gap of 44 years. Around 180 athletes from 28 countries are expected to participate in the tournament. The championship is also important because it serves as a qualifying event for major international competitions like the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games, highlighting India’s growing role in hosting international sporting events.

2026-05-13.question: Which country developed an AI-driven electrochemical process to convert nitrate-polluted wastewater into sustainable agricultural ammonia?
2026-05-13.explanation: China developed an advanced Artificial Intelligence-driven electrochemical process to transform nitrate-polluted wastewater into sustainable agricultural ammonia. The innovation uses machine learning to identify the most effective Dual-Atom Catalyst (DAC) for nitrate electroreduction. This technology operates at room temperature with renewable electricity and achieves nearly three times the efficiency of earlier methods. The process is environmentally significant because it helps reduce water pollution, limits eutrophication in aquatic ecosystems, and lowers carbon emissions associated with traditional ammonia production. It also serves as an eco-friendly alternative to the conventional Haber-Bosch process, which requires fossil fuels, high temperatures, and extreme pressure.

2026-05-13.question: Which Indian city is hosting the Kimberley Process Intersessional Meeting 2026 from May 11 to May 14, 2026?
2026-05-13.explanation: Mumbai is hosting the Kimberley Process Intersessional Meeting 2026 from May 11 to May 14, 2026, under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry. India assumed the Chair of the Kimberley Process on January 1, 2026, focusing on the theme of credibility, compliance, and consumer confidence in the natural diamond sector. The meeting includes representatives from 86 countries and the European Union. The Kimberley Process Certification Scheme was established to prevent conflict diamonds from entering legitimate global markets. India’s role as a major global hub for diamond cutting and polishing further strengthens its importance in the international diamond trade and regulatory framework.

2026-05-13.question: Which organization successfully conducted the long-duration test of an Actively Cooled Full Scale Scramjet Combustor for hypersonic missiles?
2026-05-13.explanation: DRDO, the Defence Research and Development Organisation, successfully carried out a major long-duration test of an Actively Cooled Full Scale Scramjet Combustor for hypersonic missile technology on May 09, 2026. The test was conducted at the Scramjet Connect Pipe Test Facility in Hyderabad and achieved a continuous engine runtime of more than 1,200 seconds, surpassing the earlier benchmark set in January 2026. The project involved advanced indigenous technologies such as liquid hydrocarbon endothermic fuel and high-temperature thermal barrier coatings. This achievement strengthens India’s Hypersonic Cruise Missile Development Program and highlights the country’s growing capability in advanced aerospace and missile technologies.

2026-05-13.question: In which Indian state was the Girder Laying Ceremony for the Indian Coast Guard’s Air Cushion Vehicles (ACVs) conducted on May 11, 2026?
2026-05-13.explanation: The Girder Laying Ceremony for the 4th, 5th, and 6th Air Cushion Vehicles (ACVs) of the Indian Coast Guard was conducted in Goa on May 11, 2026. The ceremony took place at the Rassaim Yard of Chowgule Shipyard. These hovercrafts are being built with 50% indigenous material under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, promoting self-reliance in defence manufacturing. The ACVs are specially designed for high-speed coastal patrolling, reconnaissance, interception, and search-and-rescue missions in shallow waters, marshy terrains, and deep sea regions. The project highlights India’s growing focus on strengthening coastal security and indigenous defence production.

2026-05-13.question: In which Indian state was the Annapurna Bhandaar scheme announced to provide ₹3,000 monthly financial assistance to eligible women?
2026-05-13.explanation: The Annapurna Bhandaar scheme was announced in West Bengal on May 11, 2026, by Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. The scheme aims to provide direct financial support of ₹3,000 per month to eligible women through bank transfers. It replaces the earlier Lakshmir Bhandar scheme, which offered lower financial assistance to women from the general and SC/ST categories. Along with financial aid, the state government also introduced free travel for women on state-run buses. The initiative reflects the government’s focus on women’s welfare, social security, and economic empowerment while integrating several central government schemes within the state.

2026-05-12.question: Which city’s government launched a new aftercare scheme in May 2026 to support youth leaving child care institutions after turning 18?
2026-05-12.explanation: The government of New Delhi launched an aftercare scheme aimed at supporting vulnerable youth transitioning out of child care institutions after reaching the age of 18. The initiative focuses on rehabilitation, financial support, emotional counselling, education, and vocational opportunities. A budget allocation of ₹3.5 crore was made for the 2026-27 financial year to implement the program effectively. The scheme operates under the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015, which emphasises the welfare and rehabilitation of children in need of care and protection. District and state-level committees will oversee the implementation and ensure individualised care plans for beneficiaries.

2026-05-12.question: Which state government created the Singappen Special Task Force in 2026 to strengthen women’s safety measures?
2026-05-12.explanation: The Tamil Nadu government established the Singappen Special Task Force as a dedicated police wing focused on improving women’s safety and protection across the state. The initiative aims to strengthen preventive measures, security systems, and rapid response mechanisms for crimes against women. The task force functions under the direct supervision of the Chief Minister and includes several high-ranking police officers, such as an Inspector General of Police, Superintendent of Police, Deputy Superintendents, Inspectors, and Sub-Inspectors. Alongside this initiative, the state also carried out key administrative restructuring under the IAS (Pay) Rules, 2016, reflecting the government’s emphasis on governance reforms and public safety.

2026-05-12.question: Who became one of the first openly transgender candidates elected to the Scottish Parliament in 2026?
2026-05-12.explanation: Q Manivannan, originally from Tamil Nadu, achieved a historic milestone by winning a seat in the Scottish Parliament in 2026 as a representative of the Scottish Green Party. This victory made Manivannan one of the first openly transgender and non-binary individuals elected to Holyrood. An important aspect of this achievement was that the election was won without permanent UK residency or British citizenship. Eligibility was possible because of a 2025 rule change allowing individuals with legal immigration status to contest public office. The event highlights progress in political inclusivity, representation, and equal opportunities within Scotland’s democratic system.

2026-05-12.question: Which country signed 8 Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with India during Dr S. Jaishankar's diplomatic visit in May 2026?
2026-05-12.explanation: India and Trinidad and Tobago strengthened their bilateral relationship by signing eight MoUs covering sectors such as infrastructure, security, healthcare, tourism, and capacity building. The agreements were signed during External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar’s official visit in May 2026. A significant part of the visit included paying tribute at Nelson Island, the historic site where the first Indian indentured labourers, known as Girmitiyas, arrived in Trinidad and Tobago during British colonial rule. The visit highlighted the deep cultural and historical connections between the two nations, while also promoting stronger diplomatic, economic, and people-to-people ties for future cooperation.

2026-05-12.question: Who became the second youngest chess grandmaster in history in May 2026 after securing the final GM norm at the Sardinia World Chess Festival?
2026-05-12.explanation: Faustino Oro, a young chess prodigy from Argentina, achieved global recognition by becoming the second youngest grandmaster in chess history at the age of 12. He secured his final grandmaster norm during the Sardinia World Chess Festival held in Italy. Oro also became one of only a few players worldwide to earn the prestigious GM title before turning 13 years old. Earlier, he had already made history by becoming the youngest International Master and the first under-12 player to cross the 2500 ELO rating mark. His achievement reflects the growing rise of exceptionally talented young chess players in international competitions.

2026-05-12.question: What is the name of the AI-powered virtual assistant launched by the judiciary in May 2026 to help litigants access judicial services?
2026-05-12.explanation: Su Sahay is an Artificial Intelligence-powered chatbot launched by the Indian judiciary to improve access to judicial services for citizens and litigants. Introduced alongside the One Case One Data initiative, the chatbot was developed by the National Informatics Centre in collaboration with the Supreme Court Registry. Its main purpose is to provide front-end assistance, guide users through judicial procedures, and offer access to live court updates and official legal information. The initiative aims to modernise the judicial system through digital integration, reduce administrative barriers, and make legal services more accessible and transparent for the general public across India.

2026-05-12.question: Who was appointed as the next Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India in May 2026?
2026-05-12.explanation: Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani was appointed as the next Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India, succeeding Gen Anil Chauhan after his retirement in May 2026. Along with serving as the principal military adviser to the Defence Minister, the CDS also functions as the Secretary of the Department of Military Affairs. Lt Gen Subramani has a distinguished military career, having been commissioned into the Garhwal Rifles in 1985 and later serving in key strategic roles along the Line of Actual Control and the western front. His appointment reflects the government’s emphasis on experienced leadership and integrated military coordination within India’s defence structure.

2026-05-12.question: Who was formally appointed as the Chief Minister of Assam on May 11, 2026, following the assembly election results?
2026-05-12.explanation: Himanta Biswa Sarma was formally appointed as the Chief Minister of Assam by Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya under Article 164(1) of the Constitution. The appointment came after the NDA secured a strong majority in the 126-member Assam Legislative Assembly. The BJP emerged as the leading party with 82 seats, while its allies AGP and BPF also contributed to the coalition’s victory. This appointment marked an important political milestone, as Himanta Biswa Sarma became the first non-Congress leader in Assam to serve two consecutive terms as Chief Minister, further strengthening the NDA’s political presence in the state since 2016.

2026-05-12.question: What is the projected real GDP growth rate of India for FY27 according to SBI Research?
2026-05-12.explanation: SBI Research projected India’s real GDP growth for the fiscal year 2026-27 (FY27) at 6.6% despite challenges such as global economic uncertainty and fluctuating crude oil prices. The report also highlighted strong credit growth among Scheduled Commercial Banks during FY26, driven largely by increased consumption and GST-related economic activity. However, credit growth is expected to moderate in FY27 due to the high base effect. Additionally, rising crude oil prices remain a concern because they can widen the current account deficit, increase inflation, and reduce overall GDP growth. The forecast reflects India’s resilience amid global economic pressures.

2026-05-12.question: Which Indian state achieved a zero per cent primary school dropout rate in 2024-25, along with major improvements in enrolment and transition metrics?
2026-05-12.explanation: Jharkhand achieved a remarkable milestone by recording a zero per cent primary school dropout rate in 2024-25. The state also showed major progress in reducing upper primary and secondary school dropout rates. In addition, transition rates from primary to upper primary and secondary education improved significantly. Girls’ enrolment in higher secondary education also increased notably. Despite these achievements, the state still faces challenges such as declining academic performance in mathematics and language scores, a high pupil-teacher ratio, and thousands of teaching vacancies. These developments highlight both the progress and ongoing educational concerns in Jharkhand.

2026-05-11.question: Which state emerged as the top-performing state in India under PMAY-U 2.0 housing completions?
2026-05-11.explanation: Odisha secured the top position in India for achieving the highest number of housing completions under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U 2.0). The state consistently maintained the number one rank from March 2025 to March 2026 for urban housing completion performance. Under the scheme’s second phase, more than 24,000 houses were sanctioned in Odisha, with a large number successfully geo-tagged and several thousand units under active construction. The initiative is managed by the Housing and Urban Development Department in coordination with Urban Local Bodies. PMAY-U aims to provide durable and affordable housing to eligible urban households across the country.

2026-05-11.question: Who became the first Indian woman elected as a Fellow of The Meteoritical Society in 2026?
2026-05-11.explanation: Professor Kuljeet Kaur Marhas was elected as a Fellow of The Meteoritical Society in 2026 for her exceptional contributions to planetary science and cosmochemistry. She became the first Indian woman to receive this prestigious recognition and only the third Indian scientist to achieve the honour after Devendra Lal and JN Goswami. Her research at the Physical Research Laboratory in Ahmedabad focuses on isotopes, pre-solar grains, Calcium-Aluminium-rich Inclusions, and extraterrestrial materials collected from missions such as Stardust, Hayabusa, and Apollo. Her scientific work has significantly advanced the understanding of the origin and evolution of the Solar System through sophisticated isotopic analysis techniques.

2026-05-11.question: Which university became India's first Institution of Eminence to receive accreditation from the Data Science Council of America (DASCA)?
2026-05-11.explanation: O.P. Jindal Global University (JGU), located in Sonipat, Haryana, became the first Institution of Eminence in India to receive accreditation from the Data Science Council of America (DASCA). The accreditation was granted under the World Data Science & AI Initiative (WDSAI) to align academic programs with international industry standards. The certification remains valid until 2031 and covers residential, non-residential, and online learning formats. Several AI and Data Science-related programs, including MBA, M.Sc., and undergraduate courses, received recognition under this framework. The achievement highlights the university’s growing focus on advanced technology education, ethical AI practices, and globally benchmarked academic excellence.

2026-05-11.question: Which state government launched the Lump Sum Traffic Challan Settlement Scheme 2026?
2026-05-11.explanation: The Lump Sum Traffic Challan Settlement Scheme 2026 was launched by the Bihar Police along with the state transport department to address the large number of pending traffic e-challans. The scheme focuses on resolving challans that remained unpaid for more than 90 days as of March 31, 2026. It also offers relief in penalties for minor traffic offences such as speeding, not wearing helmets or seat belts, and driving without a licence. More than two lakh pending challan cases are targeted for disposal through the National Lok Adalat process, improving efficiency in traffic law enforcement and dispute resolution across Bihar.

2026-05-11.question: Which institution announced the establishment of its first international deep-tech centre in Menlo Park, California?
2026-05-11.explanation: IIT Madras announced the creation of its first international deep-tech center in Menlo Park, California, with an investment plan of US$ 7.5 million. The initiative was introduced at the SelectUSA Investment Summit and aims to support Indian deep-tech startups by providing access to mentorship, funding opportunities, and global markets. Developed in collaboration with CA Startups, the centre is designed to encourage translational research, innovation, and international talent exchange. IIT Madras, established in 1959 with support from West Germany, is recognised as one of India’s leading engineering and research institutions and is headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

2026-05-11.question: Which bank received RBI approval to acquire up to 9.99% stake in AU Small Finance Bank and Federal Bank in May 2026?
2026-05-11.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India approved Kotak Mahindra Bank to acquire up to 9.99% stake in both AU Small Finance Bank and Federal Bank. The approval allowed the Kotak Mahindra Group to increase its aggregate holding in the two banking institutions through paid-up share capital or voting rights. Following the announcement, market valuations of the involved banks witnessed positive movement. Kotak Mahindra Bank, founded by Uday Kotak in 1985, became the first Non-Banking Financial Company in India to convert into a commercial bank in 2003. The development highlights ongoing consolidation and strategic investments within India’s banking and financial sector.

2026-05-11.question: What GDP growth rate was projected for India for FY27 by S&P Global in May 2026?
2026-05-11.explanation: S&P Global revised India’s FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.6% due to a major energy supply disruption originating in West Asia. The downgrade reflected concerns over rising crude oil prices, increased freight costs, and global economic uncertainty. Earlier projections estimated growth at 7.1%, while the economy had previously expanded by 7.6%. The report also highlighted rising inflation, weakening of the Indian rupee, and widening current account deficits caused by increased import dependence on crude oil and gas. To address the economic challenges, the government introduced stabilisation measures such as a ₹1 lakh crore oil hedging fund and maintenance of strategic petroleum reserves.

2026-05-11.question: From which year did the Supreme Court propose the creation of a permanent Vice-President post reserved for women in the SCBA?
2026-05-11.explanation: The Supreme Court proposed the establishment of a permanent Vice-President post reserved exclusively for women in the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) beginning from the 2027-28 term. The move is aimed at improving women’s representation in legal institutions and encouraging greater participation in leadership roles within the legal profession. The court also retained the reservation of the Secretary post for women in the 2026-27 SCBA elections. These reforms are part of broader judicial efforts to strengthen gender inclusion, including reservations for women in bar associations and bar councils, ultimately paving the way for increased representation of women in senior legal positions.

2026-05-11.question: What is the name of the newly commissioned Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessel inducted into the Indian Coast Guard in May 2026?
2026-05-11.explanation: ICGS Achal is a new-generation Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessel commissioned into the Indian Coast Guard at Goa Shipyard Limited on May 09, 2026. The vessel was designed and built entirely in India, supporting the government’s focus on indigenous defence manufacturing and self-reliance. More than 50 percent of its components are domestically produced, highlighting advancements in the Indian shipbuilding sector. The vessel is intended to strengthen maritime security and coastal surveillance operations across India’s maritime frontiers. The commissioning ceremony was attended by senior officials from the Ministry of Defence and the Indian Coast Guard, reflecting the strategic importance of the induction.

2026-05-11.question: Who was appointed as the Co-Chair of the Indian side of the Saudi-India Business Council (SIBC) by FICCI?
2026-05-11.explanation: Priyanka Mittal of KRBL Limited was appointed as the Co-Chair of the Indian side of the Saudi-India Business Council (SIBC) by the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI). She will work alongside Dr. Siddeek Ahmed to strengthen corporate and trade relations between India and Saudi Arabia. KRBL Limited is widely recognised for its India Gate rice brand and for maintaining an integrated supply chain system. The SIBC serves as an important platform for enhancing bilateral economic cooperation, trade partnerships, and investment opportunities between the two countries, contributing to stronger commercial engagement and long-term business collaboration.

2026-05-10.question: Who was sworn in as the new Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on May 10, 2026?
2026-05-10.explanation: C. Joseph Vijay, the actor-turned-politician and founder of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on May 10, 2026. The oath-taking ceremony was held at Chennai’s Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium in the presence of political leaders, celebrities, alliance partners, and thousands of supporters. His victory marked a major political shift in Tamil Nadu, ending nearly six decades of dominance by the DMK and AIADMK parties. TVK emerged as the single largest party in the 2026 Assembly elections and formed the government with support from alliance partners, including Congress, CPI, CPI(M), VCK, and IUML.

2026-05-10.question: On which date is World Thalassemia Day officially observed every year?
2026-05-10.explanation: World Thalassemia Day is observed every year on May 8 to spread awareness about thalassemia, a hereditary blood disorder that affects haemoglobin production and requires lifelong medical care. The 2026 theme, “Hidden No More: Finding the Undiagnosed. Supporting the Unseen,” highlighted the importance of identifying undiagnosed patients and improving support systems. The observance also promotes prenatal screening to reduce the number of affected births. Established officially on May 8, 1994, by Panos Englezos, the day honours patients battling thalassemia and encourages global healthcare communities to improve treatment, care, and advocacy efforts worldwide.

2026-05-10.question: Which country had its Olympic ban lifted by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) for participation under its national flag at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics?
2026-05-10.explanation: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) lifted the ban on Belarus on May 7, 2026, allowing Belarusian athletes to participate under their national flag at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Belarusian teams and officials will also be included in the opening ceremony and official medal standings. In contrast, Russia continues to remain suspended because the Russian Olympic Committee unlawfully absorbed sports organisations from occupied Ukrainian territories. Russian athletes are only permitted to compete as “Individual Neutral Athletes” without national symbols. The decision reflects changing international sports policies and varying stances among global sporting federations regarding participation restrictions.

2026-05-10.question: On which date was Mother’s Day celebrated across the world in 2026?
2026-05-10.explanation: Mother’s Day 2026 was celebrated globally on May 10, which fell on the second Sunday of May. The occasion honours the unconditional love, sacrifices, care, and support provided by mothers and maternal figures. People celebrate the day through family gatherings, heartfelt wishes, gifts, flowers, and expressions of gratitude. The modern celebration of Mother’s Day began in the early 20th century due to the efforts of American social activist Anna Jarvis, who organised the first official observance in 1908 in memory of her mother. Today, Mother’s Day is recognised worldwide as one of the most meaningful family-oriented celebrations.

2026-05-10.question: Which city is hosting India’s first International Ophthalmology Research Conference, AIOS-AFOU 2026?
2026-05-10.explanation: India’s first International Ophthalmology Research Conference, AIOS-AFOU 2026, is being held at the Manekshaw Centre in New Delhi on May 09 and 10, 2026. The conference is jointly organised by the Department of Ophthalmology at Army Hospital (Research & Referral) and the All-India Ophthalmological Society. The event focuses on advancements in ophthalmology and encourages collaboration between civil and military medical institutions. Renowned international experts and leading ophthalmologists from premier institutes such as AIIMS New Delhi, PGI Chandigarh, and LV Prasad Eye Institute are participating. The conference also highlights innovations in AI-driven eye diagnostics and modern ophthalmic research.

2026-05-10.question: Which organisation successfully tested a 120-kilowatt lithium-fed magnetoplasmadynamic (MPD) thruster for future Mars travel missions?
2026-05-10.explanation: NASA, in collaboration with the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), successfully tested a 120-kilowatt lithium-fed magnetoplasmadynamic (MPD) thruster on May 08, 2026. The advanced propulsion technology uses ionized lithium plasma accelerated through magnetic fields to produce electromagnetic thrust. The system operates using Nuclear Electric Propulsion (NEP), where a compact nuclear reactor powers the thrusters instead of solar energy. This innovation is significant for future deep-space exploration and crewed Mars missions, which may require power outputs between 2 and 4 megawatts. The successful test represents a major milestone in high-power space propulsion technology for long-duration interplanetary travel.

2026-05-10.question: Who took oath as West Bengal’s first BJP Chief Minister after the 2026 Assembly elections?
2026-05-10.explanation: Suvendu Adhikari became the first Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Chief Minister of West Bengal after taking oath on May 9, 2026. His appointment followed the BJP’s historic victory in the 2026 Assembly elections, where the party secured 207 seats in the 294-member Assembly, ending the Trinamool Congress’s 15-year rule. The swearing-in ceremony took place at Brigade Parade Ground in Kolkata in the presence of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other senior NDA leaders. Suvendu Adhikari had earlier joined the BJP in December 2020 after leaving the Trinamool Congress and later emerged as one of the party’s strongest leaders in West Bengal politics.

2026-05-10.question: On which date is World Ovarian Cancer Day observed every year?
2026-05-10.explanation: World Ovarian Cancer Day is observed annually on May 8 to raise awareness about ovarian cancer and promote better healthcare access for women worldwide. In 2026, the World Ovarian Cancer Coalition marked the 14th observance of the day by launching new initiatives focused on health equity. The campaign theme “No Woman Left Behind” emphasised equal access to diagnosis and quality treatment irrespective of geographic location. Awareness activities, including the #ReachForTheScars campaign and the WOCD 2026 toolkit, aimed to educate people about early symptoms, the importance of timely medical care, and the risks associated with delayed diagnosis.

2026-05-10.question: Which country hosted the ISO TC 20 / SC 14 international subcommittee meetings on space systems and operations for the first time in 2026?
2026-05-10.explanation: India hosted the ISO TC 20 / SC 14 international subcommittee meetings on space systems and operations for the first time on May 08, 2026, in New Delhi. The meetings were organized by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) at Bharat Mandapam and witnessed participation from 131 delegates representing 13 countries. The event focused on creating global standards for mission safety, interoperability, and mitigation of space debris. The conference also highlighted India’s rapidly growing private space ecosystem, encouraged through IN-SPACe policy reforms. Experts from ISRO and several international space agencies participated, strengthening India’s role in global space governance and technological cooperation.

2026-05-10.question: Where was the 52nd All India Sainik Schools Principals’ Conference inaugurated on May 07, 2026?
2026-05-10.explanation: The 52nd All India Sainik Schools Principals’ Conference was inaugurated at Kazhakoottam in Kerala by Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth on May 07, 2026. The conference brought together delegates from 33 Sainik Schools and principals of 79 New Sainik Schools through video conferencing. The event included activities such as a wreath-laying ceremony at the War Memorial and exhibitions on educational technology at the Gyan Mela. Several awards for academic excellence and contributions to defence academy admissions were presented during the conference, highlighting the role of Sainik Schools in preparing students for leadership and military careers.

2026-05-09.question: Who was named the South Asia regional winner of the 2026 Cambridge Dedicated Teacher Awards?
2026-05-09.explanation: Soma Mandal, an Indian science teacher, was selected as the South Asia regional winner of the 2026 Cambridge Dedicated Teacher Awards for her innovative work in environmental education. The awards are organised by Cambridge University Press & Assessment to recognise outstanding educators from different regions across the world. Winners are chosen based on their impact on students, creativity in teaching, and contribution to education. Soma Mandal was recognized for her practical environmental initiatives that encouraged awareness and learning among students. Along with the recognition, winners receive a commemorative trophy and books worth £500 for their classrooms, supporting further educational development.

2026-05-09.question: Which state is set to emerge as a premium fruit hub according to the Fruit Horizon 2026 conference?
2026-05-09.explanation: Uttar Pradesh is being developed as a premium fruit hub through initiatives discussed at the Fruit Horizon 2026 conference held at the ICAR-Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH) in Lucknow. The conference focused on improving fruit quality, shelf life, export standards, and achieving “zero rejection” for international markets. A specialized task force involving ICAR institutions, APEDA, exporters, and related agencies will prepare an action plan to increase farmers’ income and strengthen the horticulture sector. In addition, a modern Clean Plant Centre is being established to provide disease-free planting materials for fruits such as mango, guava, litchi, and avocado, boosting export-oriented agricultural development.

2026-05-09.question: In which country was the humanoid robot monk Gabi introduced?
2026-05-09.explanation: South Korea introduced its first humanoid robot monk named Gabi after it completed a traditional Buddhist precept ceremony at the Jogye Temple in Seoul on May 07, 2026. The initiative was organised by the Jogye Order to address the shortage of human monks and attract younger generations toward Buddhism through technology. Developed using China’s Unitree G1 platform, the robot was given symbolic Buddhist elements such as a rosary and a ceremonial burn sticker. Specially modified vows were also designed for the robot, including respecting life, avoiding deception, and saving energy. Gabi is expected to participate in religious and cultural events such as the Yeondeunghoe lantern festival.

2026-05-09.question: In which city was the 100th N-Gen Post Office inaugurated at North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU)?
2026-05-09.explanation: The 100th N-Gen Post Office in India was inaugurated at North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU) in Shillong, Meghalaya, by Union Minister for Communications Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia on May 6, 2026. N-Gen Post Offices are modern postal hubs designed mainly for youth and students within educational institutions. These facilities provide services such as free Wi-Fi, QR-based payment systems, concessional parcel services, and dedicated student service counters. The Shillong branch is unique because it is operated entirely by women staff and incorporates eco-friendly local materials like bamboo and straw, reflecting sustainability and community participation in its design and development.

2026-05-09.question: On which date is World Athletics Day observed annually?
2026-05-09.explanation: World Athletics Day is observed every year on May 7 to promote athletics and encourage young people to participate in sports and physical activities. The day is regulated by World Athletics, the international governing body for athletics headquartered in Monaco. In 2026, the theme for the observance is “Sport: Building Bridges, Breaking Barriers.” The celebration aims to spread awareness about the importance of fitness, teamwork, discipline, and sportsmanship while encouraging schools and institutions to organise athletic events and grassroots competitions. It also highlights the role of sports in building healthier communities and fostering social and environmental awareness among youth.

2026-05-09.question: In which city was the seminar on Sustainable Spice Value Chains organised in May 2026?
2026-05-09.explanation: The seminar on Sustainable Spice Value Chains was organised in Kochi, Kerala, by the Consulate General of the Netherlands and the World Spice Organisation. The event focused on enhancing sustainability in the spice industry while addressing European regulations related to food safety, quality standards, and traceability. India plays a significant role in the global spice market by exporting more than 250 varieties of spices and value-added products to over 180 countries. The seminar also reviewed the progress of the National Sustainable Spices Program (NSSP), which supports sustainable cultivation practices among thousands of farmers involved in producing spices such as chilli, turmeric, coriander, cumin, and pepper.

2026-05-09.question: On which date is World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day observed annually?
2026-05-09.explanation: World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day is observed every year on May 08 to recognise humanitarian efforts carried out across the world by volunteers and aid workers. The day commemorates the birth anniversary of Henry Dunant, the founder of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. In 2026, the theme was “United in Humanity. No Matter Where, No Matter When,” highlighting the importance of humanitarian assistance during conflicts, disasters, and refugee crises. Volunteers and relief workers provided support in regions affected by war, displacement, and infrastructure damage, including areas in the Middle East, Ukraine, and refugee camps in Chad, demonstrating global solidarity and compassion.

2026-05-09.question: Which Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands was ousted after losing a no-confidence vote in May 2026?
2026-05-09.explanation: Jeremiah Manele, the Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands, was removed from office on May 7, 2026, after losing a no-confidence vote in the national parliament. He lost the motion by 22 votes to 26 in the 50-seat legislature. The political crisis intensified after multiple cabinet resignations and the withdrawal of coalition partners from the ruling Government for National Unity and Transformation. Concerns regarding governance, financial accountability, and rising infrastructure debt to China further contributed to the instability. Following the vote, parliament was adjourned so that the Governor-General could oversee the process of electing a new national leader under the country’s parliamentary democratic system.

2026-05-09.question: Which company became India’s first space-tech unicorn after raising $60 million in funding in 2026?
2026-05-09.explanation: Skyroot Aerospace became India’s first space-tech unicorn after raising $60 million in a funding round co-led by Sherpalo Ventures and Singapore’s sovereign wealth fund GIC. The Hyderabad-based company achieved a valuation of $1.1 billion, marking a major milestone for India’s private space sector. Founded in 2018 by former ISRO engineers Pawan Kumar Chandana and Naga Bharath Daka, Skyroot Aerospace is developing orbital launch vehicles such as Vikram-1 and Vikram-2. The company had earlier achieved success by launching the Vikram-S suborbital rocket in 2022, becoming the first private Indian firm to send a rocket into space.

2026-05-09.question: Which city is scheduled to host the 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championship 2026?
2026-05-09.explanation: The 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championship 2026 is scheduled to be held in New Delhi from July 27 to August 2, 2026, at the Thyagraj Stadium. The event is being jointly organised by the Government of Delhi and the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI). Players from more than 35 Commonwealth nations, including England, Australia, Canada, South Africa, and Singapore, are expected to participate. The championship aims to strengthen India’s sports infrastructure and aligns with the Vision 2036 Olympics mission. India has previously hosted major Commonwealth sporting events, including the 2010 Commonwealth Games in New Delhi.

2026-05-08.question: Which country participated with India in the ninth Foreign Office Consultations held in May 2026?
2026-05-08.explanation: India and Sudan conducted the ninth round of Foreign Office Consultations (FOC) in Port Sudan on May 4, 2026, to review and strengthen bilateral relations. The discussions covered areas such as trade, energy, mining, agriculture, digital infrastructure, and capacity building. Both countries also emphasised cooperation in counter-terrorism and human resource development through programs like ITEC and ICCR scholarships. Sudan condemned the terrorist attack in Pahalgam, reflecting support for security cooperation with India. The meeting further reinforced diplomatic engagement between the two nations, and it was decided that the next round of consultations would be hosted in New Delhi.

2026-05-08.question: Who was appointed as the non-executive chairman of Vodafone Idea Limited?
2026-05-08.explanation: Kumar Mangalam Birla was appointed as the non-executive chairman of Vodafone Idea Limited, succeeding Ravinder Takkar. Prior to this elevation, he served as a non-executive director on the company’s board. The leadership transition was approved by the board and disclosed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, ensuring regulatory compliance and transparency. Ravinder Takkar stepped down from the chairman position and assumed the role of non-executive vice-chairman to maintain continuity in leadership. Vodafone Idea, formed through the merger of Vodafone India and Idea Cellular in 2018, is one of India’s leading telecommunications service providers with headquarters in Mumbai and Gandhinagar.

2026-05-08.question: Which city will host the second edition of WAVES Doc Bazaar in June 2026?
2026-05-08.explanation: The second edition of WAVES Doc Bazaar will be hosted in Mumbai from June 16 to June 18, 2026, at the NFDC Complex alongside the 19th Mumbai International Film Festival (MIFF). The event is designed to support documentary, animation, and short filmmakers by providing them with mentorship, networking opportunities, and international market exposure. Key components of the event include the Viewing Room for showcasing completed films and the Work-In-Progress Lab for filmmakers seeking expert guidance during post-production stages. Organised in connection with MIFF, the initiative strengthens India’s creative and cinematic ecosystem while promoting independent and high-quality filmmaking.

2026-05-08.question: Who was appointed as the new Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) in May 2026?
2026-05-08.explanation: Shashi Shekhar Vempati was appointed as the new Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) by the Government of India on May 6, 2026. He succeeded Prasoon Joshi, who stepped down after being elevated as the Chairman of Prasar Bharati. Vempati will serve a three-year term from the date of assuming office. The CBFC functions under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and is responsible for regulating the public exhibition of films in India under the Cinematograph Act, 1952. Originally established as the Central Board of Film Censors in 1951, the CBFC is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

2026-05-08.question: Which country participated with India in the inaugural Joint Commission meeting to expand bilateral defence cooperation in May 2026?
2026-05-08.explanation: India and Algeria held their inaugural Joint Commission meeting in New Delhi on May 05, 2026, to strengthen bilateral defence cooperation. The meeting was co-chaired by senior defence officials from both countries and focused on expanding collaboration in military training, joint exercises, defence industries, and medical cooperation. Both sides signed the Rules of Procedure to establish a structured framework for implementing defence initiatives. The engagement reflects growing strategic ties between India and Algeria following the signing of a Defence Memorandum of Understanding in 2024. Algeria, the largest country in Africa by land area, continues to play an important role in India’s outreach to African nations.

2026-05-08.question: Which two regions signed reform-linked agreements with the Ministry of Jal Shakti for implementing Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0?
2026-05-08.explanation: Mizoram and Ladakh signed reform-linked agreements with the Ministry of Jal Shakti on May 06, 2026, for the implementation of Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0. The mission aims to provide sustainable and community-led rural drinking water systems under the vision of “Har Ghar Jal” by 2028. Mizoram achieved near-complete progress in water supply schemes and established multiple testing laboratories, while Ladakh recorded over 98% Functional Household Tap Connection coverage in rural areas. The agreements also emphasise the role of Village Water and Sanitation Committees, community participation, and convergence with schemes like MGNREGA to ensure long-term sustainability of rural water infrastructure.

2026-05-08.question: Which city has been designated as the headquarters of the newly notified South Coast Railway (SCoR) zone?
2026-05-08.explanation: The Union Government officially notified the creation of the South Coast Railway (SCoR) zone with its headquarters in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. The new railway zone will become operational from June 1, 2026, and has been formed by reorganising parts of the East Coast Railway and South Central Railway under the Railways Act, 1989. The restructuring includes divisions such as Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada, and the reorganised Visakhapatnam division. The establishment of the new zone is aimed at improving operational efficiency, strengthening freight and passenger connectivity, and supporting regional infrastructure development across Andhra Pradesh and nearby regions.

2026-05-08.question: In which state did Coal India Limited commission a 100 MW solar power plant in March 2026?
2026-05-08.explanation: Coal India Limited (CIL), a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Coal, commissioned a 100 MW solar power project in Gujarat with effect from March 31, 2026. The project received its official commissioning certificate from the Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA). This initiative is part of CIL’s broader strategy to diversify into renewable energy and move toward becoming a net-zero energy company. The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) had earlier highlighted delays in achieving the company’s solar energy targets, prompting faster implementation of renewable energy projects to support India’s clean energy transition and sustainable development goals.

2026-05-08.question: Which city’s government approved a major salary increase for Vocational and Samagra Shiksha educators?
2026-05-08.explanation: The New Delhi Government approved a significant salary hike for Vocational and Samagra Shiksha teachers to strengthen the education system and support contractual educators. Vocational teachers will now receive ₹38,100 per month, while Samagra Shiksha teachers will receive ₹35,420 per month, bringing them closer to the salary structure of regular teaching staff. The policy benefits more than 1,100 vocational teachers and educators working in hundreds of Special Training Centres. The initiative aims to improve teacher retention, reduce financial insecurity, and ensure better academic support for school dropouts so they can successfully reintegrate into the formal education system under the Samagra Shiksha framework.

2026-05-08.question: Which country partnered with India to set a bilateral trade target of $25 billion by 2030?
2026-05-08.explanation: India and Vietnam held bilateral discussions in New Delhi and agreed to achieve a bilateral trade target of $25 billion by 2030 under their enhanced comprehensive strategic partnership. The talks focused on expanding trade, improving agricultural market access, and strengthening defence cooperation. Both countries granted access for products such as Indian grapes and Vietnamese durians while also working toward faster clearances for other agricultural goods. They additionally agreed to establish a 2+2 Dialogue mechanism involving foreign and defence ministries. The discussions also emphasised the early review and implementation of the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) to further strengthen economic integration and regional cooperation.

2026-05-07.question: Which organisation inaugurated the new CBRN Field Training and Demonstration Centre in Delhi?
2026-05-07.explanation: The Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) inaugurated a new Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear (CBRN) Field Training and Demonstration Centre at Burari plains in Delhi. The facility was opened by Dr. Samir V Kamat, who serves as the Secretary of the Department of Defence R&D and Chairman of DRDO. The centre is part of the upcoming CBRN Centre of Excellence under the Institute of Nuclear Medicine & Allied Sciences (INMAS). It includes advanced infrastructure such as radiological test beds, heavy ion research facilities, and emergency response systems to provide specialized training for defence personnel and disaster management agencies.

2026-05-07.question: In which city was India’s first comprehensive Urban Testbed and Aerosol Observatory inaugurated?
2026-05-07.explanation: India’s first comprehensive Urban Testbed and Aerosol Observatory was inaugurated in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES). The project was established by the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) along with the Centre for Atmospheric Science Research and Innovation (CASRI). Equipped with advanced instruments, weather stations, and X-band radars, the observatory is designed to monitor atmospheric conditions, aerosols, rainfall patterns, and thermodynamic changes. The initiative aims to improve short-term weather forecasting, study the effects of aerosols on climate change, and strengthen India’s climate and weather research capabilities under the broader vision of Mission Mausam.

2026-05-07.question: Which city will host the inaugural International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit in June 2026?
2026-05-07.explanation: The inaugural International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit will be hosted in New Delhi on 1st and 2nd June 2026 by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. The summit aims to bring together global wildlife conservation delegates to strengthen cooperation for the protection of big cat species. Guided by the theme “Save Big Cats, Save Humanity, Save Ecosystem,” the event seeks to adopt the historic Delhi Declaration focused on transboundary big cat conservation. The summit is inspired by India’s successful conservation initiatives, such as Project Tiger, and highlights India’s growing leadership role in global wildlife and biodiversity protection efforts.

2026-05-07.question: What was the non-food credit growth recorded by Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs) for the financial year 2025-26?
2026-05-07.explanation: Scheduled Commercial Banks (SCBs) recorded a strong non-food credit growth of 15.9% during the financial year 2025-26. This marked a significant improvement compared to the previous year’s growth rate of 10.9%. The increase was driven by rising demand for credit across the industrial, agricultural, and services sectors. Industrial credit saw notable expansion in infrastructure and manufacturing, while agriculture benefited from improved rural consumption and formal credit systems. The services sector also experienced strong growth due to NBFCs, trade, and commercial real estate activities. Overall, the data reflect increased economic activity and stronger lending momentum within the Indian banking sector.

2026-05-07.question: In which city will the second edition of the Joint Commanders’ Conference be held in May 2026?
2026-05-07.explanation: The second edition of the Joint Commanders’ Conference is scheduled to be held in Jaipur, Rajasthan, on May 07 and May 08, 2026. The conference focuses on the theme “Military Capability in New Domains” and brings together top defence leadership, including Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh and Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan. Discussions during the event will centre on emerging challenges such as cyber warfare, space security, cognitive warfare, and unmanned systems. The conference also emphasises self-reliance in defence production under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative and highlights the importance of civil-military fusion in strengthening India’s defence capabilities.

2026-05-07.question: What Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) per quintal was approved for sugarcane farmers for the Sugar Season 2026-27?
2026-05-07.explanation: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) for sugarcane at Rs. 365 per quintal for the Sugar Season 2026-27. This rate is applicable for a basic recovery rate of 10.25% and will come into effect from October 1, 2026. Farmers are eligible for additional premiums if the sugar recovery rate exceeds the benchmark, while deductions apply for lower recovery rates. The decision benefits nearly 5 crore sugarcane farmers and lakhs of workers employed in sugar mills and related industries. The FRP system ensures fair compensation to farmers while maintaining stability in the sugar sector.

2026-05-07.question: In which state were two new semiconductor manufacturing units approved under the India Semiconductor Mission?
2026-05-07.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved two semiconductor manufacturing projects in Gujarat under the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) on May 05, 2026. One project by Crystal Matrix Limited in Dholera will establish India’s first commercial Gallium Nitride (GaN)-based Mini/Micro-LED display facility, while the second project by Suchi Semicon Private Limited in Surat focuses on semiconductor assembly and testing. Together, the projects involve investments worth ₹3,936 crore and are expected to generate employment for more than 2,200 skilled professionals. These initiatives strengthen India’s semiconductor ecosystem and support the country’s vision of becoming a global hub for electronics and chip manufacturing.

2026-05-07.question: In which state has the Cabinet approved the development of a new Ship Repair Facility at Vadinar?
2026-05-07.explanation: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the establishment of a new Ship Repair Facility at Vadinar in Gujarat on May 05, 2026. The project will be jointly implemented by the Deendayal Port Authority (DPA) and Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) with an investment of ₹1,570 crore. The facility is planned as a brownfield infrastructure project and will include advanced repair facilities such as floating dry docks, marine workshops, and a long jetty. It is expected to strengthen India’s maritime infrastructure, improve ship repair capacity for larger vessels, and generate significant employment opportunities in logistics and related industries.

2026-05-07.question: In which state will the Coal-to-Ammonium-Nitrate facility developed by BCGCL be situated?
2026-05-07.explanation: L&T Energy Hydrocarbon Onshore secured a major contract from Bharat Coal Gasification and Chemicals Ltd (BCGCL) to establish a Coal-to-Ammonium-Nitrate facility in Odisha. The project aims to convert high-ash domestic coal into ammonium nitrate with a planned production capacity of 2,000 tonnes per day. This initiative supports India’s broader goal of achieving 100 million tonnes of coal gasification capacity by 2030 under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative. The project is expected to reduce import dependence and promote the production of value-added products such as ammonia, methanol, and synthetic natural gas while strengthening India’s industrial and energy sectors.

2026-05-07.question: Which country secured a $515 million financing agreement from the World Bank for the Dorjilung Hydropower Project?
2026-05-07.explanation: Bhutan secured a $515 million financing agreement from the World Bank for the development of the 1,125 MW Dorjilung Hydropower Project. The project is the largest hydropower initiative in Bhutan, developed under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model. It is being executed by Dorjilung Hydro Power Limited, a joint venture between Bhutan’s Druk Green Power Corporation and India’s Tata Power. Once completed, the project will significantly enhance Bhutan’s power generation capacity and support energy exports to India. The financing package involves support from multiple World Bank institutions, including the IBRD, IDA, and IFC, highlighting international cooperation in sustainable energy development.

2026-05-06.question: Which state launched the Centre of Excellence for Space Technology (CoE SpaceTech Foundation) in Bengaluru in May 2026?
2026-05-06.explanation: Karnataka launched the Centre of Excellence for Space Technology (CoE SpaceTech Foundation) in Bengaluru on May 1, 2026, to promote advanced aerospace research and innovation. The initiative aims to support both hardware and software development in cutting-edge space technology. The centre operates under the supervision of Priyank Kharge, the Minister for Information Technology and Biotechnology. Bengaluru, often called the Space City of India, serves as a major hub for aerospace, defence, and software industries. The initiative also seeks to attract global scientists, researchers, and institutional investments through focused outreach programmes. Karnataka has been a pioneer in the aerospace sector and was the first Indian state to introduce a dedicated aerospace policy in 2013.

2026-05-06.question: Which organisation announced a $70 billion investment plan by 2035 to develop cross-border power grids and digital infrastructure across Asia and the Pacific?
2026-05-06.explanation: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) announced a $70 billion investment initiative aimed at strengthening cross-border power grids and digital infrastructure across Asia and the Pacific by 2035. The announcement was made during the ADB Annual Meeting held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. The initiative includes the Pan-Asia Power Grid project, which seeks to integrate renewable energy systems and transmission networks, and the Asia-Pacific Digital Highway project, focused on improving broadband access, data infrastructure, and AI readiness. The ADB also established a Centre for AI Innovation and Development in Seoul to promote responsible AI adoption and digital skill training. Founded in 1966, the ADB is headquartered in Metro Manila, Philippines.

2026-05-06.question: What was India’s rank in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index published by Reporters Without Borders (RSF)?
2026-05-06.explanation: India was ranked 157th out of 180 countries in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index published by Reporters Without Borders (RSF). The country received a global score of 31.96 in the annual assessment. The index evaluates press freedom conditions across nations using factors such as political context, legal framework, economic conditions, sociocultural environment, and journalist safety. Published annually since 2002, the index highlights the operational environment for media organisations and journalists worldwide. Norway secured the top position in the 2026 rankings, while Eritrea ranked last. RSF, headquartered in Paris, France, is an international non-profit organisation dedicated to protecting freedom of information and journalists’ rights globally.

2026-05-06.question: Which state was officially declared as India's first paperless judiciary state?
2026-05-06.explanation: Sikkim became India’s first paperless judiciary state after the formal declaration made by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant at a judicial conclave in Gangtok. The initiative completely removed the requirement for physical document submissions across courts in the state. The judiciary system now operates through e-filing platforms, centralised digital case management systems, and electronic archival of court proceedings and evidence. The transition involved extensive server setup and digitisation of historical case records over several years. The initiative supports the broader vision of Viksit Bharat 2047 by promoting technology-driven governance and modernisation of judicial administration. Sikkim, which became the 22nd state of India in 1975, is governed under special provisions of Article 371F.

2026-05-06.question: Which fintech company partnered with NPCI Bharat BillPay Ltd (NBBL) to launch the Banking Connect SDK platform?
2026-05-06.explanation: Juspay partnered with NPCI Bharat BillPay Ltd (NBBL) to launch a new switch and Software Development Kit (SDK) for the Banking Connect platform. The collaboration aims to simplify integration for banks and financial institutions operating within the ETBFSI ecosystem. The platform provides a single integration layer that enables direct transaction routing to a central switch while enhancing security and fraud monitoring systems. It also standardises net banking integration protocols and reduces onboarding time for participating entities. Juspay, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Bengaluru, is a leading Indian fintech company specialising in digital payment processing infrastructure and financial technology solutions.

2026-05-06.question: Which institution organised the first-ever Technology Summit inaugurated by Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan in New Delhi?
2026-05-06.explanation: IIT Madras organised its first-ever Technology Summit at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi under the theme “From IITM. For Bharat. Building Together.” The summit was inaugurated by Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan and focused on showcasing deep technology innovations and research advancements. IIT Madras announced strategic collaborations with NTPC, BPCL, and HSBC to establish dedicated research centres aimed at healthcare technologies and sustainability initiatives. The event also highlighted developments in sovereign AI through the Bodhan AI project, semiconductor ecosystems, robotic surgery, and cardiovascular research. IIT Madras, established in 1959 with assistance from former West Germany, consistently ranks first in the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF).

2026-05-06.question: Who became the youngest and fastest swimmer to cross the Palk Strait from Sri Lanka to India in April 2026?
2026-05-06.explanation: Seven-year-old Ishank Singh from Ranchi, Jharkhand, created a world record by swimming across the 29-km Palk Strait from Sri Lanka to India on April 30, 2026. He completed the challenging open sea route from Talaimannar in Sri Lanka to Dhanushkodi in Tamil Nadu in 9 hours and 50 minutes. The achievement was officially recognised by the Universal Records Forum (URF), which awarded him the title of the Youngest and Fastest Palk Strait Swimmer. During the swim, he received security support from the Sri Lankan Navy and the Indian Coast Guard. His training for the endurance challenge was conducted at Dhurwa Dam in Ranchi under the guidance of coaches Aman Kumar Jaiswal and Bajrang Kumar.

2026-05-06.question: In which city was the Second Employment Working Group (EWG) Meeting under India’s BRICS Presidency 2026 held?
2026-05-06.explanation: The Second Employment Working Group (EWG) Meeting under India’s BRICS Presidency 2026 was held in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, from May 6 to 7, 2026. The meeting brought together representatives from 11 BRICS member countries to discuss labour, employment, and worker welfare issues. Key focus areas included social protection through digital public infrastructure, women’s employment opportunities, digital skilling, labour market formalisation, and welfare support for gig and platform workers. Technical assistance for the discussions was provided by organisations such as the International Labour Organisation (ILO), International Social Security Association (ISSA), and the United Nations Resident Coordinator Office. The meeting also prepared the groundwork for the BRICS Labour and Employment Ministers’ Meeting scheduled for July 2026.

2026-05-06.question: Which country successfully launched the CAS500-2 Earth observation satellite aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket in May 2026?
2026-05-06.explanation: South Korea successfully launched the CAS500-2 Earth observation satellite into orbit on May 3, 2026, using a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket. The satellite was designed and manufactured by Korea Aerospace Industries (KAI) under the supervision of the Korea Aerospace Administration (KASA). The mission marked the launch of South Korea’s first privately built Earth observation satellite after a delay of nearly four years. The 534-kilogram satellite operates in a sun-synchronous orbit and carries high-resolution optical sensors for land management, disaster monitoring, urban planning, and mapping. The project also highlights South Korea’s growing capabilities in indigenous aerospace technology and its ambitions in the global commercial satellite market.

2026-05-06.question: In which city was the three-day North Tech Symposium inaugurated by Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh in May 2026?
2026-05-06.explanation: The North Tech Symposium was inaugurated by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, from May 4 to May 6, 2026. The event was jointly organised by the Northern Command and Central Command of the Indian Army along with the Society of Indian Defence Manufacturers (SIDM). Conducted under the theme “Raksha Triveni Sangam - Where Technology, Industry & Soldiering Converge,” the symposium featured participation from 284 companies, including MSMEs, defence startups, and private technology firms. The primary objective of the event was to identify and integrate indigenous defence technologies, improve maintenance systems, and streamline procurement processes for the Indian armed forces.

2026-05-05.question: Which private India-based company successfully launched the 190 kg Earth observation satellite “Mission Drishti” aboard a Falcon 9 rocket in May 2026?
2026-05-05.explanation: GalaxEye Space, a Bengaluru-based private Earth observation space technology company, successfully launched Mission Drishti aboard SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket on May 3, 2026. The satellite weighs 190 kg and is considered the largest satellite ever built by a private Indian company. It carries the innovative OptoSAR payload, which combines optical imaging and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) into a single platform. This technology allows simultaneous collection of optical and radar data under all weather conditions, both day and night. The satellite is expected to support disaster management, agriculture monitoring, border surveillance, and infrastructure planning with enhanced Earth observation capabilities.

2026-05-05.question: Who were appointed as full-time members of NITI Aayog by the Union Government, increasing its total full-time membership to seven?

options.A: Dr R Balasubramaniam and Dr Joram Aniya
options.B: Ashok Kumar Lahiri and Rajiv Gauba
