Dr R Balasubramaniam is known as a physician, public policy expert, and founder of organisations such as the Swami Vivekananda Youth Movement (SVYM) and GRAAM. Dr Joram Aniya is an academician from Arunachal Pradesh and is recognised as the first woman from the Nyishi community to earn a PhD in the state. NITI Aayog, established in 2015, functions as the premier public policy think tank of the Government of India.

2026-05-05.question: With which country did India conduct the bilateral military exercise CINBAX-II 2026?
2026-05-05.explanation: India conducted the bilateral military exercise CINBAX-II 2026 with Cambodia. The exercise was held from May 4 to May 17, 2026, at the Techo Sen Phnom Thom Mreas Prov Royal Cambodian Air Force Training Centre in Kampong Speu Province. Conducted under Chapter VII of the UN Mandate, the exercise focused on joint company-level operations in a sub-conventional environment. The Indian Army contingent mainly consisted of personnel from the Maratha Light Infantry Regiment, while the Royal Cambodian Army also participated actively. Key operational areas included counter-terrorism drills, drone operations, mortar deployment, sniper tactics, and joint defence coordination in semi-urban warfare scenarios.

2026-05-05.question: Which city emerged as the world's fastest-growing major city through 2035 in Savills' Growth Hubs Index?
2026-05-05.explanation: Bengaluru secured the top position in Savills' Growth Hubs Index as the world’s fastest-growing major city through 2035 among 245 evaluated urban centres. The ranking was determined using indicators such as projected GDP growth, personal wealth expansion, demographic trends, inward migration, and high-income household growth. Bengaluru’s rise has been driven by its strong, skilled workforce and the rapid growth of Global Capability Centres (GCCs). Commonly known as the Silicon Valley of India, the city is also home to the headquarters of ISRO. The report highlighted India’s strong presence in the global rankings, reflecting significant urban economic growth across multiple Indian cities.

2026-05-05.question: Who assumed charge as the Director (Strategic Project) of Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) on May 1, 2026?
2026-05-05.explanation: Retired Commodore Jasvinder Singh assumed charge as the Director (Strategic Project) of Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) on May 1, 2026. Before joining HSL, he served as the Director (Strategic Project) in the Indian Navy. With more than three decades of operational and technical experience, he has worked on naval ships, submarines, DRDO facilities, and tri-service establishments. His educational background includes degrees in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, and Defence and Strategic Studies. At HSL, he is responsible for overseeing strategic initiatives and managing critical submarine projects for the Indian armed forces. HSL, headquartered in Visakhapatnam, is notable for building INS Arihant, India’s first nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine.

2026-05-05.question: Who was appointed as the new Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for a three-year term beginning May 3, 2026?
2026-05-05.explanation: Rohit Jain was appointed as the new Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for a three-year term effective from May 3, 2026. Before this appointment, he served as an Executive Director at the RBI. He succeeded T Rabi Sankar, who retired after completing his extended tenure. Under the RBI Act, 1934, the central bank is required to have exactly four Deputy Governors, ensuring a balanced structure with internal experts and external professionals. The other serving Deputy Governors are Swaminathan J, Poonam Gupta, and S C Murmu. The RBI, established in 1935 and nationalised in 1949, is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

2026-05-05.question: Until which year has the Andhra Pradesh government extended the Ragi Java nutrition programme for government school students?
2026-05-05.explanation: The Andhra Pradesh government extended the Ragi Java nutrition programme for government school students until April 2029 through an agreement signed with the Sri Sathya Sai Central Trust. The programme provides a daily nutritious drink made from ragi flour and jaggery, both supplied free of cost by the trust. It currently benefits more than 30 lakh students studying in nearly 44,000 government schools across the state. The initiative aims to improve children’s health, energy levels, attentiveness in classrooms, and school attendance. The Sri Sathya Sai Central Trust, founded in 1972, has been actively supporting welfare and educational initiatives in Andhra Pradesh.

2026-05-05.question: Which district was officially designated as India's first and only pearl farming cluster in May 2026?
2026-05-05.explanation: Hazaribag in Jharkhand was officially designated as India’s first and only pearl farming cluster on May 3, 2026. The project focuses on developing pearl cultivation through dedicated pond clusters in the Daurwa-Kundwa area and integrating pearl culture around cage culture operations in the Tilaiya reservoir. The initiative aims to empower women by involving self-help groups (SHGs) and establishing an all-women Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) for cultivation and management activities. Supported under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), the project uses modern aquaculture technologies and direct market linkages to strengthen freshwater pearl farming and rural livelihoods in the region.

2026-05-05.question: Which mutual fund company launched the dedicated Specialised Investment Fund (SIF) brand named RedHex SIF in India in May 2026?
2026-05-05.explanation: HSBC Mutual Fund launched RedHex SIF, a dedicated Specialised Investment Fund (SIF) brand in India, on May 4, 2026. The SEBI-approved investment structure is designed for experienced investors, institutional participants, and High Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs). The fund requires a minimum investment of ₹10 lakh and combines the transparency and governance standards of mutual funds with the flexibility of advanced asset management strategies. RedHex SIF focuses on theme-based portfolio construction along with strong risk management practices. HSBC Holdings plc, headquartered in London, operates in 56 countries and territories and is one of the world’s leading banking and financial services organisations.

2026-05-05.question: Who won the 2026 WTA 1000 Madrid Open women’s singles title by defeating Mirra Andreeva in the final?
2026-05-05.explanation: Marta Kostyuk of Ukraine won the 2026 Madrid Open women’s singles title after defeating Russia’s Mirra Andreeva in straight sets, 7-5, 6-3. The victory marked Kostyuk’s third career WTA tournament title and her first-ever WTA 1000-level championship. At 23 years of age, she also became only the second player ranked outside the top 20 to win the Madrid Open women’s singles event. The triumph followed her recent title win at Rouen, making it her second consecutive tournament victory. Kostyuk celebrated the achievement with an acrobatic backflip on the clay court, which gained recognition from legendary gymnast Nadia Comaneci.

2026-05-04.question: In which state was the fourth phase of the PMGSY road projects launched?
2026-05-04.explanation: The fourth phase of the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY-IV) was launched in the Rayagada district, which is located in the state of Odisha. This initiative is part of a broader rural development strategy aimed at improving infrastructure and connectivity in remote and hilly regions. The project includes the construction of hundreds of new roads covering extensive distances to link previously unconnected areas. In addition to road development, financial allocations were made for housing, employment generation, and watershed management. These efforts are aligned with the state’s long-term development vision to enhance rural livelihoods and infrastructure.

2026-05-04.question: When was the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) established?
2026-05-04.explanation: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) was established in 1963 with the objective of professionalising India’s foreign trade management and supporting export-oriented research and policy development. Over the years, it has grown into a premier institution under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, contributing significantly to international business education and research. Its establishment marked an important step in strengthening India’s global trade capabilities during a period when the country was expanding its economic engagement with the world. The institute continues to play a vital role in shaping skilled professionals in international trade and business domains.

2026-05-04.question: What was the percentage drop in snow persistence recorded in the Hindu Kush Himalaya region during the winter season of 2025–2026?
2026-05-04.explanation: The Hindu Kush Himalaya (HKH) region witnessed a significant environmental change with a 27% decline in snow persistence during the winter season of November 2025 to March 2026. This marks the fourth consecutive year of declining snow levels, highlighting a worrying trend linked to climate change. Reduced snow persistence affects water availability as it lowers early summer river flows, which are crucial for agriculture, hydropower, and drinking water supply. The decline also increases dependence on groundwater and raises drought risks in several basins. This situation underscores the urgent need for climate adaptation and sustainable water management strategies.

2026-05-04.question: Which institution developed a new surgical technique to treat severe spinal deformities in India?
2026-05-04.explanation: AIIMS Delhi has pioneered a modified surgical technique to treat severe spinal deformities, marking a significant advancement in medical science. Developed by a specialist team, this method improves upon the traditional posterior vertebral column resection (PVCR) procedure by preserving spinal stability during surgery. The innovation is particularly beneficial for high-risk patients experiencing extreme deformities, breathing issues, and chronic pain. By enhancing surgical safety and reducing neurological complications, the technique has improved patient outcomes and mobility. This breakthrough has also received international recognition, highlighting India’s growing contribution to advanced medical research and surgical innovation.

2026-05-04.question: What percentage of all diseases in India is accounted for by cardiovascular diseases according to the NSO Survey 2025?
2026-05-04.explanation: Cardiovascular diseases have emerged as a major health concern in India, showing a significant increase over recent years. According to the NSO Survey 2025, these diseases now account for 25.6% of all reported illnesses, making them the leading category among various health conditions. This rise reflects changing lifestyles, increased stress levels, and other risk factors such as poor diet and lack of physical activity. Notably, the impact is not limited to older populations, as younger age groups are also increasingly affected. The data highlights the urgent need for improved public health strategies, awareness campaigns, and preventive healthcare measures to address this growing burden.

2026-05-04.question: Which country’s intelligence agency designated Khalistani extremists as a national security threat in May 2026?
2026-05-04.explanation: Canada took a significant step in May 2026 by officially designating Khalistani extremists as a national security threat through its intelligence agency, the Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS). This classification highlights concerns regarding extremist networks operating within the country that allegedly engage in fundraising and support activities for violent agendas. The designation distinguishes between peaceful political advocacy and extremist actions linked to terrorism. This move also comes in the context of strained diplomatic relations with India, emphasising the importance of national security while balancing civil liberties and international relations.

2026-05-04.question: What is the name of the indigenous Integrated Alert System powering the Cell Broadcast Alert System for disaster warnings in India?
2026-05-04.explanation: The Cell Broadcast Alert System, introduced in India for real-time disaster warnings, is powered by an indigenous technology known as SACHET. This system has been developed by the Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT) and plays a crucial role in enhancing disaster preparedness and response. It enables authorities to send immediate alerts to citizens’ mobile phones without requiring any prior subscription or user action. The alerts include loud alarm tones and flashing messages, ensuring high visibility. SACHET supports multiple regional languages and is designed to cover a wide range of emergencies, including natural disasters like earthquakes and tsunamis, as well as man-made threats.

2026-05-04.question: Where was the ‘Run for Sun’ Marathon, organised by MNRE to mark International Sun Day, held?
2026-05-04.explanation: The ‘Run for Sun’ Marathon was organised by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) as part of the celebrations for International Sun Day, emphasising India’s commitment to renewable energy. The event was held in New Delhi, the capital city of India, which frequently serves as the venue for major national initiatives and awareness programs. Conducted at the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, the marathon included 2 km and 5 km races. Hosting the event in New Delhi ensured maximum participation, visibility, and outreach for promoting solar energy and sustainability awareness.

2026-05-04.question: Which state mandated the timely distribution of educational materials through a centralised procurement system for government schools in May 2026?
2026-05-04.explanation: Telangana introduced a significant reform in May 2026 by mandating a centralised procurement system for distributing educational materials in government schools. This initiative aims to ensure timely delivery and maintain uniform quality across all departments, including those serving backward classes, minorities, tribal communities, and scheduled castes. The policy replaces the earlier decentralised system, which had issues related to fund mismanagement and inefficiencies. By centralising procurement, the government seeks to enhance transparency, streamline logistics, and provide students with essential items like uniforms, notebooks, and school supplies efficiently.

2026-05-04.question: What percentage of land animal habitats are projected to be threatened by extreme climate events by 2085?
2026-05-04.explanation: A global study published in May 2026 highlights the severe impact of climate change on biodiversity, projecting that 36% of terrestrial vertebrate habitats will be affected by extreme weather events by 2085. The research covered thousands of species across multiple ecosystems and revealed that rising temperatures, heatwaves, wildfires, droughts, and floods will increasingly overlap, intensifying risks to wildlife. Regions like the Amazon Basin, Africa, and Southeast Asia are particularly vulnerable. Amphibians are expected to face the highest level of exposure. These findings emphasise the urgent need for climate action and biodiversity conservation strategies worldwide.

2026-05-04.question: In which country was an ordinance issued to remove 1,594 political appointees in May 2026?
2026-05-04.explanation: Nepal undertook a major administrative reform in May 2026 when its President issued an ordinance to remove 1,594 political appointees. This move was aimed at restructuring the government under the new leadership following recent elections. The ordinance mandated the termination of all public appointments made before a specified date, ensuring a fresh administrative setup. Alongside this, the government initiated several strong measures, including suspending parliamentary sessions and amending financial laws to strengthen governance. These actions reflect Nepal’s efforts to enhance administrative efficiency, enforce accountability, and support its evolving political landscape after the electoral transition.

2026-05-03.question: Who has been appointed as the brand ambassador for the F1 Programme in India by Mumbai Falcons Racing Limited?
2026-05-03.explanation: Shreyas Iyer has been appointed as the brand ambassador for the F1 Programme in India by Mumbai Falcons Racing Limited. This initiative coincides with the launch of the F1 Sim Racing India Open 2026, aimed at promoting esports talent in the country. Iyer’s selection reflects his strong appeal among youth and his reputation for leadership and performance in cricket. His involvement is expected to help bridge traditional sports with the rapidly growing esports industry. The program also seeks to create structured opportunities for aspiring racers, connecting gaming with professional motorsport and expanding India’s presence in global esports.

2026-05-03.question: On which date is International Dance Day celebrated annually to promote dance as a universal form of expression and cultural unity?
2026-05-03.explanation: International Dance Day is celebrated every year on April 29 to honour the birth anniversary of Jean-Georges Noverre, a pioneer of modern dance. The day highlights the importance of dance as a universal language that transcends cultural and linguistic barriers. It encourages participation from people of all ages and promotes creativity, emotional expression, and cultural exchange. Organised globally with support from institutions like UNESCO, the observance brings together artists, students, and communities through performances, workshops, and events. It also emphasizes the role of dance in improving physical fitness, mental well-being, and fostering global harmony.

2026-05-03.question: Which company has proposed a $11.75 billion all-cash acquisition of Organon & Co., marking one of the largest overseas deals by an Indian firm?
2026-05-03.explanation: Sun Pharma has announced a major international acquisition plan to purchase Organon & Co. for $11.75 billion in an all-cash deal. This move represents one of the largest overseas acquisitions by an Indian company and highlights its strategy to expand globally. The acquisition will significantly strengthen its footprint across multiple countries and enhance its presence in high-growth segments like women’s health and biosimilars. With Organon’s extensive product portfolio and global reach, Sun Pharma aims to become a leading global pharmaceutical player while reducing dependence on traditional generics.

2026-05-03.question: On which date is the World Day for Safety and Health at Work observed annually to promote safe and healthy workplaces?
2026-05-03.explanation: World Day for Safety and Health at Work is observed annually on April 28 to raise awareness about workplace safety and promote healthy working conditions globally. Initiated by the International Labour Organisation (ILO), the day focuses on preventing occupational accidents and diseases while improving overall worker well-being. It also commemorates workers who have suffered injuries or lost their lives due to unsafe work environments. The observance highlights the importance of strong safety standards, mental health awareness, and collaboration among governments, employers, and employees to build safer, more inclusive, and productive workplaces worldwide.

2026-05-03.question: Who has recently assumed charge as the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) in India?
2026-05-03.explanation: Anugraha Narayana Das, a 1991-batch officer of the Indian Defence Accounts Service (IDAS), has taken charge as the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA). With over three decades of experience in defence finance and public administration, he has held several key positions across ministries and defence establishments. His expertise includes auditing, budgeting, procurement policy, and expenditure monitoring. As CGDA, he is responsible for managing defence accounts, ensuring transparency, auditing expenditures, and advising on financial matters. His leadership is expected to strengthen accountability and efficiency in defence spending, which is a crucial component of government expenditure.

2026-05-03.question: What was India’s industrial output growth rate in March 2026, marking the lowest level in five months?
2026-05-03.explanation: India’s industrial output growth, measured by the Index of Industrial Production (IIP), slowed to 4.1% in March 2026, marking a five-month low. This decline reflects weakening momentum in key sectors, particularly manufacturing and electricity, which play a major role in industrial performance. While the mining sector showed improvement, it was not sufficient to offset the slowdown in other areas. The IIP is an important indicator of economic health, as it captures trends in industrial activity, demand, and capacity utilisation. A slowdown suggests cautious demand conditions, possible supply disruptions, and broader economic challenges affecting production levels.

2026-05-03.question: Which company is developing Vikram-1, India’s first privately built orbital rocket aimed at transforming the country’s private space industry?
2026-05-03.explanation: Skyroot Aerospace is the private Indian company behind the development of Vikram-1, marking a significant milestone in India’s space sector. The rocket represents a shift from government-led missions to increased private participation, supported by regulatory bodies like IN-SPACe and technical guidance from ISRO. Vikram-1 is designed for cost-effective and on-demand satellite launches, catering to the growing small satellite market. With advanced features such as 3D-printed engines and lightweight composite structures, the initiative highlights India’s push toward innovation and commercialisation in space technology, positioning Skyroot Aerospace as a pioneering player in this evolving ecosystem.

2026-05-02.question: Who was appointed as the Strategic Defence Advisor by Synergy Quantum to strengthen India's cybersecurity infrastructure?
2026-05-02.explanation: Madhavan Nair, a retired Lieutenant General with extensive experience in military communications and cybersecurity, was appointed as the Strategic Defence Advisor by Synergy Quantum. His expertise lies in areas such as cyber defence, signal intelligence, and post-quantum cryptography. Through this role, he is expected to contribute to strengthening India’s sovereign cybersecurity framework and advancing strategic initiatives related to national security, including proposals for specialised institutions in quantum technology and cybersecurity.

2026-05-02.question: In which city did Google lay the foundation for a ₹1.35 lakh crore Artificial Intelligence hub?
2026-05-02.explanation: Visakhapatnam has been selected as the site for a massive Artificial Intelligence hub backed by a ₹1.35 lakh crore investment. The project involves collaboration between major technology and infrastructure companies and is spread across multiple locations within the district. Designed as a large-scale data centre ecosystem, it will support advanced AI workloads and digital services. The initiative is expected to create thousands of technical jobs and contribute significantly to the region’s economic growth. It also marks a strategic shift in the city’s identity toward becoming a major technology and data hub in India.

2026-05-02.question: Which organisation signed a Licensing Agreement for Transfer of Technology (LAToT) with NSTL for the naval LM2500 Gas Turbine Infrared Suppression System in 2026?
2026-05-02.explanation: BHEL entered into a significant agreement with the Naval Science & Technological Laboratory for the transfer of technology related to the LM2500 Gas Turbine Infrared Suppression System. This system is crucial for reducing infrared signatures of naval vessels, thereby enhancing stealth and survivability in maritime operations. The agreement includes fabrication, installation, and commissioning of the system for deployment on Indian Navy ships. Developed indigenously under DRDO, this collaboration aligns with the Make in India initiative, promoting self-reliance in advanced defence technologies and strengthening India’s naval capabilities.

2026-05-02.question: Which region is set to be connected with the mainland under India’s first dedicated commercial seaplane service, approved in 2026?
2026-05-02.explanation: Lakshadweep is the region targeted for connectivity under India’s first commercial seaplane service, launched by SkyHop Aviation after receiving approval from the DGCA. Using a modified Twin Otter aircraft, this initiative marks a milestone in domestic aviation innovation. It is further supported by government schemes like UDAN and Viability Gap Funding, ensuring affordability and sustainability. This development is expected to boost tourism, enhance local connectivity, and strengthen regional infrastructure in island territories.

2026-05-02.question: Who was appointed as the Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in May 2026?
2026-05-02.explanation: Rohit Jain was appointed as the Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, bringing nearly 30 years of experience in banking supervision, financial regulation, and risk management. His appointment reflects the government’s focus on strengthening the central bank’s leadership with experienced professionals. With strong academic qualifications and professional certifications, he is expected to play a key role in addressing emerging financial challenges and maintaining stability in India’s banking and regulatory systems.

2026-05-02.question: Who has been appointed as the Secretary of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) in 2026?
2026-05-02.explanation: Bharat Khera, a 1995-batch IAS officer from the Himachal Pradesh cadre, has been appointed as the Secretary of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. He brings over three decades of administrative experience across both central and state governments. His career includes key roles in the Ministry of Defence, Cabinet Secretariat, and Department of Consumer Affairs. With expertise in policy implementation and governance, he is expected to strengthen the MSME sector, which contributes significantly to India’s GDP. His leadership aims to enhance growth, innovation, and efficiency within this crucial segment of the economy.

2026-04-27.question: Which disease is Coartem Baby specifically developed to treat in newborns and infants?
2026-04-27.explanation: Malaria is the disease targeted by Coartem Baby, the first WHO-prequalified drug specifically designed for newborns and infants. Developed by Novartis in collaboration with the Medicines for Malaria Venture (MMV), this medication addresses a critical gap in pediatric treatment. It uses an artemether-lumefantrine combination and is suitable for infants weighing between 2 to 5 kilograms. The disease remains a major global health concern, causing millions of cases and deaths annually, especially among children under five in Africa, making this innovation a significant breakthrough.

2026-04-27.question: Which state approved the ₹500 crore Compressed Biogas (CBG) Policy 2026 to convert organic waste into clean fuel?
2026-04-27.explanation: Maharashtra approved the ₹500 crore Compressed Biogas (CBG) Policy 2026 aimed at converting organic waste into clean fuel and energy. The policy includes financial support through viability gap funding and promotes execution via Public-Private Partnership (PPP) and Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM). It targets municipal solid waste from numerous urban local bodies and agricultural residues like Napier grass, particularly in Marathwada. Additionally, the policy is aligned with the GOBARdhan scheme, ensuring efficient utilisation of organic byproducts as manure, thereby enhancing sustainability and waste-to-energy conversion.

2026-04-27.question: Which country’s commission added the names of 33,000 missing Indian soldiers from World War I to a digital memorial in 2026?
2026-04-27.explanation: In the United Kingdom, the Commonwealth War Graves Commission (CWGC), headquartered there, undertook the initiative to add 33,000 missing Indian soldiers to a digital memorial. These soldiers had previously been excluded from proper recognition and were only commemorated numerically. The update is linked to the Basra Memorial in Iraq and relates to casualties from the Mesopotamia Campaign during World War I. This effort corrects historical inequalities by individually naming the soldiers and integrating them into the broader record of over 46,000 Commonwealth personnel remembered for their service.

2026-04-27.question: Which city’s municipal corporation won the 4th Gender Equality Mobilisation (GEM) Award from UNIDO in 2026?
2026-04-27.explanation: Guntur is the city whose municipal corporation received the 4th Gender Equality Mobilisation (GEM) Award from the United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO) in Vienna. The recognition was given for its innovative approach to gender inclusion and sustainable waste management. The corporation deployed over 200 women as electric auto drivers for garbage collection, helping integrate informal workers into the formal economy. This initiative, implemented under the Sustainable Cities Integrated Approach Pilot (SCIAP), highlights the city’s commitment to environmental sustainability, women's empowerment, and efficient urban governance practices.

2026-04-27.question: Who was appointed as the Whole-Time Director of AU Small Finance Bank on April 27, 2026?
2026-04-27.explanation: Vivek Tripathi was appointed as the Whole-Time Director of AU Small Finance Bank, marking an important addition to the bank’s leadership structure. As a Whole-Time Director, he becomes part of the full-time executive management, contributing to strategic and operational decisions. Such appointments in banking institutions require regulatory oversight and alignment with provisions under the Companies Act, 2013. AU Small Finance Bank, headquartered in Jaipur, has evolved from a Non-Banking Financial Company into a Scheduled Commercial Bank, and leadership appointments like this play a key role in guiding its growth and governance.

2026-04-27.question: Who was appointed as the interim Chief Executive Officer of Noida International Airport in April 2026?
2026-04-27.explanation: Nitu Samra was appointed as the interim Chief Executive Officer of Noida International Airport following regulatory requirements set by the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS). She has served as the Chief Financial Officer since October 2021, bringing financial and administrative experience to the role. The appointment aligns with BCAS norms mandating that the CEO of an Indian airport must be an Indian national. This leadership change is part of the broader development of the airport, which is being built under a Public-Private Partnership and is expected to significantly expand passenger handling capacity in the coming years.

2026-04-27.question: Who was appointed as the Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog on April 25, 2026?
2026-04-27.explanation: Ashok Kumar Lahiri was appointed as the Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog, the premier policy think tank of the Government of India. He succeeded Suman K. Bery and took charge following the reconstitution of the institution. Lahiri, a noted economist, brings extensive experience in economic policy and governance. His appointment is part of a broader restructuring that also introduced new full-time members to the Aayog. NITI Aayog plays a crucial role in shaping India’s development agenda through cooperative federalism and strategic policy planning, making this leadership change significant for governance and policymaking.

2026-04-27.question: Who received a three-year extension as Managing Directors and CEOs of Bank of India and Bank of Baroda, respectively in April 2026?

options.C: Suman K. Bery And Abhay Karandikar
options.D: K. V. Raju And Gobardhan Das

2026-04-27.explanation: Rajneesh Karnatak and Debadatta Chand were granted three-year extensions as Managing Directors and CEOs of Bank of India and Bank of Baroda, respectively, by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet. These extensions ensure leadership continuity in two major public sector banks. The approvals were based on proposals from the Department of Financial Services under the Ministry of Finance. Such extensions reflect the government’s confidence in its leadership and performance. Stable executive leadership is crucial for maintaining operational efficiency, implementing reforms, and strengthening the banking sector in a competitive financial environment.

2026-04-26.question: Who has been appointed as the Chairperson of Nasscom in April 2026?
2026-04-26.explanation: Srikanth Velamakanni, Co-Founder and Group CEO of Fractal, has been appointed as the Chairperson of Nasscom. He succeeds Sindhu Gangadharan and brings extensive experience from his prior role as Vice Chairperson and Executive Council member for over six years. Under his leadership, Nasscom is expected to focus on advancing enterprise AI, agentic AI, and autonomous multi-agent systems. His appointment reflects the growing importance of artificial intelligence in India’s technology sector. Along with Vice Chairperson Kishor Patil and President Rajesh Nambiar, he will help shape the strategic direction of the IT industry.

2026-04-26.question: Who was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Reliance Enterprise Intelligence Limited in April 2026?
2026-04-26.explanation: Parminder Singh has been appointed as the CEO of Reliance Enterprise Intelligence Limited, a joint venture focused on advancing enterprise artificial intelligence in India. The company combines Reliance’s infrastructure and connectivity with Meta’s AI capabilities to drive digital transformation. Parminder Singh brings extensive global experience, having held leadership roles at major technology companies such as Google, Apple, Twitter, and IBM. He has also served as Chief Commercial and Digital Officer at Mediacorp and co-founded AI-focused initiatives like ClayboxAI and WeKamp, making him well-equipped to lead REIL’s AI-driven strategy.

2026-04-26.question: Who became the first Indian cricketer to score multiple IPL centuries in under 50 balls?
2026-04-26.explanation: Abhishek Sharma achieved a historic milestone in the IPL by becoming the first Indian cricketer to score multiple centuries in under 50 balls. His remarkable 135-run unbeaten innings against the Delhi Capitals came off just 47 balls, showcasing exceptional batting prowess. He had earlier scored a 40-ball century in IPL 2025, reinforcing his consistency in high-impact performances. His innings included 10 fours and 10 sixes, maintaining a strike rate above 200. This achievement places him among the elite T20 players globally and highlights his growing stature in Indian cricket as a dynamic and aggressive opener.

2026-04-26.question: Which country’s parliament passed the Tobacco and Vapes Bill banning tobacco sales to individuals born on or after January 1, 2009?
2026-04-26.explanation: The UK Parliament passed the Tobacco and Vapes Bill as part of a long-term public health strategy to create a smoke-free generation. The law introduces a generational ban, ensuring that individuals born on or after January 1, 2009, will never be legally allowed to purchase tobacco products. It also tightens regulations on vaping, including restrictions on advertising, flavours, and usage in public places. The policy aims to reduce smoking-related diseases, ease the burden on the National Health Service, and improve overall life expectancy by prioritising prevention over treatment.

2026-04-26.question: On which date is National Panchayati Raj Day observed annually in India?
2026-04-26.explanation: National Panchayati Raj Day is observed every year on April 24 to mark the constitutional recognition of Panchayati Raj institutions in India through the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992. This reform established a structured three-tier system of local governance, empowering rural communities and promoting decentralisation. The day highlights the importance of grassroots democracy, ensuring the participation of local populations in decision-making. It also emphasises inclusivity through reservations for women and marginalised groups. Celebrations include recognising best-performing Panchayats and promoting initiatives that strengthen transparency, accountability, and sustainable rural development.

2026-04-26.question: Who has been appointed as the Director (Finance) of Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) in April 2026?
2026-04-26.explanation: Rajesh Kumar Agarwal has been appointed as the Director (Finance) of Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) with effect from April 23, 2026. He previously served as Executive Director (Finance) at PFC and brings over 31 years of experience in the power and finance sectors. His professional journey includes roles in major organisations such as NTPC Limited, Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited, and Delhi Transco Limited. Since joining PFC in 2009, he has handled critical areas like corporate accounts, taxation, and fund management, making him well-suited for this leadership role.

2026-04-26.question: On which date is World Malaria Day observed annually across the world?
2026-04-26.explanation: World Malaria Day is observed every year on April 25 to raise global awareness about malaria and promote coordinated efforts to combat the disease. Established by the World Health Organisation, the day emphasises prevention, early diagnosis, and effective treatment strategies. It also highlights advancements such as vaccines and improved healthcare systems while addressing ongoing challenges like transmission in vulnerable regions. Governments, NGOs, and communities participate through awareness campaigns, free testing, and distribution of preventive tools like mosquito nets. The observance reinforces the importance of sustained global cooperation to achieve the goal of malaria elimination.

2026-04-26.question: Which fintech company became the first private-sector entity to secure direct membership in the RBI’s Centralised Payment System (CPS)?
2026-04-26.explanation: Pay Point India Network achieved a significant milestone by becoming the first private-sector fintech to gain direct access to the RBI’s Centralised Payment System. This allows it to operate independently within RTGS and NEFT networks without depending on partner banks. The development marks a shift from the earlier system, where only banks and select institutions could participate. With direct membership, Pay Point benefits from reduced transaction costs, faster settlements, and enhanced data security. This move also reflects the RBI’s evolving approach to integrating fintech players into core financial infrastructure.

2026-04-26.question: In which state was India’s first integrated lithium-ion battery and rare earth recycling facility established by Rocklink India in April 2026?
2026-04-26.explanation: Rocklink India established the country’s first integrated lithium-ion battery and rare earth recycling facility in Sikandrabad, located in Uttar Pradesh. The plant is equipped to recycle 10,000 tonnes of lithium-ion batteries annually and process rare-earth materials efficiently. Using advanced in-house R2 technology, it achieves a recovery rate exceeding 98% for key metals. The facility supports sustainable waste management and strengthens India’s electric mobility ecosystem. It also follows Extended Producer Responsibility norms, ensuring environmentally responsible recycling practices and contributing to the development of a circular supply chain in the country.

2026-04-26.question: Where did Eveready Industries commission India’s first alkaline battery manufacturing facility in April 2026?
2026-04-26.explanation: Eveready Industries established India’s first alkaline battery manufacturing facility in Jammu as part of its strategy to reduce dependence on imported finished goods. The greenfield plant, built with an investment of around ₹200 crore, has a production capacity of about 360 million batteries annually. This move strengthens domestic manufacturing and positions the company as the sole producer of finished alkaline batteries in India. It also helps improve profit margins and market share while supporting the rapidly growing alkaline battery segment, which is expanding much faster than traditional carbon-zinc batteries in the country.

2026-04-26.question: Which bank partnered with Kiwi to launch the credit-on-UPI card for digital payments in April 2026?
2026-04-26.explanation: Punjab National Bank collaborated with fintech platform Kiwi to introduce a credit-on-UPI card, marking an important development in digital payments. The card operates on the RuPay network and is designed to extend formal credit access to the bank’s vast customer base. It offers benefits such as zero joining and annual fees, cashback on transactions, and seamless digital onboarding with UPI integration. This initiative also represents Kiwi’s first partnership with a public sector bank, highlighting a growing trend of collaboration between traditional banks and fintech firms to expand digital financial services in India.

2026-04-25.question: Who was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Andhra Pradesh High Court effective from April 25, 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: Lisa Gill was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Andhra Pradesh High Court by the President of India, Droupadi Murmu, with effect from April 25, 2026. The appointment was made under constitutional provisions and after consultation with the Chief Justice of India. She succeeded Justice Dhiraj Singh Thakur, who retired a day earlier. Prior to this elevation, Lisa Gill served as a puisne judge in the same High Court, gaining judicial experience within the institution. Her appointment reflects the established procedure under Article 217, ensuring continuity and leadership in the judiciary at the state level.

2026-04-25.question: At which institution were the indigenously developed Silicon Photonics Technology Solutions launched by MeitY on April 24, 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) launched Silicon Photonics Technology Solutions at IIT Madras on April 24, 2026. These solutions were developed at the Centre of Excellence for Programmable Photonic Integrated Circuits and Systems within the institute. The launch included advanced tools like the Process Design Kit and Universal PPIC Test Engine, aimed at enhancing photonics chip design and testing capabilities. The initiative reflects India’s growing focus on semiconductor and photonics innovation, supported by collaborations with international and domestic partners, and aligns with the broader objectives of the India Semiconductor Mission.

2026-04-25.question: Which company signed an agreement with SMS Group to deploy the world’s first EASyMelt decarbonisation technology at its Jamshedpur Works?
2026-04-25.explanation: Tata Steel entered into a definitive agreement with SMS Group (through Paul Wurth S.A.) to implement the innovative EASyMelt technology at its Jamshedpur plant. This project represents the first industrial-scale deployment of this electrically-assisted syngas smelter technology, designed to significantly reduce carbon emissions in ironmaking. The initiative is expected to cut CO2 emissions by over 50% compared to conventional blast furnace operations. It also aligns with Tata Steel’s long-term sustainability goal of achieving net-zero emissions by 2045, marking a major advancement in green steel production and environmentally responsible industrial practices.

2026-04-25.question: Which country received a ₹30 billion currency withdrawal from India under the SAARC Currency Swap Framework on April 25, 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: India approved a ₹30 billion currency swap facility to the Maldives under the SAARC Currency Swap Framework for 2024–2027. This financial support, provided through the INR Swap Window, aims to help the Maldives manage its balance-of-payment pressures and maintain economic stability. The arrangement is implemented between the Reserve Bank of India and the Maldives Monetary Authority. It also reflects India’s ‘Neighbourhood First’ policy and Vision MAHASAGAR, emphasising regional cooperation. Over the years, India has extended significant financial assistance to the Maldives, including previous swap facilities, reinforcing strong bilateral economic and strategic ties.

2026-04-25.question: Who was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Dabur India’s India business in April 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: Herjit S Bhalla was appointed as the CEO of Dabur India’s India business in April 2026, marking a significant leadership development in one of India’s leading FMCG companies. In this role, he reports directly to Global CEO Mohit Malhotra and is responsible for driving growth across domestic operations. The company anticipates improved financial performance, supported by rising demand in key segments such as home and personal care. Bhalla’s appointment comes at a time when Dabur is focusing on strengthening its market presence, enhancing product categories, and navigating global challenges affecting supply chains and international markets.

2026-04-25.question: Which Indian Navy sail training ship arrived at Las Palmas in Spain on April 23, 2026, marking the first-ever visit to the Canary Islands?
2026-04-25.explanation: INS Sudarshini, a sail training ship of the Indian Navy, reached Las Palmas in Spain on April 23, 2026, marking a historic first visit to the Canary Islands by an Indian naval vessel. The voyage is part of the transoceanic deployment mission Lokayan 26, aimed at strengthening maritime cooperation and global presence. The ship began its journey from Kochi and has visited multiple international ports, promoting India’s cultural and diplomatic outreach under the theme Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam. It is also scheduled to participate in Sail 250 events in the United States, commemorating 250 years of American independence.

2026-04-25.question: Project DANTAK of the Border Roads Organisation celebrated its 66th Raising Day in which country on April 24, 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: Project DANTAK, a key initiative of the Border Roads Organisation (BRO), marked its 66th Raising Day in Bhutan on April 24, 2026. Since its establishment in 1961, the project has played a vital role in developing infrastructure in Bhutan, including constructing over 1,500 km of roads and major highways like the East–West Highway. It has also contributed to building critical aviation infrastructure such as Paro International Airport. The project continues to enhance connectivity through road modernization and strategic construction, strengthening bilateral ties between India and Bhutan while supporting regional development and security.

2026-04-25.question: Which country overtook India as the largest supplier of corn to Bangladesh in April 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: Brazil emerged as the leading exporter of corn to Bangladesh in April 2026, surpassing India due to shifting global trade dynamics and rising domestic ethanol demand in India. Brazil secured a dominant 78% share of Bangladesh’s corn imports for the 2025–26 marketing year. Meanwhile, India’s exports declined significantly over recent years due to increased domestic consumption and higher grain prices. The surge in Bangladesh’s imports, driven by growing demand from poultry, dairy, and aquaculture sectors, further strengthened Brazil’s position. This transition also facilitated the re-entry of US corn into Bangladesh’s market after several years.

2026-04-25.question: Which country passed legislation banning social media usage for children under 15 years and mandating strict age verification by digital platforms in April 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: Turkey introduced a significant legal reform in April 2026 by banning social media access for children below 15 years of age. The legislation amends existing social services laws to impose strict age-based restrictions on digital platform usage. It requires companies to implement robust age verification systems and appoint local representatives for compliance. The regulation also extends to gaming platforms, mandating age classification for video games. This move reflects growing global concerns about online safety for minors, digital well-being, and responsible platform governance in an increasingly connected technological environment.

2026-04-25.question: Which bank signed a strategic agreement with Pine Labs on April 21, 2026, to deploy advanced Point-of-Sale (PoS) infrastructure and enhance digital payment facilities?
2026-04-25.explanation: Karnataka Bank entered into a strategic partnership with Pine Labs on April 21, 2026, to strengthen its digital payment ecosystem. The agreement focuses on deploying advanced PoS infrastructure across all its branches nationwide, improving accessibility and efficiency for retail and MSME customers. This initiative aligns with the bank’s vision of becoming a ‘Digital Bank of the Future.’ By integrating advanced payment technologies and responding to merchant needs, the collaboration ensures faster, reliable, and user-friendly transactions, enhancing overall service delivery in the modern financial ecosystem.

2026-04-25.question: Which country successfully conducted a flight test of the indigenously developed Taimoor air-launched cruise missile on April 21, 2026?
2026-04-25.explanation: Pakistan successfully carried out a flight test of the Taimoor, an indigenously developed air-launched anti-ship cruise missile, on April 21, 2026. The test was conducted by the Pakistan Navy, showcasing its operational capabilities in maritime defence. The missile is designed to detect, track, and neutralise sea-based threats with precision at extended ranges. It strengthens the country’s conventional strike capability and reflects advancements in domestic defence technology. This successful test highlights Pakistan’s focus on enhancing naval preparedness and maintaining a coordinated, multi-dimensional defence strategy in regional waters.

2026-04-24.question: Which country identified the 11th known lunar mineral, Cerium-Magnesium Changesite, in April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: China identified a new lunar mineral named Cerium-Magnesium Changesite on April 23, 2026, marking the 11th known mineral discovered from the Moon. This mineral was found within a lunar meteorite that had fallen within China’s borders, making it a significant scientific achievement. The mineral exhibits unique fluorescent properties and contains specific ratios of rare earth elements, magnesium, and iron. Its discovery holds potential for applications in advanced technologies such as next-generation LED materials and energy-efficient electronics. This breakthrough also highlights China’s growing capabilities in space exploration and extraterrestrial geological research.

2026-04-24.question: Who inaugurated the Robotic Orthopaedic System and Maternity Operation Theatre at the Cantonment General Hospital in April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: Rajesh Kumar Singh, serving as the Defence Secretary, inaugurated advanced medical facilities at the Cantonment General Hospital in Delhi Cantt on April 23, 2026. These facilities included a Robotic Orthopaedic System designed to enhance surgical precision and reduce recovery time, along with a dedicated Maternity Operation Theatre for improved maternal care. The initiative reflects the Ministry of Defence’s commitment to strengthening healthcare infrastructure for defence personnel and civilians. Additional planned upgrades, such as dialysis centres, ICU enhancements, and advanced diagnostic tools, further highlight a comprehensive approach toward modernising medical services.

2026-04-24.question: Which company launched the Diversified Equity Fund II as a New Fund Offer in April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: Axis Max Life Insurance Limited introduced the Diversified Equity Fund II on April 23, 2026, as a New Fund Offer aimed at long-term wealth creation. The fund is designed with a multi-cap investment strategy, ensuring diversification across sectors and market capitalisations. It maintains a minimum of 80% exposure to equities for growth while allocating the remaining portion to debt instruments for stability. The fund is benchmarked against the NSE Nifty 200 Index and is offered through select ULIPs. Its launch reflects the company’s focus on providing balanced investment opportunities with strong return potential over time.

2026-04-24.question: Who concluded the official economic delegation visit to the Czech Republic on 22–23 April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: Jitin Prasada, Union Minister of State for Commerce & Industry, led and concluded the official economic delegation visit to the Czech Republic during April 22–23, 2026. During this visit, he co-chaired the 13th session of the India–Czech Republic Joint Commission for Economic Cooperation and engaged in multiple high-level meetings with Czech officials. He also inaugurated the India–Czech Business Forum and explored opportunities in sectors like automotive manufacturing, artificial intelligence, robotics, and advanced laser science. His visit aimed at strengthening bilateral trade, investment ties, and technological collaboration between India and the Czech Republic.

2026-04-24.question: Which institution launched India’s first fully integrated agricultural intelligence system via the ANNAM.AI platform in April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: IIT Ropar introduced India’s first comprehensive agricultural intelligence system through the ANNAM.AI platform, marking a significant advancement in smart farming. The system integrates multiple digital layers, including infrastructure for weather data collection, AI-driven analytics for crop and pest monitoring, and a multilingual advisory interface for farmers. It aims to enhance productivity by reducing water usage and minimizing crop losses due to unpredictable weather. Supported by a national AI initiative, the project reflects the growing role of artificial intelligence in agriculture and demonstrates scalability for broader implementation across rural India.

2026-04-24.question: Which country finalised the world’s first deep geological repository to permanently store highly radioactive nuclear waste in April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: Finland became the first country to operationalise a deep geological repository for the permanent disposal of highly radioactive nuclear waste. Located on Olkiluoto island, the facility is constructed 400–450 metres underground in ancient bedrock and is designed to safely contain nuclear waste for up to 100,000 years. The repository uses a multi-layered safety system including metal canisters, copper capsules, and bentonite clay to prevent leakage and environmental contamination. This approach relies on passive safety mechanisms, eliminating the need for continuous human monitoring, and sets a global benchmark for long-term nuclear waste management solutions.

2026-04-24.question: Which organisation introduced the Performance Incentive relaxation and Cash Discount scheme for power sector consumers in April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: Bharat Coking Coal Limited (BCCL), a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, introduced a Performance Incentive (PI) relaxation and Cash Discount scheme specifically for power sector consumers for the first quarter of FY 2026–27. The scheme was designed to encourage higher coal offtake by offering financial incentives based on different slabs of coal lifting. It applies to consumers under Fuel Supply Agreements and includes provisions for both raw coal and washed power coal. By implementing this scheme, BCCL aims to optimize coal distribution efficiency and support power generation needs in India.

2026-04-24.question: In which city was the Global Symposium on Credit Guarantees organised by CGTMSE on April 23, 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: The Global Symposium on Credit Guarantees, organised by the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE), was held in Mumbai on April 23, 2026. The event coincided with the 38th Annual Conference of ACSIC and marked the Silver Jubilee of CGTMSE. It brought together international delegates and experts to discuss key issues such as financial inclusion, risk management, and cross-border cooperation. Mumbai, being a major financial hub of India and the headquarters of CGTMSE, served as an ideal venue for hosting such a significant global event focused on strengthening the credit ecosystem.

2026-04-24.question: Which institution partnered with FedEx to successfully conduct India’s first intra-city drone delivery flight trials in Bengaluru in April 2026?
2026-04-24.explanation: IIT Madras collaborated with Federal Express Corporation (FedEx) to carry out India’s first intra-city drone delivery trials in Bengaluru. The project was implemented under the FedEx SMART Centre in partnership with the start-up Amber Wings. The drone successfully covered a distance of around 39–42 km in just 21 minutes, significantly reducing delivery time compared to road transport. The trials included advanced safety features such as autonomous flight termination and anti-collision systems. This initiative demonstrates the growing potential of drone-based logistics in urban environments and highlights India’s progress in adopting cutting-edge transportation technologies.

2026-04-24.question: The 11th Joint Defence Committee (JDC) meeting held from April 20 to 22, 2026, in Cairo was conducted between India and which country?
2026-04-24.explanation: The 11th Joint Defence Committee meeting between India and Egypt took place in Cairo from April 20 to 22, 2026, marking an important step in strengthening bilateral defence cooperation. The discussions focused on enhancing military training exchanges, maritime security, and joint defence production initiatives. Both countries also emphasised expanding structured military interactions and increasing the scale of joint exercises. Egypt plays a strategic role due to its control of the Suez Canal, a vital global trade route. The meeting further reinforced the growing strategic partnership established between India and Egypt in recent years.

2026-04-23.question: Who launched the official portal and brochure for the 9th India International Water Week (IIWW-2026)?
2026-04-23.explanation: The official portal and brochure for the 9th India International Water Week (IIWW-2026) were launched by Union Minister of Jal Shakti C. R. Patil. This event is India’s flagship global platform focused on water management and sustainability. Scheduled to be held in September 2026 in New Delhi, it emphasizes the theme of climate-resilient water management. The initiative aims to bring together international participants, policymakers, and experts to discuss pressing water challenges. It also aligns with national efforts such as Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari, which focuses on creating large-scale water conservation infrastructure across the country.

2026-04-23.question: Which state approved the establishment of accommodation facilities for patients' relatives in medical colleges along with a ₹5,479 crore healthcare allocation in April 2026?
2026-04-23.explanation: The state government that approved accommodation facilities for patients’ relatives in medical colleges, along with a substantial healthcare budget allocation of ₹5,479 crore, is Madhya Pradesh. This initiative aims to improve support systems for patients’ families without a direct financial burden on the state, as philanthropic organisations will manage the facilities. Additionally, the funding supports major healthcare infrastructure upgrades, including the CM CARE 2025 scheme and improvements in medical colleges. The plan emphasizes strengthening tertiary healthcare services such as oncology and cardiology, while also enhancing administrative and developmental programs within the state.

2026-04-23.question: Which stock exchange’s index services division launched the Housing Finance Index in April 2026?
2026-04-23.explanation: The Housing Finance Index was introduced by the index services arm of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) to track the performance of companies in India’s housing finance sector. Derived from the broader BSE 1000 Index, it includes 11 key housing finance firms with varying weightages. The index serves as an important benchmark for financial products like ETFs, mutual funds, and portfolio management services. With a base value of 1,000 and a base date of June 22, 2015, it is rebalanced semi-annually. This initiative enhances market transparency and provides investors with a focused sectoral performance indicator.

2026-04-23.question: Who has been reappointed as the Managing Director and CEO of HDFC Life for another five-year term?
2026-04-23.explanation: HDFC Life approved the reappointment of Vibha Padalkar as its Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer for another five-year term during a board meeting held on April 21, 2026. Her continuation ensures leadership stability and strategic consistency during a dynamic phase in the insurance sector. She has been associated with the company since 2008 and has significantly contributed to its growth, including overseeing its public listing in 2017 and major business expansions. Her leadership emphasises financial discipline, operational efficiency, and sustainable long-term growth, making her a key figure in India’s life insurance industry.

2026-04-23.question: Which city hosted the Bihar Diwas & Investment Forum 2026?
2026-04-23.explanation: The Bihar Diwas & Investment Forum 2026 was hosted in Jakarta, the capital city of Indonesia. The event took place at the Wayang Auditorium within the Embassy of India and marked the official launch of the Indonesia chapter of Yayasan Bihar Samaj Indonesia (BSI). It aimed to promote investment opportunities in Bihar across sectors such as agriculture, food processing, tourism, and education. The forum also showcased Bihar’s rich cultural heritage through traditional performances like the Jhijhiya dance, strengthening diaspora engagement and international collaboration.

2026-04-23.question: Who has been appointed as India’s High Commissioner to Bangladesh as part of a recent diplomatic move?
2026-04-23.explanation: India appointed Dinesh Trivedi, a seasoned politician and former Union Minister, as its High Commissioner to Bangladesh. This appointment marks a notable shift in diplomatic practice, as such positions are typically held by Indian Foreign Service officers. He succeeds Pranay Verma, who has been reassigned as Ambassador to the European Union. Trivedi’s prior experience includes serving as the Railway Minister and Minister of State for Health. His appointment comes at a time when India aims to strengthen and stabilise diplomatic relations with Bangladesh, especially under its new political leadership, highlighting the importance of strategic regional engagement.

2026-04-23.question: Which organisation completed the development of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope in April 2026?
2026-04-23.explanation: The development of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope was completed by NASA in April 2026, marking a significant milestone in space exploration. This advanced observatory is designed to study dark matter, dark energy, and the large-scale structure of the universe. It also has the capability to directly image exoplanets orbiting nearby stars. Completed ahead of schedule and under budget, the telescope reflects NASA’s continued leadership in astrophysics research. Named after Nancy Grace Roman, a pioneer in space astronomy, the mission is expected to greatly enhance understanding of cosmic evolution and the universe’s hidden components.

2026-04-23.question: In which district was the statue of war hero Lt Gen Sagat Singh Rathore unveiled on April 23, 2026?
2026-04-23.explanation: The statue of Lt Gen Sagat Singh Rathore, a distinguished war hero, was unveiled in the district of Churu, Rajasthan, during the ‘Shaurya Ke Saath Sankalp Divas’ programme. The event was led by the Chief Minister of Rajasthan and aimed to honour the contributions of the military leader. In addition to unveiling the statue, the state government also renamed the local stadium in his honour. This initiative reflects the government’s efforts to recognise the sacrifices and achievements of armed forces personnel while promoting patriotism and awareness among citizens.

2026-04-23.question: Which bank is a key partner in the insurance company that launched the RISE Life Insurance Plan?
2026-04-23.explanation: PNB MetLife India Insurance Company Limited is a joint venture that includes Punjab National Bank as a key partner along with MetLife International Holdings LLC and other investors. Established in 2001, the company leverages the strong domestic presence of Punjab National Bank and the global insurance expertise of MetLife. The launch of the RISE Life Insurance Plan highlights its focus on providing reliable financial products with life coverage and guaranteed returns. The plan offers flexible premium payment options, maturity benefits, and additional riders, catering to diverse customer needs in savings and protection.

2026-04-23.question: In which Indian state will the green ammonia production facility be located under the L&T Energy and ITOCHU partnership?
2026-04-23.explanation: The green ammonia production facility under the partnership between L&T Energy GreenTech Ltd and Japan’s ITOCHU Corporation is planned to be established in Gujarat, specifically at Kandla. This project is significant as it supports the production of green fuel aimed at reducing carbon emissions in the maritime shipping sector. The facility will supply 300,000 tonnes of green ammonia annually, primarily for use in green bunkering operations in Singapore. It also aligns with India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission, which focuses on developing sustainable energy solutions and positioning India as a global hub for green fuel exports.

2026-04-22.question: In which city is the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER) located, which signed a grant agreement with Novartis in April 2026?
2026-04-22.explanation: The National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER) involved in the grant agreement with Novartis, is located in Mohali, Punjab. Established in 1991, it is the first national-level institute in pharmaceutical sciences in India and was later designated as an Institute of National Importance in 1998. The institute plays a significant role in advancing pharmaceutical research and education. The collaboration with Novartis under the Development Pioneer Grant aims to support innovative research aligned with industry needs, strengthening the link between academic research and practical healthcare solutions.

2026-04-22.question: Which organisation released a report in April 2026 ranking India among the world’s most advanced markets for AI usage?
2026-04-22.explanation: The report highlighting India's position as a leading user of artificial intelligence technologies was released in April 2026 by OpenAI. This organization analyzed usage patterns such as coding, reasoning, and data analysis through its AI tools. India ranked among the top five countries globally in reasoning capability usage per person, reflecting strong adoption. The report also noted rapid growth in the use of AI coding tools like Codex and significant concentration of users in major cities. These findings demonstrate how AI is becoming deeply integrated into various sectors across India.

2026-04-22.question: On which date is Earth Day observed globally every year?
2026-04-22.explanation: Earth Day is observed annually on April 22 and serves as a global platform to promote environmental awareness and action. The day emphasises critical issues such as climate change, pollution, deforestation, and biodiversity loss. First celebrated in 1970, it marked a turning point in environmental activism, bringing these concerns into mainstream discourse. Over the years, it has grown into a worldwide movement involving governments, organisations, and individuals. The observance encourages sustainable practices, community participation, and policy initiatives aimed at protecting the planet and ensuring a healthier environment for future generations.

2026-04-22.question: Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary, declared as India’s 99th Ramsar site in April 2026, is located in which state?
2026-04-22.explanation: Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary, located in Aligarh, has been recognised as India’s 99th Ramsar site, highlighting its ecological significance. This designation strengthens wetland conservation efforts and underscores the importance of preserving biodiversity. With this addition, Uttar Pradesh now has a total of 12 Ramsar sites, making it a leading state in wetland conservation. Ramsar sites are wetlands of international importance, providing habitats for migratory birds and supporting ecological balance. The inclusion of Shekha Jheel also contributes to climate regulation, groundwater recharge, and promotes eco-tourism and local livelihoods.

2026-04-22.question: Who was named a Young Global Leader (YGL) 2026 by the World Economic Forum for transforming urban living through innovative space solutions?
2026-04-22.explanation: The Young Global Leaders (YGL) program by the World Economic Forum recognizes exceptional individuals under the age of 40 who are shaping the future through innovation and leadership. In 2026, Arthur Law was honoured for his contributions to transforming urban living through innovative space solutions. As a co-founder of Storefriendly Asia, he introduced technology-driven storage systems to address space constraints in rapidly growing cities. His work has impacted thousands of households and businesses. Being selected as a YGL places him among a prestigious global network of leaders, including policymakers, entrepreneurs, and change-makers.

2026-04-22.question: What was the annual rate of inflation based on the All India Wholesale Price Index (WPI) for March 2026?
2026-04-22.explanation: The Wholesale Price Index (WPI) measures inflation at the wholesale or producer level, reflecting price changes before they reach consumers. For March 2026, the WPI inflation rate was recorded at 3.88%, indicating moderate price growth in the economy. The index comprises major components such as manufactured products, primary articles, and fuel & power, with manufactured goods having the highest weight. Sector-wise, primary articles showed higher inflation compared to fuel and manufactured goods. This data is released monthly by the Office of the Economic Adviser and is crucial for understanding inflation trends and policy decisions.

2026-04-22.question: What was the total value of India's exports in the financial year 2025–26?
2026-04-22.explanation: India's export performance in the financial year 2025–26 showed steady growth compared to the previous year. The total exports rose from $825.26 billion in 2024–25 to $860.09 billion, reflecting a 4.22% increase. This growth was driven by improvements in both merchandise and services exports. Merchandise exports reached $441.78 billion, while services exports contributed $418.31 billion. Despite this growth, imports increased at a faster rate, leading to a widening trade deficit. The export figure of $860.09 billion marks a significant milestone in India's external trade performance.

2026-04-22.question: Which country suspended the automatic renewal of a bilateral defence cooperation deal with Israel in April 2026?
2026-04-22.explanation: The suspension of the defence cooperation agreement with Israel in April 2026 was carried out by Italy under the leadership of Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. The agreement, originally signed in 2003 and enforced in 2006, included provisions for automatic renewal every five years. It governed key military interactions such as defence equipment exchange, logistics, and joint training. The decision to suspend the deal came amid escalating tensions in the Middle East, particularly in Lebanon, where Italian troops faced security threats. This move also triggered diplomatic exchanges between the two countries, highlighting growing geopolitical concerns.

2026-04-22.question: What is the proposed minimum distance between new sugar mills under the Draft Sugarcane Control Order 2026?
2026-04-22.explanation: The Draft Sugarcane Control Order 2026 proposes increasing the minimum distance between new sugar mills to 25 km, replacing the earlier limit of 15 km. This measure aims to prevent excessive clustering of mills and ensure fair access to sugarcane resources for farmers. By maintaining adequate distance, the policy helps reduce competition among mills for raw materials and supports balanced regional development. It also considers changing consumption patterns, including reduced sugar demand and a shift toward alternatives like jaggery. Overall, the proposal seeks to create a more sustainable and efficient sugar industry structure in India.

2026-04-21.question: Who was awarded the 9th Prof. M.S. Swaminathan Award in 2026 for contributions to climate-resilient agriculture and natural resource management?
2026-04-21.explanation: The 9th Prof. M.S. Swaminathan Award was presented to Dr. Ch. Srinivasa Rao in recognition of his significant contributions to climate-resilient agriculture and sustainable natural resource management. Serving as the Director and Vice-Chancellor of the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), he has played a key role in developing district-level contingency plans to address climate challenges in agriculture. His efforts in scaling resource conservation technologies across vast agricultural areas have strengthened India’s food security. The award, instituted to honor excellence in agricultural science, also marked the birth centenary of M.S. Swaminathan, a pioneer of India’s Green Revolution.

2026-04-21.question: Until when has the Union Cabinet extended the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana-III (PMGSY-III) for the completion of roads and bridges in plain areas?
2026-04-21.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the extension of PMGSY-III to ensure the continued development of rural road infrastructure across India. The revised timeline allows for the completion of roads and bridges in plain areas, as well as roads in hilly regions, by March 2028. This extension supports the scheme’s goal of improving rural connectivity, facilitating access to markets, schools, and healthcare facilities. With an increased financial outlay of ₹83,977 crore, the initiative emphasises reducing transportation costs and boosting economic activities in rural areas, while also addressing pending works sanctioned before March 2025.

2026-04-21.question: Which Indian company partnered with POSCO Group to invest $7.3 billion in setting up an integrated steel plant in Odisha?
2026-04-21.explanation: The agreement involved a major collaboration between POSCO Group of South Korea and JSW Steel of India to establish a large integrated steel plant in Odisha. The project, valued at $7.3 billion, is a significant step toward boosting India’s steel production capacity. Both companies will hold equal stakes of 50 per cent in the joint venture, highlighting a balanced partnership. The plant is expected to produce 6 million tons of steel annually and will cover the entire production process at a single site. This initiative aligns with India’s long-term goal of increasing its steel production capacity under the National Steel Policy.

2026-04-21.question: Which state is set to host India’s first 3D semiconductor packaging unit at Info Valley with an investment of around ₹2,000 crore?
2026-04-21.explanation: Odisha has been selected as the location for India’s first advanced 3D semiconductor packaging unit, marking a significant milestone in the country’s push toward self-reliance in high-end electronics manufacturing. The project, established at Info Valley with an investment of around ₹2,000 crore, will introduce cutting-edge 3D heterogeneous integration technology. This initiative supports sectors such as artificial intelligence, 5G, defence electronics, and high-performance computing. It also aligns with the Atmanirbhar Bharat vision by strengthening domestic semiconductor capabilities, reducing import dependence, generating employment, and positioning Odisha as a major hub in India’s growing technology ecosystem.

2026-04-21.question: Which institution signed an MoU with the Ministry of Minority Affairs under the PM VIKAS scheme to provide technology-driven skill training to minority youth?
2026-04-21.explanation: The Ministry of Minority Affairs collaborated with IIT Patna under the PM VIKAS scheme to enhance skill development among minority youth in Bihar. The initiative aims to train 600 individuals in advanced and industry-relevant fields such as Artificial Intelligence and Business Analytics. This partnership reflects the government’s focus on bridging the skill gap and improving employability through modern technological education. IIT Patna, established in 2008, is one of India’s premier institutions and plays a key role in delivering high-quality technical training, thereby supporting sustainable livelihood opportunities for underrepresented communities.

2026-04-21.question: Who was unanimously elected as the President of the Odisha Steel Producers' Association (OSPA) on April 20, 2026?
2026-04-21.explanation: The Odisha Steel Producers' Association (OSPA), a key body representing major steel and mining companies in the state, elected Asit Tripathy as its President. A former Chief Secretary of Odisha and currently an advisor to Jindal Steel, he brings extensive administrative and industrial experience to the role. The association includes leading companies such as Tata Steel and JSW Steel, and plays a vital role in promoting collaboration, policy engagement, and sustainable industrial growth. His leadership is expected to strengthen Odisha’s position as India’s leading steel and iron ore-producing state while encouraging employment and economic development.

2026-04-21.question: Which company received the GreenPro ecolabel certification from the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for sustainable steel manufacturing on April 18, 2026?
2026-04-21.explanation: The GreenPro ecolabel certification, awarded by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), recognises environmentally sustainable products and manufacturing practices. Rathi Steel And Power Limited earned this certification for its Fe 550 Grade TMT rebars, marketed under the brand Rathi Powertech. This achievement highlights the company’s commitment to green steel production, reduced carbon emissions, and environmentally responsible construction materials.
