A 1991-batch officer of the Indian Naval Armament Service, he has served in several senior leadership roles at key naval armament depots and at the Ministry of Defence. His technical background as an IIT Delhi graduate and expertise in areas such as torpedo life-cycle management and explosive infrastructure planning make him well-suited for the role. His appointment comes at a crucial time when India’s Navy is undergoing major modernisation and capability enhancement.

2026-02-05.question: Which country held the 4th Joint Defence Cooperation Committee meeting with India in Zanzibar in February 2026?
2026-02-05.explanation: Tanzania partnered with India for the 4th Joint Defence Cooperation Committee meeting, which took place in Zanzibar in early February 2026. The meeting served as a platform to review existing defence cooperation and explore new avenues for collaboration. Discussions covered military training, service-to-service exchanges, maritime security, and defence industry partnerships. Both sides also identified emerging focus areas such as counter-terrorism, peacekeeping operations, military medicine, and advanced technologies, including cyber security and artificial intelligence. This engagement reflects the growing strategic defence relationship between India and Tanzania and their shared interest in regional and global security cooperation.

2026-02-04.question: In which Indian state will India’s first indigenous Green Urea plant be set up at the Pudimadaka Green Hydrogen Hub?
2026-02-04.explanation: India’s first indigenous Green Urea plant is planned at the Pudimadaka Green Hydrogen Hub in Andhra Pradesh through a collaboration between NTPC Green Energy Ltd and Assago. The project will use renewable hydrogen and green ammonia, marking a major step toward sustainable fertilizer production. By supplying green ammonia, carbon dioxide, and renewable energy, the initiative aims to significantly reduce India’s dependence on urea imports, which currently range between 8–10 million tonnes annually. Locating the project in Andhra Pradesh strengthens the state’s role in green energy infrastructure while supporting national goals of lowering carbon emissions and enhancing self-reliance.

2026-02-04.question: Which institution jointly hosted The Cities of Care Conference 2026 in Chennai to advance urban climate action?
2026-02-04.explanation: The Cities of Care Conference 2026 was jointly hosted by IIT Madras, along with the University of Toronto India Foundation and the University of Toronto in Chennai. The conference aimed to translate climate ambitions into actionable outcomes for urban India. A key focus of the event was the Water-Food-Waste Nexus, which is critical for building urban resilience as India’s population is projected to double by 2050. The conference also witnessed the launch of the “Sustainable India 2025” report, highlighting practical strategies to address environmental and sustainability challenges in rapidly growing cities.

2026-02-04.question: In which city will MAHE host the MAHE Global Health Summit 2026?
2026-02-04.explanation: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) is set to host the MAHE Global Health Summit 2026 in Manipal, reinforcing its position as a leading centre for global health discussions. The summit focuses on evidence-based global health policy and academic responsibility, bringing together key international initiatives such as the World Health Summit Academic Alliance and the Lancet Commission on Academic Responsibility. By hosting this major event in Manipal, MAHE aims to influence global health dialogue, promote research-driven policymaking, and strengthen the role of academic institutions in shaping responsible and impactful global health strategies.

2026-02-04.question: Which asset management company partnered with the Central Bank of India to distribute mutual fund products?
2026-02-04.explanation: The Central Bank of India entered into a partnership with HSBC Asset Management (India) Private Limited to offer mutual fund products to its customers. Through this collaboration, customers of the public sector bank can access professionally managed mutual fund schemes, expanding their investment choices beyond traditional savings products. The initiative is designed to help customers generate better long-term wealth by leveraging expert fund management and diversified portfolios. By associating with HSBC, a globally recognized financial institution, the Central Bank of India aims to strengthen its investment offerings and support customers in achieving improved financial planning and savings outcomes.

2026-02-04.question: Which brand launched the Celestor 2.0 dual-band GPS smartwatch with advanced tracking features?
2026-02-04.explanation: Celestor 2.0 is a newly launched dual-band GPS smartwatch aimed at users who prioritize fitness, accuracy, and modern design. The product supports L1 and L5 GPS bands, offline maps, and ABC sensors, making it suitable for high-precision activity tracking. Titan Smart introduced this smartwatch to cater to an active and goal-oriented generation that values both performance and style. To strengthen its brand presence and connect with sports enthusiasts, the company also appointed India’s top men’s doubles badminton duo, Chirag Shetty and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, as brand ambassadors, aligning the product with excellence and athletic achievement.

2026-02-04.question: In which country did the Indian senior women’s football team defeat Hertha BSC Frauen in an international friendly match?
2026-02-04.explanation: The Indian senior women’s football team achieved a notable 1–0 victory against Hertha BSC Frauen during an international friendly held in Antalya. This match took place in Turkiye, where the Indian team is conducting an overseas training and preparation camp. The friendly forms part of India’s build-up to the AFC Women’s Asian Cup Australia 2026. While in Turkiye, the team is also scheduled to play additional practice matches against clubs from Russia and Romania, using the exposure to strengthen performance, tactics, and match readiness at the international level.

2026-02-04.question: Which company received tentative approval from the USFDA for the generic version of the cancer drug Erdafitinib?
2026-02-04.explanation: Tentative approval was granted by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for a generic version of Erdafitinib in multiple strengths, expanding access to an important cancer treatment in the US market. Natco Pharma secured this approval for the drug equivalent to Janssen’s Balversa. Erdafitinib is prescribed for adults with unresectable or metastatic urothelial carcinoma that carries specific FGFR3 genetic alterations. This development highlights Natco Pharma’s growing presence in the oncology segment and reflects its focus on making advanced cancer therapies more affordable and accessible to patients through high-quality generic medicines.

2026-02-04.question: Which Indian state planned to launch India’s first live National UAV Test and Innovation Corridor?
2026-02-04.explanation: India’s first live National UAV Test and Innovation Corridor is planned to be launched at Rangeilunda, a repurposed commercial airport designed for real-world drone testing. This major initiative is being undertaken by the state of Odisha to support advanced and dynamic airspace testing for unmanned aerial vehicles. The corridor will facilitate testing of drone technologies such as swarm operations, artificial intelligence-based navigation, and other next-generation UAV capabilities. Developed in collaboration with BonV Aero and aligned with the B-MAAN scheme, the project is expected to play a crucial role in shaping India’s national UAV policy and innovation ecosystem.

2026-02-04.question: Which bank launched the premium LUXURA Metal Credit Card on the VISA Infinite platform?
2026-02-04.explanation: The LUXURA Metal Credit Card was introduced as a premium offering designed for high-net-worth individuals seeking global acceptance and exclusive lifestyle benefits. Punjab National Bank launched this card on the VISA Infinite platform to strengthen its premium banking portfolio. The card comes with several high-end features such as accelerated reward points, zero foreign exchange markup, complimentary access to global airport lounges, and round-the-clock VISA concierge services. By launching this metal credit card, the bank aims to combine luxury, convenience, and personalised services, enhancing its appeal among affluent customers and expanding its presence in the premium credit card segment.

2026-02-04.question: In which city was the 5th Bollywood Maha Arogya Shivir (Mega Health Camp) organised, setting a world record for the largest health camp of 2026?
2026-02-04.explanation: The Mega Health Camp, organised by DRVA Charitable Trust and Doctor 365, achieved international recognition for its scale and impact. The event was held in Mumbai, where it received acknowledgement from the IEA and ACE Book of World Records as the world’s largest health camp of 2026. The camp delivered extensive free healthcare services, including health checkups, distribution of medicines worth ₹2.5 crore, and issuance of nearly 5 lakh health cards. Hosting such a large-scale public health initiative in Mumbai highlights the city’s role as a major hub for social, medical, and charitable activities in India.

2026-02-04.question: On which date is World Cancer Day observed globally to raise awareness and promote cancer prevention?
2026-02-04.explanation: World Cancer Day is observed every year on February 4 with the objective of increasing global awareness about cancer and encouraging its prevention, detection, and treatment. The day brings together individuals, organisations, and governments to address the growing burden of cancer and work toward equitable access to care for all. The theme “United by Unique” emphasizes people-centered cancer care and recognises that every individual’s experience with cancer is different. Established in 2000 by the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC), the observance plays a key role in mobilising global action to reduce cancer-related deaths worldwide.

2026-02-03.question: In which city was Wings India 2026, Asia’s largest civil aviation event, held from January 28 to 31?
2026-02-03.explanation: Wings India 2026, recognised as Asia’s largest civil aviation event, was organised from January 28 to 31 in Hyderabad. The event highlighted India’s emergence as the world’s fastest-growing civil aviation market and served as a platform to showcase the country’s strengths in aviation connectivity, manufacturing, innovation, and sustainability. Held under the theme “Indian Aviation: Paving the Future,” the event emphasized the critical role of civil aviation in driving economic growth, enhancing global integration, and positioning India as a key player in the international aviation ecosystem.

2026-02-03.question: Which organisation signed an MoU with RITES to strengthen diesel locomotive leasing and maintenance for rail logistics?
2026-02-03.explanation: SAIL entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Rail India Technical and Economic Service to enhance rail logistics operations across its plants and mines. Under this collaboration, RITES will provide technical support for diesel locomotive leasing and maintenance while assisting SAIL in operating its mini rail network using Indian Railways’ facilities, spares, and skilled manpower. The partnership is designed to optimise operational costs, improve efficiency in material movement, and reduce the overall carbon footprint, aligning with sustainable and cost-effective industrial logistics practices.

2026-02-03.question: Which bank launched CHAKRA, a Centre of Excellence to promote financing for sunrise sectors under Viksit Bharat 2047?
2026-02-03.explanation: State Bank of India has launched CHAKRA, a Centre of Excellence aimed at strengthening financial support for sunrise sectors that are crucial for India’s long-term development vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. The initiative focuses on eight key areas, such as renewable energy, electric vehicles, green hydrogen, semiconductors, batteries, decarbonisation, smart infrastructure, and data centres. CHAKRA is designed to enhance risk assessment capabilities, develop innovative financing solutions, encourage research-based insights, and facilitate industry dialogue, thereby enabling effective capital flow into future-ready and technology-driven sectors.

2026-02-03.question: Who assumed additional charge as Chairman and Managing Director of Hindustan Shipyard Limited with effect from January 31, 2026?
2026-02-03.explanation: Capt. Ganti Venkateswarlu assumed additional charge as Chairman and Managing Director of Hindustan Shipyard Limited following the superannuation of Cmde Girideep Singh on January 31, 2026. Prior to this appointment, he was serving as Director (Shipbuilding) at HSL and had been closely associated with major shipbuilding and refit initiatives. The leadership transition comes at a significant time, as the shipyard has completed important refit projects and made steady progress on large-scale programmes for the Indian Navy and the Coast Guard, reinforcing HSL’s strategic role in India’s maritime and defence manufacturing ecosystem.

2026-02-03.question: Which state ranks first in India by contributing 16.5% of the total renewable energy capacity as of December 2025?
2026-02-03.explanation: Gujarat has emerged as the leading state in India in terms of renewable energy capacity, contributing 16.5 per cent of the national total as of December 2025. With an installed capacity of 42.583 GW, the state ranks at the top in wind energy, solar power, and rooftop solar installations. Gujarat has achieved 25,529 MW of solar capacity and 14,820 MW of wind capacity, along with more than 11 lakh rooftop solar installations. The state is also home to the world’s largest Khavda Renewable Energy Park, supporting India’s goal of generating 50 percent of electricity from renewable sources by 2030.

2026-02-03.question: Which airport operator will become India’s first to deploy hydrogen-powered buses for passenger transport?
2026-02-03.explanation: Cochin International Airport Ltd is set to become India’s first airport operator to introduce hydrogen-powered buses for passenger transportation, marking a major milestone in sustainable aviation practices. The initiative is being implemented through a Memorandum of Agreement with the Kerala Hydrogen Valley Innovation Cluster Foundation under the National Green Hydrogen Mission. As part of this green mobility project, three hydrogen fuel cell buses will be procured within a period of 12 months, with total funding capped at ₹8.7 crore, reinforcing CIAL’s leadership in clean energy adoption.

2026-02-03.question: To what level were tariffs reduced under the trade deal announced between the United States and India in February 2026?
2026-02-03.explanation: The United States and India announced a trade deal in February 2026 that included a significant reduction in tariffs. Under this agreement, the U.S. reciprocal tariff on Indian goods was reduced from 25 percent to 18 percent, with immediate effect. The announcement followed a direct conversation between U.S. President Donald Trump and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The deal also highlighted India’s commitment to increasing purchases of American goods, including energy, agriculture, and technology products. While the tariff reduction was welcomed by both sides, questions remain regarding the legal framework, formal documentation, and long-term implications of the agreement.

2026-02-03.question: Why was the upgraded National Youth Parliament Scheme (NYPS 2.0) portal launched by the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs?
2026-02-03.explanation: The NYPS 2.0 portal was launched to encourage wider youth participation in parliamentary practices across the country. The upgraded platform enables institutions, groups, and individuals to take part, including citizens from remote and rural regions, thereby broadening inclusivity. Since its introduction in September 2024, the scheme has witnessed strong engagement, with over 95,000 participants involved through more than 4,400 institutions and multiple youth parliament sittings. The initiative aims to deepen democratic awareness, foster civic responsibility, and strengthen the connection between young citizens and parliamentary processes.

2026-02-03.question: Which state launched Pilloo AI, a voice-based billing and accounting application for businesses?
2026-02-03.explanation: Andhra Pradesh launched Pilloo AI, an innovative voice-based billing and accounting application aimed at simplifying financial management for businesses. The app enables users to create invoices and manage accounts by speaking in five Indian languages, making it accessible to a wide range of users. Pilloo AI automates financial transactions, generates business reports, and extracts relevant data from uploaded bills and bank statements. By allowing real-time actions through natural language input, the initiative supports transparency, efficiency, and digital empowerment for enterprises, especially small and medium businesses across the state.

2026-02-03.question: Who has assumed additional charge as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Western Coalfields Limited from February 1, 2026?
2026-02-03.explanation: Harish Duhan has assumed the additional charge of Chairman and Managing Director of Western Coalfields Limited from February 1, 2026, while continuing his role as CMD of South Eastern Coalfields Limited. The responsibility has been assigned for a period of three months or until further orders, whichever is earlier. With over 35 years of experience as a mining engineer, he has held several senior leadership positions across key coal subsidiaries such as Western Coalfields Limited, Central Coalfields Limited, and Northern Coalfields Limited, reflecting his extensive expertise in the coal and mining sector.

2026-02-02.question: Which state launched the Mukhyamantri Gramotthan Yojana aimed at urban-style rural development?
2026-02-02.explanation: Gujarat launched the Mukhyamantri Gramotthan Yojana to promote urban-style infrastructure and amenities in rural areas. The initiative was inaugurated by Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel from Bhadran in Anand district. In its first phase, the scheme covers 114 taluka-headquarter villages and focuses on improving essential facilities such as roads, drainage systems, solar street lighting, and e-Gram services. Additionally, foundation stones were laid for 2,666 Gram Panchayat Ghar-cum-Talati Awas buildings with a total investment of ₹663 crore, reflecting the state’s commitment to strengthening rural governance and infrastructure development.

2026-02-02.question: In which city was the IndiaAI–Digital India Workshop on Artificial Intelligence held?
2026-02-02.explanation: The IndiaAI–Digital India Workshop on Artificial Intelligence was conducted in Gangtok at Chintan Bhawan. The one-day event was organised by the Information Technology Department of the Government of Sikkim in collaboration with the National e-Governance Division under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. It served as a pre-event to the IndiaAI Impact Summit 2026 scheduled in New Delhi. The workshop brought together policymakers, educators, students, and experts to deliberate on the transformative potential of artificial intelligence and its practical applications across governance, education, and society.

2026-02-02.question: Who was sworn in as the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, becoming the first woman to hold the post?
2026-02-02.explanation: Sunetra Pawar was sworn in as the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, marking a historic moment as she became the first woman to hold this position in the state. A Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament, she was unanimously elected as the leader of the NCP legislature party at Vidhan Bhavan. Her appointment followed the tragic death of Deputy CM Ajit Pawar in a plane crash. Backed by senior party leaders, her elevation reflects political continuity as well as a significant step toward greater representation of women in top executive roles within state governance.

2026-02-02.question: Which state has launched the digitisation of old manual birth and death records to modernise civil registration?
2026-02-02.explanation: Nagaland has initiated the digitisation of old manual birth and death certificates as part of efforts to modernise its civil registration system. Launched under the leadership of Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio, the initiative aims to improve the accuracy of vital statistics, enhance citizen access to essential documents, and strengthen service delivery. The move also supports evidence-based policymaking by ensuring reliable demographic data. In line with the guidelines of the Registrar General of India, the state is transitioning to a fully online registration system, thereby discontinuing the use of manual certificates and promoting digital governance.

2026-02-02.question: In which city was the CSIR-NIO Shore-Based Laboratory inaugurated to boost coastal and ocean research?
2026-02-02.explanation: The CSIR-National Institute of Oceanography inaugurated its Shore-Based Laboratory in Visakhapatnam to enhance India’s capabilities in coastal and ocean research. The facility focuses on studying the Eastern Coastal Margin, which is known for its geological diversity and rich potential in hydrocarbons, oil, gas, and seabed minerals influenced by Himalayan sediment deposits. The laboratory is also envisioned as a hub for skill development, innovation, and startup support, encouraging young scientists and researchers to contribute to India’s growing marine and ocean economy while strengthening scientific infrastructure along the eastern coastline.

2026-02-02.question: Which state achieved a Guinness World Record by distributing 5,555 e-cycles to women within 24 hours?
2026-02-02.explanation: Andhra Pradesh achieved a Guinness World Record by distributing 5,555 e-cycles to women within a span of 24 hours under the leadership of Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu. The initiative was aimed at promoting green mobility, reducing monthly transportation expenses, and empowering women by enhancing their independence and confidence. The e-cycles, assembled in Kuppam, have a running capacity of up to 60 kilometers and can be charged using rooftop solar power. This initiative highlights the state’s commitment to sustainable transport, renewable energy, and women-centric development programs.

2026-02-02.question: On which date is World Wetlands Day observed in 2026?
2026-02-02.explanation: World Wetlands Day is an important global observance linked to the conservation and sustainable use of wetlands. It commemorates the adoption of the Ramsar Convention, an international treaty focused on wetland protection. In 2026, World Wetlands Day is observed on February 2, drawing attention to the theme “Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage.” The day highlights the ecological, cultural, and economic value of wetlands worldwide. With 172 contracting parties and India having 98 Ramsar Sites, the observance reinforces the role of wetlands in biodiversity conservation, climate regulation, and sustaining traditional livelihoods.

2026-02-01.question: Which institution secured the top position in the Times Business-School Ranking 2026?
2026-02-01.explanation: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade achieved the top rank in the Times Business-School Ranking 2026, highlighting its strong reputation in global trade and international business education. Established in 1963, the institute has played a significant role in developing skilled professionals for India’s trade and commerce sectors. With multiple campuses across India and plans to expand internationally through its first overseas campus in Dubai, the institute continues to strengthen its global presence. Its focus on trade policy, international business, and applied research has contributed to its recognition as a leading business school in the country.

2026-02-01.question: Which state is home to Chhari-Dhand, recently designated as a Ramsar site?
2026-02-01.explanation: Chhari-Dhand is an ecologically important wetland located in the Kutch region of Gujarat and has been recognised as the state’s fifth Ramsar site. The wetland supports rich biodiversity, including large populations of migratory birds as well as unique desert wildlife. Its designation as a Ramsar site highlights the importance of conserving wetlands that play a vital role in maintaining ecological balance, supporting migratory species, and sustaining local ecosystems. Along with Patna Bird Sanctuary in Uttar Pradesh, the inclusion of Chhari-Dhand reflects India’s growing commitment to wetland conservation and biodiversity protection.

2026-02-01.question: Which city witnessed the inauguration of India’s first Bharat Ratna Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Advocate Training and Research Centre?
2026-02-01.explanation: The inauguration of India’s first Bharat Ratna Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Advocate Training and Research Centre took place in Navi Mumbai, specifically at Taloja. The centre has been established by the Maharashtra and Goa Bar Council with the objective of strengthening the legal profession by integrating legal education with practical courtroom training. The event was inaugurated by Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and attended by senior members of the judiciary. The centre is expected to play a key role in enhancing professional competence among advocates and honouring the legacy of Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar.

2026-02-01.question: In which state were projects worth ₹1,715 crore launched along with the foundation stone of a new Legislative Assembly?
2026-02-01.explanation: The projects worth ₹1,715 crore were launched in Assam, highlighting a major push toward infrastructure and institutional development in the state. The foundation stone for the new Assam Legislative Assembly was laid in Dibrugarh, reinforcing its role as the second capital of Assam. The initiatives include sports infrastructure, housing for legislators, and a Wildlife Research Institute, reflecting a balanced focus on governance, development, and conservation. Emphasis was also placed on flood mitigation through wetland development, a critical issue for Assam, along with the potential boost to Assam’s tea exports through the India–EU Free Trade Agreement.

2026-02-01.question: Where is the 39th Surajkund International Atmanirbhar Crafts Mela being held?
2026-02-01.explanation: The 39th Surajkund International Atmanirbhar Crafts Mela is organized at Surajkund, which is located in Faridabad, Haryana. The event runs from January 31 to February 15, 2026, and serves as a major platform for promoting self-reliance through traditional crafts and cultural expressions. Faridabad’s proximity to Delhi makes it an ideal venue for attracting national and international visitors. The mela highlights rural artisanship, folk performances, ethnic cuisines, and cultural exchange, with special theme pavilions showcasing the crafts, heritage, and traditions of Uttar Pradesh and Meghalaya.

2026-01-31.question: Under which constitutional provision did the Supreme Court direct the continued application of the UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Educational Institutions) Regulations, 2012?
2026-01-31.explanation: The Supreme Court exercised its extraordinary constitutional powers under Article 142 to ensure complete justice while issuing an interim stay on the UGC Regulations, 2026. Since the earlier 2012 Regulations had already been repealed, the Court relied on Article 142 to prevent a regulatory vacuum by directing that the 2012 framework would continue until further orders. This provision empowers the Supreme Court to pass any order necessary for doing complete justice in matters before it, even if such directions go beyond existing statutory provisions, reinforcing its role as the final constitutional arbiter.

2026-01-31.question: Which Foundation Day of the National Commission for Women (NCW) was observed on 31st January?
2026-01-31.explanation: The National Commission for Women observed its 34th Foundation Day on 31st January, marking over three decades of its role as India’s apex statutory body for safeguarding women’s rights. Established in 1992 under the National Commission for Women Act, 1990, the NCW focuses on reviewing constitutional and legal safeguards, addressing grievances, and recommending policy reforms. The 34th Foundation Day event emphasized women’s health as a critical pillar of empowerment under the theme “Swasthya hi Sashaktikaran,” reinforcing the link between health, social equity, and nation-building while highlighting the Commission’s continuing relevance.

2026-01-31.question: Which country announced its withdrawal from the International Solar Alliance (ISA) in January 2026?
2026-01-31.explanation: The International Solar Alliance is a multilateral initiative aimed at promoting solar energy adoption globally, particularly in developing countries. In January 2026, a major development occurred when the United States announced its withdrawal from the ISA, five years after joining in 2021. This decision is significant because the United States is one of the world’s largest economies and carbon emitters, and its exit could weaken global momentum on climate cooperation and solar energy financing. The withdrawal may also impact investor confidence and collective efforts to meet ambitious solar and climate targets set under the ISA framework.

2026-01-31.question: Which Indian state hosted the India Energy Week (IEW) 2026?
2026-01-31.explanation: India Energy Week 2026 was concluded in Goa, where the event highlighted India’s preparedness to manage global energy volatility while pursuing a balanced transition toward clean energy. As the host state, Goa played a significant role by showcasing its long-term renewable energy ambitions, including a roadmap to achieve 100% renewable energy by 2050. The state also emphasised harmonising the Green Economy with the Blue Economy, reflecting sustainable use of marine resources. Hosting IEW positioned Goa as an important platform for discussions on energy security, global cooperation, and future energy demand trends centred on emerging markets like India.

2026-01-31.question: Which country was the location of the US operation codenamed Operation Absolute Resolve involving the use of the classified “Discombobulator” weapon system?
2026-01-31.explanation: Operation Absolute Resolve refers to a reported US military operation carried out in Venezuela, notable for the alleged deployment of advanced non-lethal and electronic warfare technologies collectively referred to as the Discombobulator. These capabilities include directed energy weapons, acoustic and visual disorientation tools, electronic warfare systems, and cyber-attack mechanisms aimed at disabling enemy defenses and infrastructure. The operation highlights the growing emphasis on electronic, cyber, and non-kinetic means of warfare to achieve strategic objectives while limiting direct physical destruction and casualties.

2026-01-30.question: Which Indian state launched the ‘Mukhya Mantrir Eti Koli Duti Paat’ scheme to support tea garden workers?
2026-01-30.explanation: Assam introduced the ‘Mukhya Mantrir Eti Koli Duti Paat’ scheme as a commemorative initiative marking 200 years of Assam Tea while recognising the vital role played by tea garden workers. Under this scheme, each registered tea garden worker, excluding those in management roles, receives a one-time financial assistance of ₹5,000. The amount is transferred directly to beneficiaries through Aadhaar-linked bank accounts, ensuring transparency and efficiency. The initiative is aimed at improving socio-economic security, promoting financial inclusion, and strengthening support for the tea-growing community that forms the backbone of Assam’s tea industry.

2026-01-30.question: Which Indian state launched the 872-acre Knowledge City project to develop a global education and innovation hub?
2026-01-30.explanation: Tamil Nadu initiated the ambitious 872-acre Knowledge City project near Chennai with the vision of building a world-class education and innovation ecosystem. Launched by Chief Minister M.K. Stalin in Tiruvallur, the project is designed to host campuses of eight international universities along with advanced research and infrastructure facilities. The initiative aims to strengthen higher education, promote cutting-edge research, and encourage global academic collaboration. By positioning itself as a premier destination for education and innovation, Tamil Nadu seeks to attract international institutions, foster talent development, and boost long-term socio-economic growth.

2026-01-30.question: In which city did the 12th Smile International Film Festival for Children & Youth (SIFFCY) begin?
2026-01-30.explanation: The 12th edition of the Smile International Film Festival for Children & Youth was held in New Delhi, marking an important cultural and social event focused on young audiences. Organised by the Smile Foundation in collaboration with the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, the festival emphasised themes of diversity, equity, and inclusion. It showcased films created by disabled children and highlighted socially relevant issues through cinema. By hosting the festival in New Delhi, the organizers aimed to reach a wide and diverse audience, using films as a powerful medium to educate, inspire, and encourage positive action among children and youth.

2026-01-30.question: Which Indian company partnered with BISAG-N to strengthen quantum-safe cybersecurity by integrating solutions like “Vedic Kavach” with quantum hardware platforms?
2026-01-30.explanation: QNu Labs entered into a partnership with BISAG-N to advance India’s quantum-resilient cybersecurity capabilities. The collaboration focuses on integrating indigenous software solutions such as “Vedic Kavach” with quantum hardware platforms to protect critical digital systems. The initiative aims to develop and deploy quantum-safe cybersecurity frameworks for defence, the public sector, and key infrastructure. It also involves technology transfer and the use of Quantum Random Number Generation (RNG), supporting India’s strategic objective of building secure, self-reliant, and future-ready digital infrastructure in the face of emerging quantum computing threats.

2026-01-30.question: Which government think tank signed a Statement of Intent with the NIIT Foundation to promote digital literacy and skill development in Aspirational Blocks?

options.A: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

2026-01-30.explanation: NITI Aayog partnered with the NIIT Foundation by signing a Statement of Intent aimed at improving digital literacy and skill development in India’s Aspirational Blocks. The initiative targets around 1.2 lakh beneficiaries and emphasizes inclusivity, with at least 40% participation from women. The collaboration focuses on providing digital skills training, enhancing financial awareness, and offering vocational and employability programs. By concentrating on underserved and backward regions, the effort seeks to create equitable growth opportunities, reduce the digital divide, and empower communities with skills essential for participation in the modern digital economy.

2026-01-30.question: Which fintech company launched India’s first RBI repo rate–linked savings account with UPI-first banking features?
2026-01-30.explanation: Slice introduced India’s first savings account directly linked to the RBI repo rate, marking a significant innovation in digital banking. The account calculates interest on a daily basis and credits it in line with real market rates, ensuring transparency and fairness for customers. With features such as instant UPI access, no minimum balance requirement, and immediate liquidity, the solution is designed for convenience and efficiency. Powered by a cost-efficient digital model, Slice’s offering aligns consumer profitability with equitable banking practices, setting a new benchmark for modern, UPI-first financial products in India.

2026-01-30.question: Which fintech company became India’s first unicorn of the year 2026 after securing a Series D follow-on investment at a $1.2 billion valuation?
2026-01-30.explanation: Juspay achieved unicorn status in 2026 after raising $50 million in a Series D follow-on round led by WestBridge Capital, reaching a valuation of $1.2 billion. This milestone made it the first company in India to enter the unicorn club that year and the 127th unicorn overall in the country. The company specializes in enterprise payment solutions such as UPI, payment orchestration, and infrastructure, processing nearly 300 million transactions daily with an annual total payment value of about $1 trillion. The funding also supported global expansion and provided liquidity to early investors and ESOP holders.

2026-01-30.question: Which provision of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, requires prior approval before initiating an inquiry or investigation into a public servant’s official acts and was recently subject to a split Supreme Court verdict?
2026-01-30.explanation: Section 17A of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, was introduced through the 2018 amendment with the objective of protecting honest public servants from frivolous and vexatious investigations related to decisions taken in good faith. It mandates that investigative agencies obtain prior approval from the competent authority before initiating an inquiry or investigation into official acts of a public servant. The provision has sparked intense legal debate, as reflected in the Supreme Court’s split verdict balancing the need to safeguard bureaucratic decision-making while ensuring that anti-corruption investigations remain independent, effective, and consistent with the constitutional principle of equality before law.

2026-01-30.question: Which Indian state’s living root bridges have been nominated for UNESCO World Heritage evaluation for the 2026–27 cycle?
2026-01-30.explanation: Meghalaya’s living root bridges have been nominated for UNESCO World Heritage status, recognising their outstanding cultural and ecological significance. These bridges are naturally grown from the aerial roots of rubber fig trees and have been carefully shaped over generations by the Khasi and Jaintia communities. They represent a remarkable example of sustainable bioengineering, showcasing a deep-rooted harmony between humans and nature. The nomination highlights centuries-old indigenous knowledge systems and emphasises the bridges’ resilience, functionality, and role as living symbols of sustainability and environmental stewardship on a global platform.

2026-01-30.question: Which institution signed an MoU to establish the Krishnamurthy Tandon School of AI with a ₹100 crore endowment?
2026-01-30.explanation: IIM Ahmedabad entered into a memorandum of understanding with its alumna, Chandrika Krishnamurthy Tandon and Ranjan Tandon to set up the Krishnamurthy Tandon School of AI, backed by a substantial ₹100 crore endowment. The initiative is designed to strengthen India’s artificial intelligence ecosystem by promoting responsible and inclusive AI development. It focuses on addressing nation-scale challenges, encouraging innovation at the intersection of technology and societal impact, and creating employment opportunities. This move further reinforces IIM Ahmedabad’s leadership role in management education and emerging technology-driven research in India.

2026-01-29.question: Which Indian state has declared 2026 as the ‘Year of Agriculture’ with a significantly increased budget to enhance farmer prosperity?
2026-01-29.explanation: Madhya Pradesh has announced 2026 as the ‘Year of Agriculture’ as part of a long-term strategy to strengthen its agricultural sector and improve farmer livelihoods. The state has increased its agriculture budget to ₹27,000 crore, marking a substantial rise compared to allocations made two decades earlier. The initiative focuses on technology transfer, income enhancement, promotion of natural farming practices, innovation, and wider access to e-Mandi platforms for nearly 40 lakh farmers. Guided by the theme ‘prosperous farmers–prosperous state’, the policy also aims to boost agricultural productivity and exports, reinforcing agriculture as a key driver of economic growth.

2026-01-29.question: Which Indian state government announced a ₹1,250 crore financial assistance package under the Namo Laxmi Scheme to support over 12 lakh schoolgirls?
2026-01-29.explanation: Gujarat has launched the Namo Laxmi Scheme as a major social welfare initiative focused on promoting girls’ education and well-being. Under this scheme, the state government has allocated ₹1,250 crore to provide financial assistance to more than 12 lakh girls studying in secondary and higher secondary classes. Eligible students from Classes 9 to 12 will receive a total of ₹50,000 spread over four years. The program is designed to reduce financial constraints, encourage school retention, support adolescent health, and ensure that girls can continue their education without economic hurdles.

2026-01-29.question: Which Indian state signed an MoU with the Bombay Natural History Society to strengthen the breeding programme for critically endangered vultures?
2026-01-29.explanation: Jharkhand has entered into a five-year collaboration with the Bombay Natural History Society (BNHS) to enhance conservation efforts for the critically endangered vulture species. The initiative focuses on the Oriental White-backed and Long-billed Vultures and includes the establishment of a new Vulture Conservation Breeding Centre at Muta. With technical support from BNHS, the programme emphasizes scientific breeding methods, capacity building, and long-term species recovery. This partnership contributes to India’s broader vulture conservation and recovery strategy, addressing population decline and strengthening ecological balance through sustained conservation action.

2026-01-29.question: Which international financial institution approved ₹5,700 crore in technical and financial assistance for the Jal Sanrakshit Haryana Project?
2026-01-29.explanation: The World Bank has approved substantial technical and financial assistance amounting to ₹5,700 crore to support the Jal Sanrakshit Haryana Project. This initiative is aimed at achieving water self-reliance through large-scale restoration and modernisation of canal infrastructure across the state. The funding will be released in phases between 2026 and 2032 and will contribute to upgrading hundreds of canals. Along with support from state funds and NABARD, the World Bank’s involvement highlights its role in strengthening water resource management, improving irrigation efficiency, and promoting sustainable agricultural and water practices in the region.

2026-01-29.question: Which bank has adopted HyperVerge’s AI-powered Video KYC solution to enhance digital onboarding and regulatory compliance?
2026-01-29.explanation: Suryoday Small Finance Bank has strengthened its digital banking capabilities by adopting an AI-powered Video KYC solution developed by HyperVerge. This advanced technology enables faster and more efficient customer onboarding while ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements. By leveraging artificial intelligence, the bank has been able to significantly improve agent productivity, allowing more verification calls to be completed each day without increasing operational costs. The initiative supports scalable growth, maintains high verification quality, and enhances customer experience, reflecting the bank’s focus on innovation and technology-driven transformation in the financial services sector.

2026-01-29.question: Which country signed a joint statement with India to expand cooperation in conventional and clean energy during India Energy Week 2026?
2026-01-29.explanation: Canada has partnered with India by signing a joint statement at India Energy Week 2026 to deepen collaboration in both conventional and clean energy sectors. This agreement strengthens the India–Canada Ministerial Energy Dialogue, with key focus areas including energy security, diversification of supply chains, and enhancement of trade and investment relations. The renewed cooperation builds on earlier discussions held at the 2025 G7 Summit and marks a revival of senior-level engagement between the two countries. The initiative reflects shared priorities in sustainable energy development and long-term strategic cooperation in the global energy landscape.

2026-01-29.question: Which organisation plans to roll out semi-knockdown SuperJet 100 (SJ100) aircraft in collaboration with Russia’s PJSC-UAC?
2026-01-29.explanation: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd is undertaking a strategic initiative to expand its footprint in the civil aviation sector by planning the rollout of semi knock-down SuperJet 100 aircraft within the next three years. This move is part of a collaboration with Russia’s PJSC-UAC and reflects a long-term vision to significantly increase the share of civil aviation revenue. By focusing on domestic production and diversification of the aviation market, the company aims to raise its civil aviation contribution from the current low single-digit percentage to about one-fourth of its total revenue over the coming decade.

2026-01-29.question: Which Indian state partnered with MEESCHOOL to launch the Cine Startup Incubator at T-Hub?
2026-01-29.explanation: Telangana has taken a proactive role in strengthening India’s media and creative entrepreneurship ecosystem by collaborating with MEESCHOOL to launch the Cine Startup Incubator at T-Hub in Hyderabad. The initiative focuses on supporting cinepreneurs through structured skilling programs, mentorship, and venture support, while aligning with national and state-level bodies such as DPIIT and TGIC. In addition, the launch of SHE NARRATES reflects the state’s emphasis on inclusive growth by empowering women through drone cinematography and storytelling, aiming to benefit thousands of women and enhance their participation in the creative economy.

2026-01-29.question: Which Indian state has launched India’s first government-run menopause clinics to address women’s physical and mental health needs?
2026-01-29.explanation: Maharashtra has taken a pioneering step in women’s healthcare by launching India’s first government menopause clinics. These clinics are set up in hospitals and urban health centres to provide comprehensive support for women experiencing menopause, a stage often overlooked in public health systems. The facilities offer medical consultations, screenings for bone health, heart conditions and hormonal changes, along with medicines and psychological counseling under one roof. By addressing issues such as sleep disturbances, bone loss and mental stress, the initiative aims to improve the quality of life and promote holistic health care for middle-aged women.

2026-01-28.question: Which organisation carried out the high-altitude rescue and road restoration operation at Chatergala Pass in Jammu and Kashmir in January 2026?
2026-01-28.explanation: The high-altitude rescue and road restoration operation at Chatergala Pass was executed by the Border Roads Organisation, showcasing its critical role in maintaining connectivity in strategically important and inhospitable regions. Operating under Project Sampark, BRO personnel cleared massive snowfall ranging from 5 to 6 feet, reopening nearly 38 km of blocked roads. The mission enabled the safe evacuation of stranded civilians and Rashtriya Rifles troops without any casualties. Conducted under extreme weather and sub-zero temperatures, the operation highlighted BRO’s expertise in infrastructure resilience, humanitarian assistance, and close coordination with the Indian Army in sensitive border areas.

2026-01-28.question: In which Indian state was the mobile mephedrone laboratory, disguised as a poultry farm, busted under Operation Sahyadri Checkmate?
2026-01-28.explanation: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence conducted a major crackdown under Operation Sahyadri Checkmate, leading to the busting of a mobile mephedrone manufacturing laboratory hidden as a poultry farm. The operation took place in the Sahyadri ranges of Maharashtra, an area exploited by traffickers due to its difficult terrain and remoteness. Authorities seized nearly 22 kg of mephedrone in various forms along with 71.5 kg of raw materials used for production. The lab was designed to frequently relocate to avoid detection, highlighting the sophistication of the drug network. The seized NDPS substances were valued at approximately ₹55 crore, and five individuals were arrested.

2026-01-28.question: Which country’s National Assembly has approved a bill to ban children under 15 from accessing social media platforms to protect mental health?
2026-01-28.explanation: France has moved decisively to regulate digital access for minors by approving legislation that bans children below the age of 15 from using social media platforms. The decision is driven by growing concerns over online bullying, mental health challenges, sleep disruption, and youth violence linked to excessive screen time. The bill mandates strict age-verification systems and extends existing smartphone restrictions in schools. Passed with strong political and public backing, the proposal reflects France’s intent to set firm boundaries on children’s digital exposure and aligns with a broader European debate on safeguarding minors in the online environment.

2026-01-28.question: Which Indian state has officially declared Bacillus subtilis as its State Microbe, becoming the first in the country to do so?
2026-01-28.explanation: Kerala has made a pioneering move by officially adopting Bacillus subtilis as its State Microbe, marking the first such recognition by any Indian state. This decision reflects Kerala’s strong emphasis on science, research, and sustainability-driven development. Bacillus subtilis is a beneficial microorganism known for its role in human health, agriculture, and environmental balance. The announcement coincided with the launch of the Centre of Excellence in Microbiome, which aims to advance research across health, agriculture, fisheries, and environmental conservation. The initiative highlights the growing importance of microbiome research in addressing global challenges such as disease resistance, soil health, and climate resilience.

2026-01-28.question: In which city is Gulfood 2026 being held, where India has made its historic debut as a Partner Country?
2026-01-28.explanation: Gulfood 2026 is being hosted in Dubai, marking a significant milestone for India as it participates as a Partner Country for the first time in the event’s 31-year history. The exhibition is taking place across two major venues—the Dubai World Trade Centre and the Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai. India’s participation, led by APEDA, showcases the country’s growing agri-food export strength through a large and diverse pavilion featuring exhibitors from across India. This engagement highlights deepening India–UAE trade relations and reinforces Dubai’s role as a global hub for food, beverage, and agri-trade connectivity.

2026-01-28.question: Which Indian state’s police force received the President’s Police Colour Award for distinguished service, becoming the 15th state in the country to achieve this honour?
2026-01-28.explanation: The President’s Police Colour Award, also known as the Nishaan, is among the highest collective honours bestowed on police forces in India for sustained excellence, discipline, and professionalism. Sikkim Police earned this prestigious recognition, making Sikkim the 15th state in India and the third in the North-East to receive the award since Independence. The honour reflects the force’s long-term commitment to public service, integrity, and effective law enforcement in a strategically sensitive border state. The ceremonial presentation of the flag and insignia during a Colour Presentation Parade symbolises national pride and institutional achievement.

2026-01-28.question: Which country has officially withdrawn from the World Health Organisation after completing the mandatory one-year notice period?
2026-01-28.explanation: The United States formally exited the World Health Organisation following a one-year withdrawal process initiated through an executive order. The decision marked a major shift in global health diplomacy, as the country had been the largest contributor to WHO funding, providing nearly 18% of its budget. The withdrawal was driven by disagreements over the organisation’s handling of the COVID-19 pandemic and concerns about financial obligations. This move has had wide-ranging implications, including funding shortfalls for the WHO, workforce reductions, and changes in global disease surveillance and public health coordination mechanisms.

2026-01-28.question: Which country has commissioned the world’s largest compressed-air energy storage plant?
2026-01-28.explanation: China has taken a major step in advancing large-scale energy storage by commissioning the world’s largest compressed-air energy storage plant in Jiangsu province. The facility, developed by Harbin Electric Corp., is designed to support renewable energy integration by providing long-duration and cost-effective storage solutions. With a massive storage capacity of 2,400 MWh and a power generation capability of 600 MW, the plant can supply electricity to around 600,000 households each year. This project reflects China’s broader strategy to strengthen its green energy infrastructure and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

2026-01-28.question: Which port was visited by the Indian Navy’s First Training Squadron as part of its overseas deployment?
2026-01-28.explanation: The Indian Navy’s First Training Squadron, comprising INS Tir, INS Shardul, INS Sujata, and ICGS Sarathi, made a port call at Phuket Deep Sea Port in Thailand. This visit is significant as it coincides with the ASEAN-India Year of Maritime Cooperation and highlights India’s efforts to enhance maritime engagement in the Indo-Pacific region. The port call involved professional interactions, joint naval exercises, sports events, and yoga sessions with the Royal Thai Navy. Such engagements strengthen bilateral naval cooperation and align with India’s MAHASAGAR vision, reinforcing collaborative maritime security and regional partnerships ahead of India assuming the IONS Chair in 2026.

2026-01-28.question: In which Indian state was the rare mushroom species Hemileccinum indicum discovered in high-altitude oak forests?
2026-01-28.explanation: The rare mushroom species Hemileccinum indicum was discovered in the oak forests of Uttarakhand, specifically in the Dhakuri region of Bageshwar district at elevations above 2,600 metres. This finding is scientifically significant as it marks the first recorded presence of the genus Hemileccinum in India. The discovery was made through systematic macrofungal surveys and confirmed using advanced molecular phylogenetic analysis. Beyond taxonomy, the species plays an important ecological role by forming symbiotic relationships with oak trees, enhancing nutrient cycling and forest health, and highlighting the rich yet underexplored fungal biodiversity of the Himalayan region.

2026-01-28.question: Which institution developed a new scientific technique to predict glacial hazards and identify potential glacial lake formation sites in the Eastern Himalayas?
2026-01-28.explanation: IIT Guwahati has developed an advanced predictive framework to assess glacial hazards in the Eastern Himalayas, addressing rising risks linked to climate change and glacier retreat. By combining high-resolution satellite imagery with digital elevation models, researchers identified 492 locations where glacial lakes may form in the future. The study used sophisticated predictive models, including Bayesian Neural Networks, to improve accuracy and handle uncertainty in complex mountainous terrain. This research supports early warning systems for Glacial Lake Outburst Floods, strengthens disaster preparedness, and aids climate-resilient planning, making it valuable for policymakers, disaster managers, and infrastructure planners in fragile Himalayan regions.

2026-01-28.question: On which date is International Data Privacy Day observed every year to highlight the importance of protecting personal data?
2026-01-28.explanation: International Data Privacy Day is observed annually on January 28 to promote awareness about the protection of personal information in an increasingly digital world. The observance traces its origin to the signing of Convention 108 by the Council of Europe, the first legally binding international treaty on data protection. For countries with large digital ecosystems, the day serves as a reminder that trust in digital services depends on strong privacy safeguards. In India’s context, where platforms handle data related to identity, finance, healthcare, and welfare, January 28 underscores the need for robust laws, responsible governance, and informed citizens to ensure secure and inclusive digital growth.

2026-01-27.question: Who became the first tennis player to achieve 400 career Grand Slam singles victories?
2026-01-27.explanation: Novak Djokovic reached a historic milestone by securing his 400th Grand Slam singles win after defeating Botic van de Zandschulp 6‑3, 6‑4, 7‑6 at the Australian Open. This achievement makes him the first player in history to reach 400 Grand Slam victories, surpassing Roger Federer (369) and Rafael Nadal (314). Additionally, his 102nd win at the Australian Open tied Federer’s record for the most men’s singles wins in Melbourne. Djokovic’s consistent performance highlights his dominance and longevity in professional tennis.

2026-01-27.question: Which company launched NEXIPOX PLUS®, a next-generation Varicella vaccine in India?
2026-01-27.explanation: Novo Medi Sciences introduced NEXIPOX PLUS®, an advanced Varicella (chickenpox) vaccine tailored for Indian clinical and environmental conditions. The vaccine uses a 2X trehalose-based stabiliser system, which enhances viral stability, preserves potency, and reduces allergenic reactions associated with gelatin and mannitol. This launch represents India’s first upgraded formulation of the Varicella vaccine, reflecting innovation in vaccine development and addressing the need for safer, more effective immunisation options in the country. The product is positioned to improve vaccination outcomes and public health protection.

2026-01-27.question: Which country has announced a $785 million investment in public AI research by 2030?
2026-01-27.explanation: Singapore has committed S$1 billion (approximately $785 million) to public AI research by 2030, aiming to strengthen its global competitiveness and technological leadership. The investment will fund advanced AI research centres, foster industrial AI applications, and develop skilled talent in collaboration with international experts. This initiative is designed to address labour constraints, promote economic growth, and secure Singapore’s position as a leader in AI innovation and development. It highlights the strategic importance of AI in shaping the nation’s future economy and technological landscape.

2026-01-27.question: Which country is set to benefit from the IFC’s $166 million programme to support SMEs and inclusive growth?
2026-01-27.explanation: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) has launched a $166 million initiative aimed at boosting Sri Lanka’s economic growth through enhanced support for small and medium enterprises (SMEs). The programme specifically targets women-owned businesses and the agriculture sector, aiming to promote inclusive growth, generate employment, and strengthen economic resilience in underserved communities. By facilitating access to financing and resources, this initiative helps Sri Lanka transition from economic stabilization efforts to sustainable, broad-based development, highlighting the role of international financial institutions in supporting emerging economies.

2026-01-27.question: On which date is National Geographic Day observed each year?
2026-01-27.explanation: National Geographic Day is observed annually on January 27 to commemorate the founding of the National Geographic Society in 1888. The day celebrates exploration, geographic knowledge, science, wildlife, and environmental conservation. It encourages people to learn about the planet’s landscapes, oceans, climates, cultures, and biodiversity while promoting awareness of global challenges such as climate change and habitat loss. By highlighting the legacy of the National Geographic Society, the observance inspires curiosity, global understanding, and sustainable living, reinforcing the importance of informed, responsible citizens in protecting Earth for future generations.

2026-01-27.question: At which railway station did Indian Railways deploy its first humanoid robot, ASC ARJUN?
2026-01-27.explanation: Indian Railways deployed its first humanoid robot, ASC ARJUN, at Visakhapatnam Railway Station. This AI-powered robot is designed to enhance passenger safety and security while improving operational efficiency. It assists the Railway Protection Force by monitoring crowds, using face recognition technology, and delivering multilingual announcements to raise awareness among travellers. The deployment highlights Indian Railways’ commitment to integrating advanced technology and innovation into public transit services, ensuring a smarter, safer, and more efficient travel experience for passengers at one of the key railway hubs in the country.

2026-01-27.question: Which Indian state is set to develop the ₹450 crore Matabari Tourism Circuit?
2026-01-27.explanation: The foundation for the ₹450 crore Matabari Tourism Circuit has been laid in Tripura, aimed at boosting spiritual and eco-tourism. Key sites connected by the circuit include the Tripura Sundari Temple, Chabimura, and Dumbur Lake. The project will feature jetties, eco-resorts, and modern tourism facilities, with ₹276 crore funded by the Ministry of DoNER. This initiative is part of Tripura’s broader push to enhance tourism infrastructure, attract visitors, and generate economic growth through sustainable and culturally significant tourism projects.

2026-01-27.question: In which city did Amit Shah inaugurate Assam’s largest multi-sports hub, the Khanikar Stadium?
2026-01-27.explanation: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the Khanikar Stadium in Dibrugarh, Assam, which is set to become the state’s largest multi-sports hub. The facility aims to host regional and national sports events, enhance sports tourism, and provide expanded opportunities for athletes at the state level. This development represents a significant step toward modern sports infrastructure in Assam, promoting youth engagement and supporting the state’s vision of nurturing athletic talent. The location in Dibrugarh positions it strategically for regional accessibility and long-term sports development initiatives.

2026-01-27.question: Who scored a 14-ball half-century, marking India’s second-fastest fifty in T20 Internationals?
2026-01-27.explanation: Abhishek Sharma achieved a remarkable feat by scoring a 14-ball fifty against New Zealand, making it the second-fastest T20I half-century for India. He finished unbeaten on 68 off just 20 balls, contributing significantly to India’s eight-wicket victory while chasing 154. Alongside key performances from Suryakumar Yadav and Jasprit Bumrah, Sharma’s explosive innings helped India secure a 3-0 lead in the five-match T20I series. This innings highlights his aggressive batting style and capability to change games quickly in the shortest format of cricket.

2026-01-27.question: Which country is receiving a $740,000 UNESCO emergency aid package for protecting cultural heritage and education after severe storms?
2026-01-27.explanation: UNESCO has announced a $740,000 emergency aid package for Vietnam to protect its cultural heritage and education in regions affected by severe storms. The support, funded by the World Heritage Fund, will assist with damage assessments and emergency measures at key sites, including the World Heritage-listed cities of Hue and Hoi An. The initiative aims to stabilize both tangible and intangible heritage, restore learning facilities, and work collaboratively with local authorities, ensuring that Vietnam’s historical and educational assets are preserved despite natural disasters.

2026-01-26.question: Which state launched its first Dog Sanctuary in Ludhiana as a pilot project to address the stray dog menace?
2026-01-26.explanation: Punjab has launched its first Dog Sanctuary in Ludhiana as a pilot initiative aimed at improving animal welfare while addressing public safety concerns related to stray dogs. The sanctuary is designed to manage stray dog populations in a humane and structured manner, following Supreme Court guidelines and Animal Birth Control rules. The initiative focuses on sheltering, sterilisation, vaccination, and controlled management to reduce dog bite incidents in urban areas. As a pilot project, it will help assess effectiveness before being replicated across other districts, creating a sustainable and legally compliant model for stray animal management.

2026-01-26.question: On which date is International Customs Day observed globally?
2026-01-26.explanation: International Customs Day is celebrated every year on January 26 to recognize the crucial role of customs authorities in facilitating global trade, ensuring border security, and supporting economic growth. The date commemorates the first session of the Customs Cooperation Council (now World Customs Organization) held on 26 January 1953 in Brussels. The day raises awareness about customs procedures, promotes cooperation among nations, and honours customs officials for maintaining lawful trade and secure supply chains. Activities include seminars, workshops, and recognition programs to highlight efficiency, security, and international collaboration in customs administration.

2026-01-26.question: In which region was India’s first open-sea marine fish farming project launched to promote finfish and seaweed cultivation?
2026-01-26.explanation: Andaman has become the site of India’s first open-sea marine fish farming project, marking a significant shift from traditional coastal aquaculture to open-ocean farming. The pilot initiative focuses on cultivating marine finfish and seaweed using specially designed cages capable of withstanding strong ocean currents. Implemented with the support of scientific institutions and local administration, the project aims to enhance the livelihoods of fishing communities while promoting the sustainable use of marine resources. It aligns with India’s broader Blue Economy vision by combining marine science, innovation, and economic development to responsibly harness ocean potential.

2026-01-26.question: What was India’s rank in the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026 released by Dezan Shira & Associates?
2026-01-26.explanation: India secured the sixth position in the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026, placing it in the middle among 11 Asian manufacturing economies. The index evaluates countries on multiple pillars such as economic strength, infrastructure quality, workforce readiness, innovation capacity, and trade environment. India’s ranking reflects steady progress supported by a large domestic market and improving infrastructure, but it also highlights the need for faster reforms and stronger execution. As competition intensifies across Asia, enhancing ease of doing business, logistics efficiency, skills development, and technological adoption will be essential for India to improve its manufacturing competitiveness.

2026-01-26.question: Who has been awarded the Ashok Chakra for exceptional peacetime bravery?
2026-01-26.explanation: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla has been conferred with the Ashok Chakra, India’s highest peacetime gallantry award, recognising extraordinary courage, leadership, and devotion to duty. This award is given for acts of valour and self-sacrifice away from the battlefield. The President of India, Droupadi Murmu, approved this along with gallantry awards for 70 other armed forces personnel. Shukla’s award highlights his exceptional contribution to India’s aerospace and defence achievements and serves as an inspiration for bravery, leadership, and service to the nation.

2026-01-26.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer of Raymond Lifestyle with effect from January 19, 2026?
2026-01-26.explanation: Satyaki Ghosh has been appointed as the Chief Executive Officer of Raymond Lifestyle as part of a strategic leadership decision to strengthen the company’s consumer and lifestyle business. With more than 25 years of experience across FMCG, textiles and retail sectors, he brings deep expertise in managing large brands and operations in both B2B and B2C environments. His previous leadership roles at Aditya Birla Group, Grasim Industries, and global companies such as L’Oréal and PepsiCo equip him to drive growth, innovation and competitiveness in Raymond Lifestyle’s evolving market landscape.

2026-01-25.question: Which state has launched a ₹25,000 monthly support scheme for research scholars under the Atal Vichal Agragami scheme?
2026-01-25.explanation: Assam has introduced the Atal Vichal Agragami scheme to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹25,000 for research scholars and ₹40,000 for Divyang scholars, starting February 11, 2026. The scheme aims to reduce financial stress, promote innovation, and strengthen higher education and research across the state. By supporting scholars in universities and higher education institutions, Assam intends to foster an inclusive and knowledge-driven academic ecosystem, encourage interdisciplinary research, and position the state as a hub for innovation and academic excellence. This initiative also emphasizes social inclusion by offering higher support for differently-abled researchers.

2026-01-25.question: Who is set to take over as the new Group CEO of Eternal Group?
2026-01-25.explanation: Albinder Singh Dhindsa will assume the role of Group CEO at Eternal Group as part of a major leadership transition, while founder Deepinder Goyal steps down from the position but continues as Vice Chairman. Dhindsa’s appointment is aimed at ensuring operational execution, growth stability, and enhanced shareholder value, balancing managerial discipline with the company’s innovative vision. This leadership change, pending shareholder approval, reflects strategic continuity and allows Eternal Group to scale effectively while maintaining governance standards, marking an important shift in the company’s executive management.

2026-01-25.question: On which date is National Tourism Day observed in India?
2026-01-25.explanation: National Tourism Day is celebrated every year on January 25 in India to highlight the importance of tourism for economic growth, cultural preservation, and global recognition. The day encourages citizens to explore India’s diverse destinations while promoting responsible and sustainable travel practices. Activities include cultural programs, travel fairs, seminars, and awareness campaigns organised by tourism departments, educational institutions, and cultural organisations. By observing this day, India aims to strengthen tourism’s contribution to local livelihoods, heritage conservation, and international cultural exchange, making tourism a key driver of national development.

2026-01-25.question: On which date is National Voters Day observed in India?
2026-01-25.explanation: National Voters Day is celebrated every year on January 25 in India. This date marks the foundation day of the Election Commission of India, established on January 25, 1950, a day before India became a Republic. The day aims to promote voter awareness, increase voter registration, and encourage youth participation in elections. Special programs, including voter ID distribution, pledge ceremonies, and educational activities, are organized to strengthen democratic participation and instill a sense of civic duty among citizens, especially first-time voters. This observance highlights the importance of informed and responsible voting in a democracy.

2026-01-25.question: Who has been appointed as Deputy Inspector General (DIG) in the CRPF on central deputation by the Ministry of Home Affairs?
2026-01-25.explanation: Ravi Shankar Chhabi, a 2007-batch IPS officer of the Uttar Pradesh cadre, has been appointed as Deputy Inspector General (DIG) in the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) on central deputation. This key appointment, approved by the Ministry of Home Affairs, allows him to strengthen national-level internal security leadership. Prior to this, he served as DIG (Public Grievances) at the Uttar Pradesh DGP Headquarters, gaining experience in citizen-centric policing and administrative reforms. His diverse operational roles, including district policing, women's safety initiatives, prison administration, and election duties, equip him to handle strategic responsibilities in India’s premier paramilitary force.

2026-01-25.question: Which state has announced a new spaceport at Hope Island primarily for private launch missions?
2026-01-25.explanation: Andhra Pradesh has announced the establishment of a new spaceport at Hope Island under its Space City initiative. The facility is aimed at supporting private and commercial launch missions, complementing India’s existing space infrastructure at Satish Dhawan Space Centre and Kulasekharapatnam. The spaceport will focus on small and medium-lift launch vehicles, enabling startups and private companies to participate in the country’s growing space economy. Its strategic eastern coastal location leverages the equator’s advantage for fuel efficiency and launch optimisation, reflecting the state’s commitment to advancing India’s private space sector.

2026-01-24.question: On which date is National Girl Child Day observed every year in India?
2026-01-24.explanation: National Girl Child Day is observed on January 24 every year to highlight the importance of girls’ rights, education, health, and empowerment in Indian society. The date holds special historical significance as it marks the day when Indira Gandhi became India’s first woman Prime Minister in 1966, symbolising women’s leadership and potential. The observance aims to raise awareness about issues such as gender discrimination, child marriage, unequal access to education, and healthcare challenges faced by girls. Through awareness programmes and campaigns, the day encourages society to promote gender equality and create equal opportunities for every girl.

2026-01-24.question: Which Indian state has partnered with the United Arab Emirates to explore collaboration for developing Bharat Future City as a global urban hub?
2026-01-24.explanation: Telangana has emerged as a key player in global urban development through its partnership with the United Arab Emirates to develop Bharat Future City. The collaboration, discussed at the World Economic Forum 2026, focuses on creating India’s first net-zero greenfield smart city with an emphasis on sustainability, smart infrastructure, and innovation. The project aligns with the Telangana Rising 2047 vision, which aims to transform the state into a $3 trillion economy. By attracting international investments and forming strategic partnerships, the initiative positions the state as a future-ready global economic and urban centre.

2026-01-24.question: Which state government signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Starlink to enhance internet connectivity, digital governance, and disaster preparedness?
2026-01-24.explanation: Goa has taken a significant step toward digital transformation by signing an MoU with Starlink Satellite Communications to strengthen internet connectivity across the state. The partnership focuses on expanding high-speed satellite-based internet access, especially in remote and underserved areas, while also improving disaster preparedness and emergency response systems. By leveraging advanced communication technology, the initiative aims to modernise governance, bridge the digital divide, support tourism and investment, and enhance public service delivery. The collaboration reflects Goa’s vision of becoming a digitally empowered and resilient state with smart governance and inclusive digital growth.

2026-01-24.question: Which organisation won the SKOCH Award 2025 for developing an indigenous Cell Broadcast disaster alert system in India?
2026-01-24.explanation: C-DOT has been recognised with the SKOCH Award 2025 for its indigenous Cell Broadcast Solution, a unified national platform designed to deliver real-time disaster and emergency alerts directly to mobile phones. The system enables geo-targeted, multilingual warnings even during network congestion, ensuring timely communication in critical situations. By integrating multiple alert-generating agencies and following global standards such as the Common Alerting Protocol, the platform strengthens India’s disaster preparedness and resilience. This achievement highlights the organisation’s contribution to public safety, digital infrastructure, and the vision of self-reliant, citizen-centric technology.

2026-01-24.question: Across how many locations in India will Bharat Rang Mahotsav 2026 be held, making it the largest theatre festival in the world?
2026-01-24.explanation: Bharat Rang Mahotsav 2026 is recognised as the world’s largest international theatre festival because of its massive scale and nationwide reach. The festival will take place across 40 locations in India, covering metropolitan cities as well as remote and culturally significant regions. This extensive spread allows the theatre to reach diverse audiences and promotes cultural inclusivity. By bringing performances to multiple regions simultaneously, the festival strengthens artistic exchange, supports regional theatre, and highlights India’s rich theatrical heritage on a global platform.

2026-01-24.question: Which state witnessed the launch of India’s first integrated private satellite manufacturing unit at Sanand?
2026-01-24.explanation: Gujarat has marked a major milestone in India’s space and aerospace journey with the launch of the country’s first integrated private satellite manufacturing unit at Sanand. The facility, established by Azista Space, will enable end-to-end satellite manufacturing under one roof, reducing dependence on imports and promoting indigenous innovation. The project supports the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and reflects strong state government backing for advanced technologies. It is expected to generate high-skilled employment, attract advanced investments, and position the state as a growing hub for space technology and high-tech manufacturing in India.

2026-01-24.question: Which state signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Indo-Tibetan Border Police to launch the Swasth Seema Abhiyan for improving healthcare in border villages?
