By harnessing solar energy to power highway systems, the initiative contributes to lowering carbon emissions, promoting green mobility, and advancing India’s commitment toward achieving Net Zero emissions by 2070. It also serves as a benchmark for sustainable infrastructure development across the nation.

2025-11-12.question: In which city did the Indian Air Force organise its first-ever full-scale air show to celebrate the IAF’s 93rd anniversary?
2025-11-12.explanation: The Indian Air Force’s Eastern Air Command conducted its inaugural full-scale air show in Guwahati to commemorate the 93rd anniversary of the IAF. The spectacular event featured over 75 aircraft, including Rafale, Sukhoi, Mirage, and C-17, executing 25 coordinated formations above the Brahmaputra River. Operations were supported by seven regional bases to ensure precision and safety. The air show also included a cultural tribute to the late Assamese singer Zubeen Garg, with his popular song “Mayabini Ratir Bukut,” blending regional pride with national celebration and showcasing India’s growing air power and aviation excellence.

2025-11-12.question: Who won the 2025 Booker Prize for the novel "Flesh"?
2025-11-12.explanation: Hungarian-British writer David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize for his novel "Flesh", marking a historic win as the first author of his background to receive the honour. The novel is celebrated for its minimalist prose and powerful exploration of class, ambition, and masculinity. It follows a man’s rise from a modest Hungarian housing estate to the sophisticated world of London’s elite, reflecting themes of identity and power. Alongside the prestigious recognition, Szalay received a £50,000 cash prize, earning global literary acclaim and cementing his place among contemporary literary greats.

2025-11-12.question: Who won the silver medal in the men’s 50m rifle 3 positions event at the ISSF World Championships in Cairo?
2025-11-12.explanation: Aishwary Pratap Singh Tomar, an Indian Olympian shooter, won the silver medal in the men’s 50m rifle 3 positions event at the ISSF World Championships held in Cairo. He showcased remarkable consistency by equalling the world record in the qualification round with a score of 466.9, narrowly missing the gold to China’s Yukun Liu, who scored 467.1. This achievement reinforces Tomar’s reputation as one of India’s leading rifle shooters and adds to the country’s growing success in international shooting competitions, highlighting India’s rising stature in precision shooting sports globally.

2025-11-12.question: Who became the first Indian to be elected as President of the Organisation Internationale des Constructeurs d’Automobiles (OICA)?
2025-11-12.explanation: Shailesh Chandra, Managing Director and CEO of Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Tata Electric Mobility, has become the first Indian to be elected President of OICA (Organisation Internationale des Constructeurs d’Automobiles). Headquartered in Paris and founded in 1919, OICA represents the global automobile manufacturers’ community on key issues such as safety, emissions, and trade policy. Chandra’s appointment signifies India’s growing influence in global automotive governance, especially in electric mobility and sustainable transport. His leadership will help align India’s fast-evolving vehicle ecosystem with global standards while promoting EV innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainable manufacturing in the international automotive industry.

2025-11-12.question: In which state did MeitY and CERT-In launch the “Cyber Bharat Setu: Bridging States, Securing Bharat” workshop to enhance cyber resilience?
2025-11-12.explanation: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), in collaboration with CERT-In, organised the “Cyber Bharat Setu: Bridging States, Securing Bharat” workshop in Agartala, Tripura. The two-day event, held on November 11–12, 2025, aimed to strengthen cybersecurity awareness and capacity across government officials, law enforcement agencies, and students. Through practical drills and simulated cyber-attack exercises, the initiative sought to improve India’s digital defence preparedness, promote innovation in cyber practices, and build a cohesive national framework for proactive cyber resilience.

2025-11-11.question: Which country became the first South Asian nation to join the UN Water Convention in 2025?
2025-11-11.explanation: Bangladesh became the first South Asian country to join the UN Water Convention in 2025, marking a major milestone in transboundary water governance. Officially known as the Convention on the Protection and Use of Transboundary Watercourses and International Lakes, it provides a legally binding framework for the equitable and sustainable management of shared water bodies. By acceding to this treaty, Bangladesh aims to strengthen its position in addressing cross-border river issues, particularly with India, and to promote cooperative water management aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. This move enhances Bangladesh’s global engagement on environmental diplomacy and regional water security.

2025-11-11.question: Which country is participating with India in the joint military exercise Mitra Shakti 2025?
2025-11-11.explanation: Exercise Mitra Shakti 2025 is the 11ᵗʰ edition of the bilateral joint military exercise conducted between the armies of India and Sri Lanka. Held from 10 to 23 November 2025 at the Foreign Training Node in Belagavi, Karnataka, the exercise focuses on counter-terrorism, drone warfare, and UN peacekeeping operations. Indian troops from the Rajput Regiment and Sri Lankan soldiers from the Gajaba Regiment are participating in this edition. The exercise aims to strengthen interoperability, mutual trust, and coordination between the two nations, reflecting their shared commitment to regional peace, security, and defence cooperation in South Asia.

2025-11-11.question: What was India’s unemployment rate in the second quarter (Q2) of 2025 according to MoSPI’s Periodic Labour Force Survey?
2025-11-11.explanation: In Q2 2025, India’s unemployment rate for individuals aged 15 years and above fell to 5.2%, reflecting a modest but positive improvement in the labour market. This decline from 5.4% in Q1 2025 indicates better job creation and higher labour absorption, especially in rural areas supported by agricultural and government-led employment schemes like MGNREGA. The data, based on the Current Weekly Status (CWS) approach of MoSPI’s Periodic Labour Force Survey, also highlighted a rise in the female labour participation rate to 33.7% and a slight increase in the overall Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) to 55.1%, showing signs of gradual employment recovery.

2025-11-11.question: Which company launched the 7th-generation Ironwood TPU to compete with Nvidia’s AI dominance?
2025-11-11.explanation: Google introduced its 7th-generation Ironwood TPU, a cutting-edge AI processing unit designed to enhance the company’s cloud computing and machine learning capabilities. The Ironwood TPU is optimised for training and deploying large-scale AI models such as chatbots and digital assistants. Each Ironwood pod interconnects 9,216 TPUs, significantly reducing data bottlenecks and enabling seamless scaling of massive workloads. This innovation underscores Google’s commitment to advancing AI infrastructure and positioning itself as a formidable competitor to Nvidia in the field of high-performance computing and artificial intelligence development.

2025-11-11.question: Which organization has been granted Mini Ratna (Category-I) status by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh?
2025-11-11.explanation: Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), a public sector shipyard located in Visakhapatnam, has been granted Mini Ratna (Category-I) status by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh. The recognition was presented to HSL’s CMD, Cmde Girideep Singh, during the DPSU Annual Review Meeting held in New Delhi. Established originally as the Scindia Shipyard by industrialist Walchand Hirachand under The Scindia Steam Navigation Company Ltd, HSL has played a pivotal role in shipbuilding and naval support operations, significantly contributing to India’s maritime and defence capabilities over the decades.

2025-11-11.question: Which Indian state approved the Prohibition of Polygamy Bill 2025 to criminalise multiple marriages?
2025-11-11.explanation: The Assam government has approved the Assam Prohibition of Polygamy Bill 2025, marking a historic move to criminalise the practice of multiple marriages while a first marriage is still legally valid. The Bill proposes imprisonment of up to seven years for offenders and establishes a special compensation fund to support women affected by polygamous unions. It excludes Scheduled Tribes and areas under the Sixth Schedule, as well as certain pre-2005 Muslim marriages in Scheduled Areas. The legislation reinforces gender justice, promotes uniform marriage laws, and could serve as a legislative model for other Indian states pursuing similar reforms.

2025-11-11.question: Who has been selected as the next Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of GAIL (India) Limited?
2025-11-11.explanation: Deepak Gupta, currently serving as Director (Projects) at GAIL (India) Limited, has been recommended by the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) to be the next Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of the Maharatna PSU under the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas. With over 35 years of experience in the oil and gas sector, he is recognised for his expertise in project and construction management, digitization, and strategic reforms. A Mechanical Engineer from DTU and a PMP-certified professional, Gupta’s leadership is expected to strengthen GAIL’s project execution and innovation initiatives.

2025-11-11.question: In which country did India operate the Ayni Airbase, its only overseas military base, before withdrawing in 2022?
2025-11-11.explanation: The Ayni Airbase, located near Dushanbe in Tajikistan, was India’s only overseas military facility until its quiet withdrawal in 2022. Originally a Soviet-era base, Ayni was renovated by India’s Border Roads Organisation (BRO) in the early 2000s with an investment of around $80 million. The base featured a 3,200-metre runway, hangars, and fuel storage, and served as a key strategic outpost near Afghanistan, Pakistan, and China. India’s withdrawal followed the non-renewal of its lease by Tajikistan, reportedly under Russian and Chinese pressure, marking a significant reduction in India’s military footprint in Central Asia.

2025-11-11.question: Who has been appointed as the first woman to lead UN Tourism?
2025-11-11.explanation: Shaikha Nasser Al Nowais from the United Arab Emirates has been appointed as the first woman to head UN Tourism, marking a historic breakthrough in global tourism leadership. Her appointment was confirmed during the 123rd UN Tourism Executive Council session in Segovia, Spain, and she will assume office in January 2026 for a four-year term. With over 16 years of experience in corporate governance and tourism development, Al Nowais has held key roles including Corporate Vice President at Rotana Hotels and Chair of the Abu Dhabi Chamber’s Tourism Working Group. Her leadership emphasises sustainability, digital innovation, and women’s empowerment in global tourism.

2025-11-11.question: Which company partnered with Engineers India Limited (EIL) to collaborate on onshore projects in Saudi Arabia?
2025-11-11.explanation: Engineers India Limited (EIL), a Navratna PSU under the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with NMDC Energy, a UAE-based company, to jointly undertake onshore projects in Saudi Arabia. The partnership covers a wide range of sectors, including oil and gas, refineries, petrochemicals, pipelines, storage, and energy transition. The MoU was formalised at the ADIPEC 2025 event in Abu Dhabi, marking a significant collaboration in advancing cross-border energy infrastructure initiatives.

2025-11-11.question: With which country did India sign a Memorandum of Agreement on Mutual Submarine Search and Rescue Support in November 2025?
2025-11-11.explanation: India signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) on Mutual Submarine Search and Rescue Support with Vietnam during the 15th India–Vietnam Defence Policy Dialogue held in Hanoi in November 2025. The agreement, co-chaired by India’s Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh and Vietnam’s Deputy Defence Minister Sr Lt Gen Hoang Xuan Chien, aims to enhance cooperation in submarine rescue operations, ensure rapid assistance in emergencies, and strengthen interoperability between the two navies. Alongside, a Letter of Intent (LoI) was also signed to deepen collaboration in defence manufacturing and technology, reinforcing the India–Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and Indo-Pacific maritime security.

2025-11-11.question: On which date is National Education Day celebrated in India?
2025-11-11.explanation: National Education Day is celebrated every year on November 11 to commemorate the birth anniversary of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, India’s first Education Minister. The observance was initiated in 2008 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, now known as the Ministry of Education. Maulana Azad played a vital role in laying the foundation of India’s modern education system and establishing key institutions such as the University Grants Commission (UGC), Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs), and the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR), promoting learning and cultural development across the nation.

2025-11-11.question: In which city will the 2nd WHO Traditional Medicine Global Summit be held from December 17–19, 2025?
2025-11-11.explanation: The 2nd WHO Traditional Medicine Global Summit is scheduled to be held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, from December 17 to 19, 2025. Co-hosted by the World Health Organization (WHO) and India’s Ministry of AYUSH, the summit will bring together around 7,000 participants, including global health leaders, researchers, and traditional medicine practitioners. The event, themed “Restoring Balance: The Science and Practice of Health and Well-being,” aims to promote evidence-based traditional medicine, strengthen universal health coverage, and foster collaboration between science, innovation, and indigenous wisdom for sustainable healthcare development worldwide.

2025-11-10.question: What is the primary focus of the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority’s (IEPFA) financial awareness drive held in Karnal, Haryana?
2025-11-10.explanation: The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA), under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, organized a financial awareness drive aimed at empowering rural women. Conducted in Karnal, Haryana, under the theme “Viksit Bharat ke path par Saksham Naari,” the initiative focused on enhancing financial literacy, promoting safe investment practices, and fostering digital inclusion among women Self-Help Groups. Partnering with SEBI, AMFI, NCAER, and HSRLM, the program sought to strengthen financial independence and informed decision-making among rural women, contributing to inclusive economic growth and women’s empowerment in India.

2025-11-10.question: In which country was a new natural gas discovery announced in the Western Desert’s Badr-15 area?
2025-11-10.explanation: Egypt announced a major natural gas discovery in the Badr-15 area of its Western Desert, tapping into the Lower Bahariya reservoir. The find is expected to add approximately 15 billion cubic feet to Egypt’s gas reserves, with an initial production rate of about 16 million cubic feet per day. This discovery strengthens Egypt’s strategy to boost domestic energy production, reduce reliance on imports, and position itself as a key energy hub in the region. The Western Desert continues to be an important frontier for hydrocarbon exploration, offering significant economic and strategic benefits through expanded reserves and increased energy security.

2025-11-10.question: Which Indian Naval Ship arrived at Port Louis, Mauritius as part of an operational deployment?
2025-11-10.explanation: INS Savitri, an indigenously built Offshore Patrol Vessel constructed by Mazagon Dock Ltd, Mumbai, arrived at Port Louis, Mauritius as part of an operational deployment. Commissioned on 7 June 1990, the vessel operates under the Eastern Naval Command based at Visakhapatnam. Equipped with a 40×60 Bofors Gun and a helicopter deck for Chetak helicopter operations, INS Savitri is designed for aerial surveillance, search and rescue, and patrol missions. Its visit to Mauritius underscores India’s commitment to maritime cooperation, regional security, and fostering strong bilateral ties with Indian Ocean nations.

2025-11-10.question: In which city did the 18th Urban Mobility India (UMI) Conference 2025 conclude?
2025-11-10.explanation: The 18th Urban Mobility India (UMI) Conference 2025 was held in Gurugram, a rapidly developing city known for its modern infrastructure and urban mobility advancements. Hosting this prestigious event highlights Gurugram’s growing role as a hub for discussions and innovations in sustainable and smart urban transport solutions. The conference brought together policymakers, experts, and industry leaders to recognize and celebrate excellence in urban transport across Indian cities, promoting best practices and future-ready mobility systems.

2025-11-10.question: Where was the National Urban Conclave 2025 inaugurated by Union Minister Manohar Lal?
2025-11-10.explanation: The National Urban Conclave 2025 was inaugurated at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, by Union Minister Manohar Lal under the theme “Sustainable Urban Development and Governance.” The event marked the launch of several key initiatives, including the Dumpsite Remediation Accelerator Programme (DRAP), Urban Invest Window (UiWIN), Swachh Bharat Knowledge Management Unit, and Jal Hi Janani. DRAP aims to remediate 214 major dumpsites accounting for 80% of legacy waste. With participation from over 2,500 experts and policymakers, the conclave emphasized collaborative efforts toward cleaner, sustainable, and efficiently governed urban ecosystems in India.

2025-11-10.question: On which date is World Science Day for Peace and Development observed every year?
2025-11-10.explanation: World Science Day for Peace and Development is celebrated annually on November 10, as established by UNESCO in 2001. The day highlights the essential role science plays in promoting peace, sustainability, and global cooperation. It encourages young minds and students to explore how scientific innovation can solve real-world challenges such as climate change, health crises, and resource management. The 2025 theme, “Trust, transformation, and tomorrow: The science we need for 2050,” inspires youth to build trust in science, foster creativity, and use knowledge as a tool for advancing peace and sustainable development worldwide.

2025-11-10.question: Where was the two-day National Conference on India’s new criminal laws held on 8–9 November 2025?
2025-11-10.explanation: The two-day National Conference on the three new criminal laws was held at the National Judicial Academy in Bhopal. Organized by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and the Academy, the event focused on ushering India into a new era of criminal justice marked by transparency, technology, and victim-centric reforms. Home Secretary Govind Mohan emphasized the government’s commitment to a secure and efficient justice system. Key discussions revolved around initiatives like e-Sakshya, e-Summon, and Nyay Shruti, which aim to modernize legal processes and ensure swift, accessible, and fair delivery of justice across the country.

2025-11-10.question: Which Indian naval ship represented India at Exercise Malabar 2025 held in Guam, North Pacific?
2025-11-10.explanation: INS Sahyadri, an indigenously built Guided Missile Stealth Frigate, represented India at Exercise Malabar 2025 in Guam, North Pacific. This exercise, the 28th edition under the Quad framework involving India, the U.S., Japan, and Australia, focuses on strengthening naval cooperation and enhancing maritime interoperability. INS Sahyadri’s participation demonstrates India’s commitment to regional security, technological self-reliance, and operational readiness. The event included both a Harbour Phase for planning and a Sea Phase with joint fleet maneuvers, anti-submarine warfare, and gunnery operations, emphasizing collaboration among Quad nations.

2025-11-10.question: Which institute partnered with C-DOT to establish a Centre of Excellence in telecom and cybersecurity research?
2025-11-10.explanation: The Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT), the premier R&D centre under the Department of Telecommunications, signed a Memorandum of Understanding with IIT Gandhinagar to establish a Centre of Excellence (CoE) dedicated to telecom and cybersecurity research. This collaboration aims to integrate C-DOT’s technological expertise with IIT Gandhinagar’s strong academic and research foundation. The CoE will focus on advancing innovation in areas such as artificial intelligence, quantum communication, and next-generation mobile networks, thereby enhancing India’s capabilities in secure and future-ready telecom infrastructure and fostering deeper academia-industry cooperation.

2025-11-10.question: Which Indian state launched the country’s first tribal-focused genome sequencing project?
2025-11-10.explanation: Gujarat became the first Indian state to launch a tribal-focused genome sequencing project aimed at tackling genetic disorders such as sickle cell anaemia and thalassemia through precision medicine. Implemented by the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre (GBRC), the initiative forms part of the national Genome India Project. It focuses on sequencing 2,000 tribal genomes across 17 districts to identify genetic mutations and hereditary disease patterns. By developing affordable diagnostic kits and promoting genetic counselling, the project aims to improve healthcare access for tribal populations while advancing India’s capabilities in biotechnology-driven public health innovation and preventive medicine.

2025-11-09.question: Who was the pioneering molecular biologist credited with co-discovering the double helix structure of DNA and later leading the Human Genome Project?
2025-11-09.explanation: James D. Watson was an American molecular biologist who, along with Francis H.C. Crick, discovered the double helix structure of DNA in 1953 — a groundbreaking model that transformed the study of genetics. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 1962 for this discovery. Watson later became the director of Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory and led the Human Genome Project, contributing to the mapping of over 3 billion base pairs of human DNA. His legacy, while marked by controversy, remains central to modern molecular biology.

2025-11-09.question: How many new butterfly species were discovered in Arunachal Pradesh’s Siang Valley, linking the ecosystems of Tibet and India?
2025-11-09.explanation: Six new butterfly species have been discovered in Arunachal Pradesh’s Siang Valley, highlighting the region’s exceptional ecological diversity. This discovery establishes a biological link between Tibet’s Yarlung Tsangpo and India’s Brahmaputra basin, emphasizing the shared evolutionary and environmental characteristics of the two regions. The finding also underscores the importance of community-based conservation efforts, which play a crucial role in protecting this biodiversity hotspot from threats like hydropower projects and climate change. Such studies not only expand scientific knowledge of Himalayan fauna but also strengthen global conservation strategies for fragile mountain ecosystems.

2025-11-09.question: Which Indian AI platform developed by the Indus Valley Group aims to become the world’s most affordable homegrown AI solution ensuring data sovereignty?
2025-11-09.explanation: Atomesus is an Indian AI platform developed by the Indus Valley Group, designed to be the world’s most affordable and secure homegrown AI system. Built by young innovators with ISRO-linked experience, it employs a hybrid intelligence model that merges proprietary technologies with India-based secure integration. The project emphasises data sovereignty and aims to democratise access to AI for students, startups, and enterprises worldwide. By focusing on affordability, accessibility, and local innovation, Atomesus seeks to position India as a global leader in ethical and inclusive artificial intelligence development.

2025-11-09.question: The Ramnami tribe, known for tattooing the name “Ram” on their bodies and homes, originates from which Indian state?
2025-11-09.explanation: The Ramnami tribe originates from Chhattisgarh and is renowned for its unique devotional practice of inscribing the name “Ram” on their bodies and homes as an expression of faith. Founded in the 19th century by Parsuram Bhardwaj, the community emphasises devotion, equality, and rejection of caste hierarchy. They follow a formless concept of divinity and uphold gender equality as part of their spiritual philosophy. Each year, the tribe celebrates their faith through the Bhajan Mela in Sarsiwa, where devotees gather to sing hymns from the Ramcharitmanas and honour the “Ram” jayostambh, symbolizing unity and devotion.

2025-11-09.question: What is the name of the global campaign launched by UPL to recognise farmers as key agents of climate resilience ahead of COP30 in Brazil?
2025-11-09.explanation: #AFarmerCan is a global campaign launched by UPL to celebrate farmers as central figures in driving climate resilience and sustainable agriculture. Introduced ahead of COP30 in Brazil, the campaign shares 20 farmer stories worldwide, demonstrating how local practices can contribute to global climate goals. UPL’s initiative is built on a four-pillar framework — Pay, Protect, Procure, Promote — designed to empower and reward climate-smart farming. By highlighting the critical role of farmers in environmental stewardship, the campaign aims to shift public perception and promote a more sustainable and equitable global food system.

2025-11-09.question: Which country, along with the United States, signed a joint framework to strengthen critical mineral and rare earth supply chains?
2025-11-09.explanation: Japan partnered with the United States to establish a joint framework focused on securing and strengthening the supply chains of critical minerals and rare earth elements essential for advanced technologies such as electric vehicles, batteries, and renewable energy systems. The agreement emphasises coordinated investment, fair market practices, and resilient bilateral supply chains across the stages of extraction, separation, and processing. Through this collaboration, both countries aim to reduce dependency on single-source suppliers, diversify global mineral resources, and enhance economic and strategic stability in the rapidly evolving clean technology and semiconductor sectors.

2025-11-09.question: On which date is National Legal Services Day observed every year in India?
2025-11-09.explanation: National Legal Services Day is observed annually on November 9 to commemorate the enforcement of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, which came into effect on this day in 1995. The day highlights India’s commitment to ensuring equal access to justice for all, especially the poor and disadvantaged. It promotes awareness about citizens’ legal rights and strengthens mechanisms for free legal aid through the three-tier system — National, State, and District Legal Services Authorities. The observance reinforces the principle that justice must be affordable, accessible, and inclusive for every citizen.

2025-11-09.question: By which year has the European Union set its target to achieve a 90% reduction in emissions from 1990 levels?
2025-11-09.explanation: The European Union has established 2040 as the target year to achieve a 90% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions compared to 1990 levels. This goal includes an allowance for up to 5% of reductions through foreign carbon credits, effectively making domestic cuts 85%. The agreement introduces a carbon credit pilot phase (2031–2035), aiming to balance environmental responsibility with economic realities. Although the plan demonstrates strong climate ambition, some critics express concern that the flexibility provided by carbon credits may weaken the EU’s overall emission integrity. Nonetheless, the 2040 goal marks a critical step toward carbon neutrality.

2025-11-09.question: Which African nation is set to receive a USD 200 million Line of Credit from India to support its defence modernisation efforts?
2025-11-09.explanation: Angola is the African nation partnering with India to strengthen cooperation in defence and energy sectors. India is finalising a USD 200 million Line of Credit to assist Angola’s defence modernisation, reflecting growing strategic and developmental ties. The two countries are also expanding their USD 5 billion energy partnership, primarily driven by oil trade, which plays a crucial role in India’s energy security. This collaboration aligns with India’s broader South-South cooperation framework, aimed at fostering sustainable development, capacity building, and mutual growth with partner nations across Africa and the Global South.

2025-11-09.question: Which Indian state, known as the "Land of the Gods," celebrates its Foundation Day on November 9 to mark its formation in the year 2000?
2025-11-09.explanation: Uttarakhand celebrates its Foundation Day every year on November 9, commemorating its creation as India’s 27th state in the year 2000, after being carved out of Uttar Pradesh. Originally named Uttaranchal, it was officially renamed Uttarakhand in 2007 to reflect its cultural and historical identity. In 2025, the state observes its Silver Jubilee (25 years) of formation with grand celebrations highlighting its progress in tourism, education, infrastructure, and sustainability. Known as Devbhoomi, or the Land of the Gods, Uttarakhand holds immense spiritual and ecological significance in India’s landscape.

2025-11-08.question: On which date is World Radiography Day observed every year to commemorate the discovery of X-rays?
2025-11-08.explanation: World Radiography Day is celebrated annually on November 8 to mark the discovery of X-rays by German physicist Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen in 1895. The day honours radiographers and radiologists for their critical role in healthcare, highlighting how imaging technologies such as X-rays, CT, MRI, and AI-driven diagnostics revolutionize medical science by enabling early detection and accurate treatment. It also emphasizes the importance of safety, precision, and compassionate care in radiological practices. Observed globally since 2007, the day reminds the world of radiography’s essential contribution to saving lives and advancing modern medicine.

2025-11-08.question: Who became the first Indian para-archer to be selected for the able-bodied national archery team?
2025-11-08.explanation: Sheetal Devi, an 18-year-old para-archer from Jammu and Kashmir, made history by becoming the first Indian para-athlete to join the able-bodied national archery team. Born with phocomelia, a condition that left her without arms, she adapted her technique to shoot using her legs and shoulders. Her remarkable performances—winning medals at the Asian Para Games, World Championships, and Paralympics—earned her a spot in the compound women’s team for the Asia Cup 2025 in Jeddah. Her selection reflects a monumental step toward inclusivity, merit-based recognition, and breaking barriers in Indian sports.

2025-11-08.question: Which country commissioned its third and most advanced aircraft carrier, the Fujian, equipped with EMALS technology?
2025-11-08.explanation: China has commissioned its third and most advanced aircraft carrier, Fujian, marking a significant milestone in its naval modernization and maritime power projection. Launched in November 2025 at Sanya Port, Hainan, the Fujian is China’s first flat-deck carrier equipped with the Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS)—a cutting-edge technology previously used only by the U.S. Navy. With a displacement of around 80,000 tonnes and all-electric propulsion, it enables smoother and faster aircraft launches, enhancing strike range and combat readiness. The Fujian joins Liaoning and Shandong in China’s carrier fleet, showcasing Beijing’s growing ambitions in the South China Sea and Indo-Pacific region.

2025-11-08.question: Which Indian aerospace company signed a $1 billion deal with GE for 113 F404 engines to power the LCA Tejas Mk 1A jets?
2025-11-08.explanation: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) signed a $1 billion agreement with General Electric (GE) for the supply of 113 F404-GE-IN20 engines, which will power 97 LCA Tejas Mk 1A fighter jets of the Indian Air Force. This deal marks a crucial milestone in India’s quest for self-reliance in defence manufacturing and strengthens the indigenous aircraft production ecosystem. The F404 engines are known for their reliability, high performance, and compatibility with advanced fighter systems. This partnership not only supports Tejas Mk 1A production but also paves the way for future collaboration on F414 engines for the LCA Mk 2, enhancing India’s aerospace capabilities.

2025-11-08.question: In which year is India scheduled to conduct the next All India Tiger Estimation (AITE), the world’s largest wildlife survey?
2025-11-08.explanation: The next All India Tiger Estimation (AITE) will be conducted in 2026, marking it as the world’s largest wildlife survey. India, home to over 75% of the global wild tiger population, will use a mix of ground tracking, satellite technology, and AI-based camera traps to ensure scientific accuracy and ecosystem-wide assessment. Building on the 2022 survey that recorded 3,682 tigers, the 2026 census aims to evaluate not just tiger numbers but also habitat health, prey density, and human-wildlife interactions. With participation from over 60,000 forest personnel, this massive operation reinforces India’s leadership in global wildlife conservation.

2025-11-08.question: Who became India’s 91st Chess Grandmaster after winning the ASEAN Championship 2025?
2025-11-08.explanation: Raahul VS became India’s 91st Chess Grandmaster after an impressive performance at the 6th ASEAN Individual Championship 2025, where he clinched the title with a round to spare. His victory highlights India’s continued dominance and depth in global chess. Raahul had earlier achieved his International Master title in 2021 and demonstrated consistent progress toward the GM title through his exceptional tournament performances. This accomplishment follows recent successes by Illamparthi AR and S Rohith Krishna, showcasing a strong new generation of Indian chess players achieving international recognition and strengthening India’s position as a powerhouse in the chess world.

2025-11-08.question: Which country conducted the strategic Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test designated GT-254 from Vandenberg Space Force Base in November 2025?
2025-11-08.explanation: The United States conducted the Minuteman III ICBM test (GT-254) from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, on November 5, 2025. The test involved launching an unarmed missile toward the central Pacific near the Ronald Reagan Ballistic Missile Defense Test Site (Kwajalein Atoll) to validate reliability, accuracy, and readiness of the US land-based nuclear deterrent. The launch also verified the Airborne Launch Control System (ALCS) using an E-6B aircraft, ensuring redundant command-and-control capability. While the timing drew global attention due to concurrent nuclear policy debates, US officials clarified that it was a routine operational readiness test supporting strategic stability and deterrence credibility.

2025-11-08.question: In which city was India’s first fully digital museum dedicated to tribal freedom fighters inaugurated?
2025-11-08.explanation: India’s first Digital Museum of Tribal Freedom Fighters was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Nava Raipur, Atal Nagar, Chhattisgarh. Officially named the Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh Memorial and Tribal Freedom Fighters Museum, it honours tribal warriors who resisted British rule and contributed to India’s independence movement. The museum uses cutting-edge digital technology, including VFX projections, QR-coded storytelling, and interactive screens, to create an immersive educational experience. It celebrates figures like Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh and showcases historic tribal revolts such as the Halba Rebellion and Bhumkal Movement, promoting both cultural preservation and tourism in Nava Raipur.

2025-11-08.question: Which Indian bank became the first to cross both $100 billion in market capitalisation and ₹100 trillion in total business?
2025-11-08.explanation: The State Bank of India (SBI) achieved a landmark milestone by surpassing $100 billion in market capitalisation and ₹100 trillion in total business, marking a historic first in India’s banking history. This achievement highlights SBI’s dominant position in retail, SME, and corporate lending, backed by strong Q2 FY26 financial performance and 12.7% year-on-year credit growth. With total deposits around ₹55.9 lakh crore and advances of ₹44.2 lakh crore, SBI’s robust digital transformation, improving asset quality, and investor confidence have propelled it into the elite global banking league. Headquartered in Mumbai, SBI continues to be the backbone of India’s financial ecosystem.

2025-11-08.question: How many new Vande Bharat Express trains were flagged off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi from Varanasi?
2025-11-08.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off four new Vande Bharat Express trains from Varanasi, marking a significant milestone in India’s ongoing railway modernization efforts. The newly launched routes include Banaras–Khajuraho, Lucknow–Saharanpur, Firozpur–Delhi, and Ernakulam–Bengaluru. These trains are designed to enhance regional connectivity, reduce travel time, and offer modern comfort through energy-efficient and high-speed rail technology. The initiative strengthens intercity travel, boosts tourism, and supports economic growth across northern and southern India. Each route strategically connects cultural, commercial, and technological hubs, aligning with the government’s broader vision for efficient and self-reliant rail infrastructure.

2025-11-07.question: Which company partnered with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) to enhance digital design skills in ITIs and NSTIs?
2025-11-07.explanation: The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), through the Directorate General of Training (DGT), signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Autodesk Inc. on November 6, 2025. This partnership aims to modernize India’s vocational training ecosystem by integrating Autodesk’s advanced design and manufacturing tools into Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) and National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs). The initiative will train both students and instructors in digital prototyping, CAD, and AI-enhanced design systems, making India’s vocational workforce more future-ready. By embedding these skills early, the collaboration supports innovation, employability, and industry-aligned technical education.

2025-11-07.question: Which country is set to join the U.S.-brokered Abraham Accords, marking a major diplomatic shift in Central Asia?
2025-11-07.explanation: Kazakhstan is poised to become the newest member of the Abraham Accords, a U.S.-brokered framework that normalizes relations between Israel and Muslim-majority nations. Announced by U.S. President Donald Trump on November 6, 2025, this development expands the accords’ influence beyond the Arab world into Central Asia. Kazakhstan’s entry signifies its intent to strengthen diplomatic, economic, and security ties with Israel and other signatories. The move aligns with its foreign policy of dialogue and regional stability, while also advancing the U.S. strategy of deepening engagement with Central Asian nations traditionally within Russia and China’s spheres of influence.

2025-11-07.question: Which bird species has vanished from 72% of its historical nesting sites in India, according to a Wildlife Institute of India report?
2025-11-07.explanation: A nationwide survey conducted by the Wildlife Institute of India revealed that vultures have disappeared from 72% of their historical nesting sites across India, with only 120 out of 425 sites still active. Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan together account for 63% of the remaining nests, most of which are located in protected areas. The report also identified 93 new nesting sites. Notably, the Slender-billed vulture has lost all 47 of its previous nesting sites, with major threats including habitat destruction, poisoning from toxic veterinary drugs, and attacks by feral dogs.

2025-11-07.question: What percentage of its stake in SBI Funds Management Ltd (SBIFML) has the State Bank of India (SBI) approved to divest through an IPO?
2025-11-07.explanation: State Bank of India (SBI) has approved the divestment of a 6.3% stake, equivalent to 3.2 crore shares, in its subsidiary SBI Funds Management Ltd (SBIFML) via an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Additionally, its co-promoter, Amundi India Holding, will sell 3.7%, making the total IPO size 10% of equity. This move aims to unlock value and prepare SBIFML for its public listing in 2026, marking it as SBI’s third listed subsidiary after SBI Cards and SBI Life Insurance.

2025-11-07.question: Which city was ranked the cleanest in India in October 2025, according to CREA’s Air Quality Snapshot?
2025-11-07.explanation: As per the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) Air Quality Snapshot for October 2025, Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya, recorded the cleanest air in India with an average PM2.5 concentration of just 10 μg/m³. In contrast, Dharuhera in Haryana topped the list of polluted cities with a PM2.5 level of 123 μg/m³, while other highly polluted cities included Ghaziabad, Delhi, and Noida. The report emphasized the need for consistent and year-round air quality management rather than short-term, seasonal interventions such as the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP).

2025-11-07.question: Which country celebrated 100 years of hockey excellence?
2025-11-07.explanation: India celebrated a century of hockey excellence at the Major Dhyan Chand Stadium in New Delhi, marking 100 years of remarkable achievements in the sport. The event was jointly organized by the Sports Authority of India and Hockey India, with participation from Union ministers, the FIH President, and legendary hockey players. Highlights included the launch of a commemorative book and a special exhibition showcasing India’s rich hockey legacy. The celebration also featured a friendly match where the Sports Ministry XI triumphed over the Hockey India XI 3–1, symbolizing India’s enduring passion and success in hockey.

2025-11-07.question: Which institution patented an AI-based system to decode rainfall data using radar signals?
2025-11-07.explanation: The Cochin University of Science & Technology (CUSAT) has patented an advanced machine learning system designed to accurately decode rainfall information from radar signals. Developed at the Advanced Centre for Atmospheric Radar Research (ACARR), the innovation employs a Hybrid Adaptive Bi-Gaussian Algorithm integrated with a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to distinguish between raindrop and turbulence echoes in real time. This AI-driven approach enhances the precision of monsoon monitoring and flood forecasting, significantly improving Kerala’s climate resilience and contributing to the advancement of atmospheric and environmental research in India.

2025-11-07.question: In which city did RITES Ltd sign an MoU with DGNP for naval infrastructure projects?
2025-11-07.explanation: RITES Ltd, a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Directorate General of Naval Projects (DGNP) in Mumbai to provide consultancy services for naval infrastructure development in the Mumbai region. The services will cover soil studies, feasibility analysis, detailed project reports, structural design, project management, and third-party inspection. This partnership aims to improve planning, design, and execution efficiency for Indian Navy infrastructure projects, strengthening defence-related construction capabilities in the Mumbai area.

2025-11-07.question: Which country recorded the highest absolute rise in greenhouse gas emissions in 2023–24, according to the UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2025?
2025-11-07.explanation: According to the UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2025, titled Off Target, India registered the highest absolute increase in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions during 2023–24, amounting to 165 million tonnes. Despite this rise, India continues to maintain one of the lowest per capita emissions among major global economies. The report highlights that the G20 nations collectively saw an emissions increase of 22 million tonnes in the same period. With the world projected to warm by 2.8°C—far exceeding the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C goal—India faces growing pressure ahead of the COP30 climate summit to adopt stronger mitigation measures.

2025-11-07.question: Which state government released a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for making farm tools more women-friendly?
2025-11-07.explanation: The Odisha government introduced a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) on November 4, 2025, to ensure farm equipment is ergonomically designed for women farmers. The initiative focuses on reducing physical strain, pain, and health issues faced by women due to the use of tools originally made for men. Since more than half of women farmers experience musculoskeletal disorders from male-centric implements, this SOP—developed under the Shree Anna Abhiyan pilot projects—will help test and refine both existing and new farm tools to promote inclusivity and improve agricultural productivity in Odisha.

2025-11-06.question: Who has been appointed as the brand ambassador for Paradeep Phosphates Ltd. to promote sustainable farming in India?
2025-11-06.explanation: Cricket legend Rahul Dravid has been appointed as the brand ambassador for Paradeep Phosphates Ltd. (PPL) to promote sustainable farming and balanced fertiliser use across India. Announced on 5 November 2025, this collaboration leverages Dravid’s reputation for integrity and discipline to connect with farmers and drive awareness about soil health and efficient nutrient management. Through campaigns like “Kheti Ka Game Changer” and “NPK and Organic Fertilisers Ki Winning Team,” the initiative aims to simplify agronomy using cricket-inspired themes, supporting national programmes such as the NMSA and PM-PRANAM for sustainable agriculture.

2025-11-06.question: Which Indian company has partnered with US-based General Atomics Aeronautical Systems (GA-ASI) to manufacture Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS) for the Indian Army?
2025-11-06.explanation: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has entered into a strategic partnership with US-based General Atomics Aeronautical Systems (GA-ASI) to jointly produce Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS) for the Indian Army. Under this collaboration, L&T will act as the prime bidder for the 87 MALE RPAS programme, while GA-ASI will serve as the technology partner. This agreement strengthens India’s Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative by boosting indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and promoting greater Indo-US cooperation in the aerospace and defence sectors.

2025-11-06.question: What is the name of Google’s project to build AI data centres in space using solar-powered satellites?
2025-11-06.explanation: Google’s Project Suncatcher is an ambitious initiative aimed at building AI data centres in orbit, powered by solar energy. The project plans to deploy satellites equipped with TPUs, solar panels, and high-speed optical communication systems to form a distributed computing network around Earth. By operating in space, these AI data centres would have uninterrupted access to solar power, eliminate the need for water-based cooling, and reduce carbon emissions. While promising a sustainable and scalable alternative to traditional data centres, Project Suncatcher still faces major engineering challenges related to communication, station-keeping, and radiation resistance in space.

2025-11-06.question: At which airport did the DRI seize ₹42 crore worth of hydroponic weed under “Operation Weed Out”?
2025-11-06.explanation: Under “Operation Weed Out,” the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) in Mumbai seized 42.34 kg of high-grade hydroponic weed valued at ₹42 crore from two passengers arriving from Bangkok. The contraband was cleverly hidden inside food packets and intercepted at Mumbai Airport. This major bust came shortly after a ₹47 crore cocaine seizure, pushing the total drug recovery value beyond ₹100 crore in just three days. The operation highlights the DRI’s continued vigilance and commitment to combating sophisticated drug-smuggling networks in support of the “Nasha Mukt Bharat” initiative.

2025-11-06.question: On which date is the International Day for Preventing the Exploitation of the Environment in War and Armed Conflict observed each year?
2025-11-06.explanation: The International Day for Preventing the Exploitation of the Environment in War and Armed Conflict is observed annually on November 6. Established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2001 through Resolution A/RES/56/4, the day aims to highlight the often-overlooked environmental consequences of warfare. It emphasizes that the environment, frequently a silent casualty of war, must be protected even amid conflict. The observance also supports global peace, sustainability, and the UN’s 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, aligning with key goals such as Climate Action, Life on Land, and Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions.

2025-11-06.question: Who won his first Rolex Paris Masters title and reclaimed the World No. 1 ranking?
2025-11-06.explanation: Jannik Sinner, the 24-year-old Italian tennis player, clinched his maiden Rolex Paris Masters title by defeating Felix Auger-Aliassime 6-4, 7-6(4) in the final. This victory marked his fifth ATP Masters 1000 crown and his return to the World No. 1 position in the PIF ATP Rankings. Sinner’s achievement also extended his impressive streak to 26 consecutive indoor match wins. Notably, he became the first player since Carlos Alcaraz in 2023 to win a Masters title without dropping a single set, underscoring his consistency and dominance on indoor courts.

2025-11-06.question: By which year is India’s bioeconomy projected to reach $300 billion according to NITI Aayog?
2025-11-06.explanation: According to NITI Aayog’s report titled “Reimagining Agriculture: A Roadmap for Frontier Technology Led Transformation,” India’s bioeconomy is expected to reach $300 billion by the year 2030. The projection covers key sectors such as agriculture, forestry, fisheries, and aquaculture. The report emphasizes the use of frontier technologies like artificial intelligence, digital twins, precision farming, and climate-resilient seeds to drive sustainable productivity growth. Under the leadership of NITI Aayog CEO BVR Subrahmanyam, this vision aims to position India as a global leader in bio-based innovation and economic transformation.

2025-11-06.question: Which subcutaneous treatment combines trastuzumab and pertuzumab for HER2-positive breast cancer?
2025-11-06.explanation: Phesgo is a subcutaneous treatment that combines two monoclonal antibodies—trastuzumab and pertuzumab—into a single under-the-skin injection. It significantly reduces hospital time from around 2.5 hours to just 5–8 minutes while maintaining the same safety and efficacy as intravenous therapy. Designed for HER2-positive breast cancer, which accounts for about 20–25% of all breast cancer cases, Phesgo represents a major advancement in making cancer care more convenient, patient-centered, and efficient by simplifying the treatment process without compromising medical outcomes.

2025-11-06.question: What is India’s global rank in the clean industrial project pipeline?
2025-11-06.explanation: India has secured the third position globally in the clean industrial project pipeline, following China and the United States. With 65 large-scale low-emission industrial projects, India demonstrates its strong commitment to decarbonizing sectors such as chemicals, steel, cement, and aviation. The nation’s clean industry pipeline represents an investment potential exceeding $150 billion and the creation of nearly 200,000 jobs. Although only six projects have reached the investment stage, this ranking highlights India’s expanding role as a key player in sustainable industrial transformation aligned with its net-zero by 2070 target.

2025-11-06.question: Which Indian state signed an ₹8,000 crore MoU with GSC PSP Maha Pvt Ltd for the 1,500 MW Panchmauli-Devalipada Pumped Storage Hydroelectric Project?
2025-11-06.explanation: The ₹8,000 crore MoU for the 1,500 MW Panchmauli-Devalipada Pumped Storage Hydroelectric Project was signed by the Maharashtra government with GSC PSP Maha Pvt Ltd. This large-scale renewable energy initiative, located in Dhule and Nandurbar districts, aims to generate 2,500 jobs and ₹1,100 crore annual revenue. By utilizing 19.29 TMC of initial water storage, the project demonstrates Maharashtra’s commitment to expanding sustainable power infrastructure and strengthening its position in India’s renewable energy sector.

2025-11-06.question: Which Indian state became the first to partner with Elon Musk’s Starlink for satellite-based internet services?
2025-11-06.explanation: Maharashtra became the first Indian state to sign a formal agreement with Elon Musk’s Starlink, a SpaceX initiative, to deliver satellite-based internet across remote and underserved areas. Through this partnership, Starlink’s low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite technology will provide high-speed, low-latency internet to government institutions, rural and tribal communities, and aspirational districts such as Gadchiroli, Nandurbar, Washim, and Dharashiv. The initiative supports the state’s “Digital Maharashtra” mission by enhancing e-governance, telemedicine, online education, and disaster response systems while strengthening connectivity in regions with limited terrestrial infrastructure.

2025-11-05.question: Which Indian state has launched the Artificial Intelligence Innovation Hub in Hyderabad to drive AI research and global collaboration by 2035?
2025-11-05.explanation: Telangana has launched the Telangana Artificial Intelligence Innovation Hub (TAIH) in Hyderabad to establish itself as a global leader in emerging technologies by 2035. Spearheaded by Minister D. Sridhar Babu, the hub aims to unite academia, industry and startups to advance AI-based innovation and research. Collaborators include institutions such as IIT Hyderabad, BITS Pilani, ISB, and global tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. The initiative reflects Telangana’s strategic transition from an IT-services powerhouse to a frontier technology leader and aligns with India’s national focus on AI-driven innovation and digital growth.

2025-11-05.question: Which country was severely affected by Typhoon Kalmaegi, also known locally as Tino, causing 26 deaths and widespread destruction in November 2025?
2025-11-05.explanation: Typhoon Kalmaegi, locally called Tino, struck the Philippines in early November 2025 with powerful winds reaching 205 km/h, devastating the Visayas region. The typhoon triggered floods, landslides, and 3-meter storm surges, heavily damaging provinces such as Cebu, Leyte, Samar, and Negros Occidental. At least 26 people lost their lives, primarily in Cebu, and hundreds of thousands were displaced as homes, infrastructure, and power systems were destroyed. The event underscored the Philippines’ continued vulnerability to intense tropical cyclones fueled by climate change and highlighted the urgent need for resilient infrastructure and disaster preparedness across coastal communities.

2025-11-05.question: Who was elected as the Mayor of New York City, becoming the city’s first Muslim and first person of South Asian descent to hold the office?
2025-11-05.explanation: Zohran Mamdani was elected as the Mayor of New York City on 4 November 2025, marking a historic moment in American urban politics. He became the city’s first Muslim mayor, the first person of South Asian descent, and the youngest individual in over a century to hold the post. Born in Uganda to Indian-origin parents, Mamdani’s progressive platform emphasised social equity through measures like free bus services, universal childcare, rent freezes, and higher minimum wages. His election represents a generational shift, greater diversity in city leadership, and the growing influence of progressive politics in major U.S. cities.

2025-11-05.question: Who has assumed charge as the Director General of the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) effective 1 November 2025?
2025-11-05.explanation: Shri Sanjay Garg, a 1994-batch IAS officer from the Kerala cadre, has taken charge as the Director General of the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) from 1 November 2025. With over three decades of administrative experience, he has contributed significantly to policy formulation, planning, and implementation across various national sectors. Prior to this role, he served as Additional Secretary at the Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE) and as Secretary at ICAR, where he led digital transformation initiatives, including the expansion of the Kisan Sarathi portal aimed at empowering farmers through real-time advisory services.

2025-11-05.question: Which Indian city was declared a UNESCO Creative City in the field of Gastronomy in 2025?
2025-11-05.explanation: Lucknow has been declared a UNESCO Creative City under the Gastronomy category in 2025, joining the UNESCO Creative Cities Network (UCCN). Established in 2004, the UCCN promotes creativity as a core pillar of sustainable urban development. This recognition highlights Lucknow’s centuries-old culinary heritage rooted in Awadhi cuisine, known for its kebabs, biryanis, and refined cooking traditions. With this inclusion, Lucknow joins other Indian cities like Jaipur (Crafts and Folk Art), Varanasi and Chennai (Music), Hyderabad (Gastronomy), Mumbai (Film), and Srinagar (Crafts and Folk Art), further showcasing India’s cultural and creative diversity on a global platform.

2025-11-05.question: To which country did India export its first consignment of fortified rice from Chhattisgarh in 2025?
2025-11-05.explanation: India exported 12 metric tonnes of fortified rice kernels (FRK) from Chhattisgarh to Costa Rica, marking a milestone in nutrition-oriented trade and global food diplomacy. Facilitated by APEDA, this initiative highlights India’s growing role in promoting food fortification technology and combating micronutrient deficiencies worldwide. Fortified rice, enriched with iron, folic acid, and vitamin B12, is already used domestically under the Poshan Abhiyan. This export strengthens Chhattisgarh’s reputation as the “Rice Bowl of India,” while aligning with India’s goal to merge agricultural innovation with global health and trade initiatives, enhancing both economic and diplomatic engagement.

2025-11-05.question: Which Indian cooperative organisation secured the top rank globally in the 2025 International Cooperative Alliance (ICA) World Cooperative Monitor rankings?
2025-11-05.explanation: Amul, managed by the Gujarat Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation (GCMMF), secured the No. 1 global ranking in the 2025 ICA World Cooperative Monitor, followed by IFFCO at second place. This milestone highlights India’s leadership in cooperative governance and its success in promoting inclusive rural growth. Amul’s three-tier cooperative model connects millions of dairy farmers to national and international markets, ensuring fair income and empowerment for producers. Its achievements in innovation, value addition, and sustainability have transformed India’s dairy sector into a global model of cooperative excellence. The recognition also strengthens India’s vision of “Sahkar Se Samriddhi.”

2025-11-05.question: On which date is World Tsunami Awareness Day 2025 observed globally to promote tsunami preparedness and early-warning systems?
2025-11-05.explanation: World Tsunami Awareness Day is observed every year on November 5, as designated by the United Nations General Assembly in 2015. The date was inspired by the Japanese legend of Inamura-no-hi (“The Burning of the Rice Sheaves”), where a farmer saved villagers by warning them of an incoming tsunami. The 2025 theme, “Be Tsunami Ready: Invest in Tsunami Preparedness,” stresses the importance of early-warning systems, community training, and resilient infrastructure. With more than 700 million people living in tsunami-prone areas worldwide, the observance reinforces the urgent need for awareness, preparedness, and global cooperation to reduce disaster risks.

2025-11-05.question: With which country did India sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) at the 17th Joint Working Group meeting to strengthen defence cooperation?
2025-11-05.explanation: India signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Israel during the 17th Joint Working Group (JWG) on Defence Cooperation held in Tel Aviv to deepen strategic collaboration. The agreement focuses on co-development, co-production, advanced technology exchange, and counter-terrorism cooperation. It reinforces the two nations’ long-standing defence partnership, which has evolved through decades of shared security priorities and technological exchange. The MoU aligns with India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat (self-reliance) vision in defence manufacturing and supports the mutual goal of building a more secure and innovation-driven defence ecosystem between India and Israel.

2025-11-05.question: When will the final voter list for the second phase of the Special Voter List Revision be published?
2025-11-05.explanation: The Election Commission of India has initiated the second phase of the Special Voter List Revision, encompassing nine states and three Union Territories, representing an electorate of around 51 crore voters. This nationwide electoral update aims to ensure accuracy and inclusivity in voter registration. The process will conclude with the publication of the final voter list on February 7, 2026. The first phase of the exercise was completed in Bihar, covering 7.42 crore voters. The ongoing phase includes states like Tamil Nadu, Kerala, West Bengal, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh, while Assam remains excluded due to Supreme Court-led citizenship verification.

2025-11-05.question: Where was the Second World Summit for Social Development held in November 2025?
2025-11-05.explanation: The Second World Summit for Social Development took place in Doha, Qatar, from November 4–6, 2025. The event culminated in the adoption of the Doha Political Declaration, which reaffirmed global commitments to eradicate poverty, ensure decent work, and promote inclusive growth. The summit served as a key international platform to review progress on social development goals outlined in the original Copenhagen Declaration of 1995. India, represented by Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, actively participated in discussions highlighting challenges faced by the Global South, especially those linked to development disparities and the transformative role of emerging technologies.

2025-11-04.question: Which country launched the nuclear submarine “Khabarovsk” designed to carry the Poseidon underwater drone?
2025-11-04.explanation: Russia launched the nuclear-powered submarine “Khabarovsk” on November 1 at the Sevmash shipyard in Severodvinsk. The submarine is designed to carry the Poseidon Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV)—a nuclear-powered torpedo capable of traveling thousands of kilometers and reportedly carrying a warhead with a yield of about 2 megatons. Poseidon’s potential to generate large-scale radioactive tsunamis and its stealthy underwater deployment make it a key component of Russia’s strategic deterrence. The launch significantly extends Russia’s naval strike and deterrence capabilities while intensifying global security and stability concerns in maritime domains.

2025-11-04.question: Who reclaimed the ATP World No. 1 ranking after winning the 2025 Paris Masters final against Felix Auger-Aliassime?
2025-11-04.explanation: Jannik Sinner, the Italian tennis sensation, reclaimed the ATP World No. 1 ranking by defeating Felix Auger-Aliassime in straight sets—6-4, 7-6 (4)—in the 2025 Paris Masters final. This victory marked Sinner’s first Paris Masters title and extended his impressive indoor winning streak to 26 matches. With this win, he surpassed Carlos Alcaraz in the ATP rankings, consolidating his dominance during the 2025 season. Sinner’s consistency, particularly in indoor tournaments like Vienna and Paris, showcased his exceptional form, tactical maturity, and mental resilience, cementing his position among the elite players shaping the new era of men’s tennis.

2025-11-04.question: Which country is set to receive its first Taliban-appointed diplomat since the group’s takeover of Kabul in 2021, signaling cautious diplomatic engagement?
2025-11-04.explanation: India is preparing to receive the first Taliban-appointed diplomat since the Taliban’s return to power in Afghanistan in August 2021. This development marks a cautious reopening of diplomatic engagement between the two sides without formal recognition of the Taliban regime. The move follows Afghan Foreign Minister Amir Khan Muttaqi’s visit to New Delhi in October 2025 and aligns with India’s broader strategy of maintaining humanitarian assistance and regional stability. By permitting a limited diplomatic presence, India balances its security concerns, humanitarian commitments, and geopolitical interests while preserving communication channels with Kabul amid evolving regional dynamics.

2025-11-04.question: Which country has become the first in the world to achieve thorium-to-uranium fuel conversion in a Thorium Molten Salt Reactor (TMSR)?
2025-11-04.explanation: China has achieved a historic milestone by successfully performing thorium-to-uranium fuel conversion within its Thorium Molten Salt Reactor (TMSR), making it the first country in the world to do so. This breakthrough, announced on November 3, 2025, represents a major advancement in fourth-generation nuclear technology, offering safer, cleaner, and more efficient energy generation. The reactor converts thorium-232 into fissile uranium-233, enabling a sustainable thorium fuel cycle. With this success, China has demonstrated the viability of molten salt reactors and taken a leading position in the race for advanced nuclear innovation, complementing India’s ongoing thorium-based research initiatives.

2025-11-04.question: Which lake in Bihar has recently been declared a Ramsar site, gaining recognition as India’s newest wetland of international importance?
2025-11-04.explanation: Gogabeel Lake, located in the Katihar district of Bihar, has been designated as India’s newest Ramsar site, earning international recognition for its ecological and cultural significance. This ox-bow lake, formed by the meandering of rivers in the trans-Gangetic plains, is flanked by the Mahananda River in the northeast and the Ganga in the south. It supports diverse flora and fauna, serving as a vital wintering ground for migratory birds and home to species like the Smooth-Coated Otter and Helicopter Catfish. Additionally, its community involvement and cultural importance highlight the Ramsar Convention’s principle of “wise use” of wetlands.

2025-11-04.question: Which organization launched the “Reimagining Agriculture: A Roadmap for Frontier Technology Led Transformation” initiative to modernise Indian farming using AI and advanced technologies?

options.B: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

2025-11-04.explanation: NITI Aayog launched the “Reimagining Agriculture: A Roadmap for Frontier Technology Led Transformation” to accelerate India’s agricultural modernization through the integration of AI, digital twins, and precision farming. The initiative emphasises climate-resilient crops, sustainability, and increased farmer income by leveraging frontier technologies. It introduces a farmer segmentation model with three archetypes—Aspiring, Transitioning, and Advanced—to enable targeted interventions. By focusing on innovation and data-driven agricultural practices, the roadmap aims to enhance productivity, resource efficiency, and long-term resilience against climate challenges, marking a major policy push toward tech-enabled, inclusive agricultural growth in India.

2025-11-04.question: The newly launched ‘SBI-STAR’ Awards by the State Bank of India are primarily aimed at recognizing which aspect of its workforce?
2025-11-04.explanation: The State Bank of India (SBI) has introduced the ‘SBI-STAR’ Awards—Staff Talent Acknowledgement & Recognition—to honour employee talents beyond professional achievements. The initiative celebrates excellence in areas such as arts, sports, literature, social work, and environmental initiatives, fostering a culture of holistic employee engagement. With over 2.45 lakh employees, SBI aims to highlight the creative, athletic, and humanitarian contributions of its staff, reinforcing its human-centric leadership approach. This annual award program promotes inclusivity, motivation, and well-being within the organization, setting a new benchmark for employee recognition in India’s public sector banking ecosystem.

2025-11-04.question: Which global technology company has partnered with AICTE to establish an Artificial Intelligence lab in India to upskill students and faculty?
2025-11-04.explanation: IBM has partnered with the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to establish a state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence (AI) lab at AICTE headquarters. The initiative focuses on enhancing AI and data science skills among students and faculty through hands-on training, hackathons, and certified programs. It also includes a Master-Trainer Program to enable large-scale skill dissemination across India’s technical institutions. The collaboration aligns with India’s National Education Policy 2020 and National AI Strategy, as well as IBM’s global mission to promote inclusive technology education and build a future-ready digital workforce for the evolving tech ecosystem.

2025-11-04.question: Which country has become the first in the world to implement a generational smoking ban prohibiting tobacco use for anyone born after January 1, 2007?
2025-11-04.explanation: The Maldives has made history by enacting the world’s first generational smoking ban, effective from November 1, 2025. This law prohibits anyone born on or after January 1, 2007, from purchasing or using tobacco in any form. It applies to both citizens and tourists, covering cigarettes, vaping devices, and e-cigarettes. Retailers who violate the age verification mandate face heavy fines. By enforcing this strict regulation, the Maldives aims to create a completely smoke-free generation, prioritizing youth health and setting a global precedent after New Zealand’s repeal and the UK’s pending legislation on similar tobacco restrictions.

2025-11-04.question: Who was honoured with IIT Kanpur’s Distinguished Alumnus Award, the institute’s highest alumni honour, during its 66th Foundation Day celebrations?
2025-11-04.explanation: Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar was conferred IIT Kanpur’s Distinguished Alumnus Award, the premier recognition given by the institute to its former students for exceptional professional achievements. A 1985 B.Tech graduate in Civil Engineering from IIT Kanpur, Gyanesh Kumar has had an illustrious career in public service and governance. Instituted in 1989, this award celebrates alumni who have made significant contributions in their respective fields. The honour was presented during IIT Kanpur’s 66th Foundation Day celebrations, marking both academic excellence and leadership in public administration.

2025-11-04.question: Which tech company has signed a $38 billion deal with OpenAI to expand AI capabilities using its cloud infrastructure?
2025-11-04.explanation: Amazon, through its cloud division Amazon Web Services (AWS), has entered a $38 billion partnership with OpenAI to enhance AI infrastructure and scalability. Announced on November 3, 2025, the agreement provides OpenAI access to AWS’s extensive cloud computing resources, including millions of CPUs and hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs. This collaboration marks one of the largest AI infrastructure deployments in history and signifies a major strategic shift for OpenAI, which previously relied exclusively on Microsoft Azure. The deal strengthens Amazon’s position as a key competitor in the global AI and cloud computing market.

2025-11-04.question: Which bank executed its first gold trade as a Special Category Client (SCC) on the India International Bullion Exchange (IIBX)?
2025-11-04.explanation: The State Bank of India (SBI) achieved a major milestone by executing its first gold trade on the India International Bullion Exchange (IIBX) as a Special Category Client (SCC). This move enhances transparency and efficiency in India’s bullion market while making gold trading more accessible and cost-effective for MSME jewellers and bullion dealers. By participating in IIBX, SBI contributes to the development of GIFT City as a global financial and bullion trading hub. The initiative also aligns with the government’s vision of modernising India’s bullion ecosystem through regulated and technology-driven market practices.

2025-11-03.question: In which Indian state was the Integrated Sohra Tourism Circuit launched under the PM-DevINE scheme by Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia?
2025-11-03.explanation: The Integrated Sohra Tourism Circuit was launched in Meghalaya under the PM-DevINE scheme, with Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia laying its foundation. Valued at ₹233 crore, this project aims to develop Sohra (Cherrapunji) into a model destination for sustainable tourism. It forms part of the larger ₹650 crore initiative focusing on tourism, connectivity, and regional development in the Northeast. Additionally, key infrastructure projects such as the Shillong–Silchar Expressway, Umroi Airport expansion, and New Shillong City initiative are being implemented to boost Meghalaya’s economic growth and tourism potential in the region.

2025-11-03.question: Who assumed charge as the 40th Chief of Materiel of the Indian Navy on 01 Nov 2025, succeeding Vice Admiral Kiran Deshmukh?
2025-11-03.explanation: Vice Admiral B Sivakumar, AVSM, VSM, assumed the role of the 40th Chief of Materiel on the specified date, taking over from Vice Admiral Kiran Deshmukh. His extensive background, including being an NDA alumnus, a postgraduate from IIT Chennai, and having over 38 years of service, is detailed. His prior experience as the Director General of Naval Projects in Visakhapatnam and his expertise in naval technology and warship production further confirm his identity as the officer who took on this key leadership position within the Indian Navy.

2025-11-03.question: On which date is World Jellyfish Day celebrated annually to raise awareness about the ecological importance and beauty of jellyfish?
2025-11-03.explanation: World Jellyfish Day is celebrated every year on November 3 to honour one of Earth’s oldest and most fascinating marine organisms. Jellyfish have existed for over 500 million years and play a vital role in maintaining marine ecosystem balance. Despite their reputation for stings, they contribute to oceanic food chains, provide shelter for juvenile fish, and act as indicators of ocean health and climate change. The day encourages appreciation through educational activities, aquarium visits, and conservation awareness, emphasizing the need to protect marine biodiversity and promote sustainable ocean practices worldwide.

2025-11-03.question: Which advanced communication satellite is ISRO launching to enhance the Indian Navy’s maritime domain awareness and secure communication network?
2025-11-03.explanation: GSAT-7R, also known as CMS-03, is India’s heaviest and most advanced indigenous naval communication satellite, weighing approximately 4,400 kg. Launched by ISRO from Sriharikota, it is designed to significantly enhance the Indian Navy’s space-based communication capabilities and maritime domain awareness across the Indian Ocean Region. The satellite is equipped with multi-band transponders that provide secure, high-bandwidth voice, data, and video connectivity between naval command centres and assets at sea. GSAT-7R strengthens India’s strategic communication infrastructure, ensuring reliable and real-time naval operations in both peacetime and defence scenarios.

2025-11-03.question: Which country’s Citizenship and Immigration Services agency has ended cheque and money order payments, making electronic debit via Form G-1650 mandatory for immigration filings?
2025-11-03.explanation: The United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has introduced a significant policy change by discontinuing cheque and money order payments for immigration-related filings. Applicants must now use electronic debit through Form G-1650 for all transactions. This shift aims to enhance security, minimise the risk of fraud, and ensure faster, more efficient processing. According to USCIS spokesperson Matthew J. Tragesser, the updated system replaces outdated manual methods, aligning with modern digital standards to improve accuracy, reliability, and overall transparency in immigration service operations within the United States.

2025-11-03.question: In which city is the Emerging Science & Technology Innovation Conclave (ESTIC-2025) being held, inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
2025-11-03.explanation: The Emerging Science & Technology Innovation Conclave 2025 (ESTIC-2025) is being hosted in New Delhi from November 3 to 5, bringing together over 3,000 participants, including leading scientists, innovators, and policymakers. The event, inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, focuses on the theme “Viksit Bharat 2047 – Pioneering Sustainable Innovation, Technological Advancement and Empowerment.” During the conclave, the Prime Minister also launched the ₹1 Lakh Crore Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Scheme to accelerate private-led R&D initiatives and support deep-tech startups, strengthening India’s path toward technological self-reliance and sustainable innovation.

2025-11-03.question: Who assumed charge as the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) on November 1, 2025?
