2025-11-03.explanation: Shri Vishvajit Sahay, a 1990 batch officer of the Indian Defence Accounts Service (IDAS), assumed charge as the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) on November 1, 2025. With over 30 years of experience in defence finance, he has held several senior positions, including Additional Secretary and Financial Adviser in the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and Finance Manager in the Ministry of Defence (MoD). An alumnus of St. Stephen’s College, Sahay has also represented India at international forums, contributing significantly to the modernization and transparency of defence financial management.

2025-11-03.question: Which DNA repair protein discovered by University of Iowa researchers shows potential for new cancer therapies by targeting DNA repair deficiencies such as BRCA1/2 mutations?
2025-11-03.explanation: RAD52 is a DNA repair protein identified by University of Iowa researchers as crucial for cancer cell survival, particularly in cells with BRCA1/2 mutations that impair DNA repair mechanisms. By inhibiting RAD52, researchers can selectively kill cancer cells without heavily affecting normal cells. This approach offers a promising alternative to PARP inhibitors, potentially overcoming drug resistance and reducing side effects associated with traditional treatments like chemotherapy and radiation, thereby opening new therapeutic avenues for cancers with DNA repair deficiencies.

2025-11-03.question: Who was re-elected as the President of Tanzania with 97.66% of the votes amid reports of violent unrest and protests?
2025-11-03.explanation: Samia Suluhu Hassan was re-elected as the President of Tanzania with an overwhelming 97.66% of the votes and a voter turnout of 87%. Her victory came during a period of significant unrest marked by violent protests and allegations of election irregularities. Opposition groups reported hundreds of deaths, although the United Nations confirmed at least 10 casualties. Despite the controversy surrounding the process, Hassan’s re-election secured her another five-year term, reinforcing her position as one of Africa’s prominent female leaders and a key figure in Tanzania’s political landscape.

2025-11-03.question: In which city was the International Conference on “Libraries Empowering Communities – Global Perspectives” held to mark 80 years of Kerala’s library movement?
2025-11-03.explanation: The International Conference on “Libraries Empowering Communities – Global Perspectives” was organised at Kanakakkunnu Palace in Thiruvananthapuram on November 2–3, 2025, commemorating 80 years of Kerala’s library movement initiated by the P. N. Panicker Foundation. The event gathered librarians, policymakers, and global experts to discuss the evolving role of libraries in promoting literacy and access to knowledge. Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan highlighted libraries as “temples of learning,” emphasizing their importance in fostering digital literacy, critical thinking, and combating misinformation in the modern age of technology and information overload.

2025-11-02.question: Which Indian tennis legend announced his retirement after a 20-year professional career, ending with a final appearance at the Paris Masters 2025?
2025-11-02.explanation: Rohan Bopanna, one of India’s greatest tennis players, retired in 2025 after a distinguished two-decade-long career. Known for his powerful serves and exceptional doubles play, Bopanna achieved historic milestones, including winning two Grand Slam titles — the 2017 French Open mixed doubles and the 2024 Australian Open men’s doubles. He became the oldest player to reach World No. 1 in doubles at age 43. His famous partnership with Pakistan’s Aisam-ul-Haq Qureshi, dubbed the “Indo-Pak Express,” symbolised sportsmanship and unity. Bopanna’s legacy extends beyond trophies, as he inspired future Indian tennis players through perseverance and excellence on the global stage.

2025-11-02.question: Who has been appointed as the Chief Product and Business Officer of Google Cloud?
2025-11-02.explanation: Karthik Narain, a seasoned technology leader and former Accenture Chief Technology Officer, has been appointed as the Chief Product and Business Officer at Google Cloud. With over 25 years of experience in cloud, AI, and enterprise transformation, Narain brings deep industry expertise to one of the world’s most competitive cloud ecosystems. In his new role, he will oversee product, engineering, and go-to-market strategies, helping Google Cloud expand its global presence and AI-driven enterprise offerings. His appointment strengthens Thomas Kurian’s leadership team and reinforces Google’s strategic push to accelerate innovation and compete effectively with AWS and Microsoft Azure in the enterprise cloud market.

2025-11-02.question: Which country launched the Shenzhou-21 mission carrying three astronauts and four lab mice to the Tiangong Space Station?
2025-11-02.explanation: China launched the Shenzhou-21 mission to its Tiangong Space Station, marking another milestone in its rapidly advancing space programme. The mission carried three astronauts — including 32-year-old Wu Fei, the nation’s youngest astronaut — and four lab mice for biological experiments in microgravity. Conducted from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre using a Long March-2F rocket, the mission aims to expand research on space-based biology, maintenance operations, and spacewalks. This achievement aligns with China’s long-term goal of landing humans on the Moon by 2030 and reinforces its position as a key global player in space exploration and scientific innovation.

2025-11-02.question: Who was elected as the 10th President of Ireland after winning about 63% of the vote in the 2025 presidential election?
2025-11-02.explanation: Catherine Connolly, an independent left-wing politician from Galway, was elected as Ireland’s 10th President with around 63% of the first-preference votes, defeating her main rival Heather Humphreys. Her victory marks a significant moment in Irish politics, being both a rebuke to the centre-right establishment and a sign of public support for progressive and inclusive values. Connolly, who has served as a Teachta Dála since 2016 and was Deputy Speaker of Parliament, campaigned on themes of social justice, neutrality in foreign policy, and equality, promising to be “a president for all” Irish citizens.

2025-11-02.question: Who has been appointed as the new Archbishop of Canterbury, becoming the first woman to lead the Church of England?
2025-11-02.explanation: Dame Sarah Mullally has made history as the first woman appointed Archbishop of Canterbury, the highest office in the Church of England. Formerly the NHS Chief Nursing Officer for England, she transitioned to the priesthood in 2006 and became the Bishop of London in 2018. Her appointment marks a major milestone for gender equality in the Anglican Church, reflecting its ongoing journey toward inclusivity and reform. Approved by King Charles III after nomination by Prime Minister Keir Starmer, she will officially take office in January 2026. Her priorities include safeguarding reforms, rebuilding trust, and promoting compassion and inclusivity in the Church’s mission.

2025-11-02.question: Who was recognised by the World Food Prize Foundation as a 2025 Top Agri-Food Pioneer for his contributions to nutrition and sustainable food systems?
2025-11-02.explanation: Chef Sanjeev Kapoor, a celebrated Indian chef and Padma Shri awardee, was honoured by the World Food Prize Foundation as one of its 2025 Top Agri-Food Pioneers. He earned this global recognition for integrating culinary innovation with nutrition advocacy, sustainable sourcing, and agricultural transformation. Kapoor’s initiatives, such as Nutri Pathshala, have connected schools, farmers, and nutrition programmes, helping deliver over 2.5 million nutrient-rich meals to children. His promotion of bio-fortified crops like iron-rich pearl millet and zinc-rich wheat has advanced both food security and community health. This recognition highlights how chefs can drive real change in agriculture and nutrition policy.

2025-11-02.question: Which company launched ‘VEER’, India’s first electric vehicle designed specifically for defence operations?
2025-11-02.explanation: Pravaig, a Bengaluru-based company, has launched VEER, India’s first indigenous electric vehicle developed for defence applications. Built under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative, the Pravaig VEER EV offers stealth capabilities, high terrain mobility, and quick field-repair readiness, making it ideal for modern military missions. The vehicle recently received the iDEX (Innovation for Defence Excellence) award, recognizing its contribution to indigenous defence innovation. By combining sustainability, tactical efficiency, and technological advancement, the VEER strengthens India’s self-reliance in defence manufacturing and positions the nation as a potential leader in electric military vehicle technology on the global stage.

2025-11-02.question: What is the name of the new programme launched by UIDAI to enhance Aadhaar security and promote digital innovation?
2025-11-02.explanation: SITAA, which stands for Scheme for Innovation and Technology Association with Aadhaar, is a new initiative launched by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The programme aims to strengthen Aadhaar’s technological foundation by encouraging innovation and research in areas like artificial intelligence, biometric authentication, and data security. In collaboration with MeitY Startup Hub and NASSCOM, SITAA will nurture startups and researchers to develop homegrown solutions for a secure and inclusive digital identity ecosystem. It also aligns with national missions such as Digital Public Infrastructure and Atmanirbhar Bharat, fostering self-reliance and trust in India’s digital framework.

2025-11-02.question: What was the year-on-year growth rate of India's GST revenue in October 2025, which marked the slowest pace in over four years?
2025-11-02.explanation: India’s Goods and Services Tax (GST) revenue grew by 4.6% year-on-year in October 2025, reaching ₹1.96 lakh crore — the highest in five months but marking the slowest growth in over four years. Despite the moderation, revenues remained above ₹1.8 lakh crore for the tenth straight month, reflecting consistent economic activity and strong tax compliance. The slowdown was partly due to the government’s restructuring of GST slabs, which simplified the tax system by reducing higher-rate categories. This reform is expected to stimulate consumption and investment over time, helping sustain fiscal stability and support India’s long-term economic growth trajectory.

2025-11-02.question: Which team won the ICC Women’s ODI World Cup 2025 by defeating South Africa by 52 runs in the final at Navi Mumbai?
2025-11-02.explanation: India won their maiden ICC Women’s ODI World Cup title in 2025 by defeating South Africa by 52 runs in the final held at the DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai. India posted a strong total of 298/7, powered by Shafali Verma’s 87 and Deepti Sharma’s all-round brilliance, including a fifty and five wickets. South Africa’s Laura Wolvaardt scored a valiant 101, but India’s bowlers sealed the victory. This triumph marked India’s first-ever Women’s ODI World Cup title, making it a historic achievement for Indian cricket and a defining moment for women’s sports in the country.

2025-11-01.question: How many countries received $5.8 million from the Kunming Biodiversity Fund to promote nature-friendly agriculture?
2025-11-01.explanation: A total of seven countries — Cook Islands, Madagascar, Mexico, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Turkey, and Uganda — collectively received $5.8 million from the Kunming Biodiversity Fund. The funding supports projects that integrate biodiversity into agricultural practices, empower local communities, and control invasive species. Backed by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), the initiative aligns with the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. By encouraging eco-friendly farming and strengthening biodiversity protection, the program promotes sustainable agriculture that benefits both ecosystems and local livelihoods across multiple regions.

2025-11-01.question: Which global technology company has partnered with Reliance Industries to strengthen India’s AI infrastructure and expand access to AI tools?
2025-11-01.explanation: Google has partnered with Reliance Industries to enhance India’s AI infrastructure and make artificial intelligence more accessible across the nation. The collaboration focuses on developing local AI computing power, promoting innovation, and supporting the “AI for All” mission. Through this alliance, Jio users aged 18 to 25 will receive 18 months of free access to Google Gemini Pro, empowering young Indians to explore AI technologies. The partnership also includes efforts to build AI models for Indian languages and establish domestic data centers powered by green energy, thereby boosting India’s digital inclusion, sustainability, and technological self-reliance.

2025-11-01.question: Which country co-chaired the annual health partnership meeting with India to review the 2025 Progress Report and approve Phase IV work plans for 2025–26?
2025-11-01.explanation: The annual partnership meeting between India and Norway focused on reviewing the 2025 Progress Report and approving Phase IV work plans for 2025–26 under the Norway India Partnership Initiative (NIPI). This collaboration aims to enhance public health outcomes through innovation and data-driven decision-making. One of its major achievements is the Indian Public Health Standards – Open Data Kit Tool, which enables states to identify healthcare gaps and receive focused support efficiently. The partnership showcases strong bilateral cooperation in improving maternal, newborn, and child health systems across India through technology and evidence-based planning.

2025-11-01.question: After whom has the FIDE Chess World Cup 2025 trophy been renamed?
2025-11-01.explanation: The FIDE Chess World Cup 2025 trophy has been renamed the Viswanathan Anand Cup to honour India’s legendary chess grandmaster and five-time World Champion. This decision celebrates Anand’s immense contributions to global chess and his role in inspiring generations of Indian players. Known as the “Tiger of Madras,” Anand’s achievements transformed chess into a mainstream sport in India. The renaming was announced during a ceremony in Goa, attended by key dignitaries, including the FIDE President and Indian officials. The tribute marks a proud recognition of Anand’s lasting legacy in the international chess community.

2025-11-01.question: Which senior IDAS officer took charge as the Financial Advisor (Defence Services) on November 1, 2025?
2025-11-01.explanation: Shri Raj Kumar Arora, a 1990-batch officer of the Indian Defence Accounts Service (IDAS), has assumed charge as the Financial Advisor (Defence Services) on November 1, 2025. With over three decades of experience in defence finance, budgeting, audit, and policy, he brings vast expertise to one of India’s most critical financial positions. Before this role, he served as the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) and held senior posts in the UPSC, Ministry of Defence, and Ministry of Finance. His leadership is expected to enhance fiscal efficiency, transparency, and strategic financial planning in India’s defence establishment.

2025-11-01.question: Which organization released the Hindi translation of the Lithuanian novel “The Last Day,” titled “Antim Din”?
2025-11-01.explanation: Sahitya Akademi, under the Ministry of Culture, launched the Hindi edition of Lithuanian author Jaroslavas Melnikas’s novel “The Last Day”, titled “Antim Din”. This initiative marks the first-ever translation of a Lithuanian fiction work into Hindi, representing a milestone in India–Lithuania literary collaboration. The novel, translated by Dr. Poonam Tiwari, was released at Rabindra Bhawan, New Delhi, in partnership with the Embassy of Lithuania. The event underscored the Akademi’s mission to promote global literature in Indian languages and foster cultural understanding through translation, making international literary masterpieces more accessible to Indian readers.

2025-11-01.question: On which date will World Vegan Day 2025 be celebrated?
2025-11-01.explanation: World Vegan Day 2025 will be celebrated on November 1, marking the beginning of World Vegan Month. The day is dedicated to promoting vegan living, sustainability, and compassion toward all living beings. It encourages people to adopt a plant-based lifestyle that avoids animal exploitation and supports environmental protection. Events such as awareness campaigns, vegan fairs, and cooking workshops are held globally to highlight the benefits of veganism for human health, animal welfare, and the planet. Established in 1994 by Louise Wallis of the Vegan Society UK, the day continues to inspire sustainable and ethical choices worldwide.

2025-11-01.question: Which company has partnered with OpenAI to integrate its digital wallet into ChatGPT, becoming the platform’s first integrated payments wallet?
2025-11-01.explanation: PayPal has partnered with OpenAI to become ChatGPT’s first integrated digital payments wallet, allowing users to make secure purchases directly within the AI platform. This collaboration enables seamless e-commerce by letting users click “Buy with PayPal” in ChatGPT for instant payments. The move strengthens PayPal’s role in the emerging field of AI-powered commerce, showcasing its commitment to innovation and user trust through secure checkout, buyer protection, and verified transactions. By aligning with OpenAI’s growing ecosystem, PayPal positions itself at the forefront of the digital payment revolution, blending convenience, safety, and artificial intelligence to shape the future of online shopping.

2025-11-01.question: Which country agreed to cut tariffs on Chinese imports from 57% to 47% as part of the one-year truce on rare earth exports?
2025-11-01.explanation: The United States agreed to reduce tariffs on Chinese imports from 57% to 47% following diplomatic negotiations with China in Busan, South Korea. This deal temporarily eased tensions between the two major economies, marking a one-year truce on rare earth exports. The U.S. concessions were part of a broader agreement that included China’s resumption of soybean purchases and increased action against fentanyl trafficking, reflecting efforts by both sides to stabilise trade relations and promote economic cooperation despite ongoing strategic competition.

2025-11-01.question: Which country launched the Fully Digital Marine Fisheries Census 2025 using multilingual Android apps developed by ICAR-CMFRI?
2025-11-01.explanation: India launched the Fully Digital Marine Fisheries Census 2025, marking a major technological leap in fisheries data collection. This initiative replaces traditional paper-based surveys with advanced multilingual Android applications — VyAS-BHARAT, VyAS-SUTRA, and VyAS-NAV — developed by ICAR-CMFRI. The census aims to comprehensively cover 1.2 million fisher households across 5,000 marine villages in 13 coastal states and union territories. By integrating real-time geo-referenced data, drone-based craft enumeration, and dashboard monitoring, India is modernizing fisheries management, improving data accuracy, and enabling informed policymaking for the sustainable development of the marine sector.
